ex.cn: 他们的声音飘过湖面传到了另一边。

ex.en: Delicious smells wafted up from the kitchen.
ex.cn: 香喷喷的味道从厨房飘了出来。

ex.cn: 痛哭流涕的妇女

senses.chn: 大声呼叫；哀号；高声抱怨

ex.en: 'It's broken,' she wailed.
ex.cn: “打碎了。” 她大声叫道。

ex.en: There's no point wailing about something that happened so long ago.
ex.cn: 事情早已发生，痛哭流涕也于事无补。

senses.def: to make a long loud high sound

ex.en: Ambulances raced by with sirens wailing.
ex.cn: 救护车高声鸣笛疾驰而过。

senses.def: a long loud high cry expressing pain or sadness; a sound similar to this
senses.chn: （疼痛或悲伤时发出的）号啕，哀号

ex.en: a wail of despair

ex.en: the distant wail of sirens

ex.en: She was paralysed from the waist down (= in the area below her waist).
ex.cn: 她从腰部以下都瘫痪了。

ex.cn: 工人光着上身。

up to the waist

ex.cn: 水齐腰深。

ex.en: We waded waist-deep into the muddy water.
ex.cn: 我们蹚进齐腰深的泥水里。

senses.def: high enough to reach the waist

ex.en: waist-high grass
ex.cn: 齐腰高的草

to stay where you are or delay doing sth until sb/sth comes or sth happens

ex.en: She rang the bell and waited.
ex.cn: 她按铃后等候着。

ex.en: Have you been waiting long?
ex.cn: 你等了很久了吗？

ex.en: I've been waiting (for) twenty minutes.
ex.cn: 我等了二十分钟。

ex.en: I'll wait outside until the meeting's over.
ex.cn: 我会在外面等到会议结束。

ex.en: Wait for me!
ex.cn: 等等我！

ex.en: We're waiting for the rain to stop before we go out.
ex.cn: 我们要等到雨停了再出去。

senses.def: to hope or watch for sth to happen, especially for a long time

ex.en: Leeds United had waited for success for eighteen years.
ex.cn: 利兹联队企盼夺冠已经十八年了。

ex.en: This is just the opportunity I've been waiting for.
ex.cn: 这正是我一直在期待的机会。

ex.en: He's waiting for me to make a mistake.
ex.cn: 他正盼着我出错呢。

ex.en: I waited my chance and slipped out when no one was looking.
ex.cn: 我等待时机，趁没人注意时溜了出去。

senses.def: to be ready for sb to have or use
senses.chn: 准备妥；在手边；可得到；可使用

ex.en: There's a letter waiting for you at home.
ex.cn: 家里有你一封信。

ex.en: The hotel had a taxi waiting to collect us.
ex.cn: 旅馆召了辆出租车等着接我们。

senses.def: to be left to be dealt with at a later time because it is not urgent

ex.en: I've got some calls to make but they can wait until tomorrow.
ex.cn: 我有几个电话要打，不过可以等到明天再说。

senses.def: a thing or person that is very likely to cause danger or a problem in the future because of the condition it is in or the way they behave
used when you are emphasizing that sb is very excited about sth or keen to do it

ex.en: The children can't wait for Christmas to come.
ex.cn: 孩子们等圣诞节都等不及了。

ex.en: I can hardly wait to see him again.
ex.cn: 我迫不及待地想再次见到他。

senses.def: to make sb have to wait or be delayed, especially because you arrive late
senses.chn: （尤指因迟到）让人等候，使人耽搁

ex.en: I'm sorry to have kept you waiting.
ex.cn: 对不起，让你久等了。

senses.def: used to tell sb that they must be patient and wait to find out about sth later

ex.en: We'll just have to wait and see—there's nothing we can do at the moment.
ex.cn: 我们只得等等看，眼下没有法子。

ex.en: a wait-and-see policy
ex.cn: 等待观望的政策

ex.en: 'Where are we going?' 'Wait and see!'
ex.cn: “我们到哪里去？” “等着瞧吧！”

senses.def: to serve food to people, for example at a formal meal
senses.chn: 伺候进餐；（往饭桌上）端饭上菜

senses.def: used to say that you are about to tell sb sth that is surprising or amusing
senses.chn: （要说出令人吃惊或高兴的事情）听着，听好了

ex.en: They're off on a trip, to—wait for it—the Maldives!
ex.cn: 他们出去旅行了，去的地方是，听好了，马尔代夫！

senses.def: used to tell sb not to start doing sth yet, but to wait until you tell them
senses.chn: （让人在得到通知前别做某事）等候通知

senses.def: to wait for a short time

ex.en: Can you wait a second while I make a call?
ex.cn: 你能等一会儿让我打个电话吗？

senses.def: used when you have just noticed or remembered sth, or had a sudden idea
senses.chn: （刚注意到、想起某事或突然想出了主意）且慢，等一等

ex.en: Wait a minute—this isn't the right key.
ex.cn: 等一等，不是这把钥匙。

senses.def: to take care of sb's needs so well that they do not have to do anything for themselves
senses.chn: 过分照顾；让…饭来张口，衣来伸手

senses.def: to work serving food to people in a restaurant
used to show that you are very excited about telling or showing sth to sb
senses.chn: （兴奋地表示或展示某事物）等到…吧

ex.en: Wait till you see what I've found!
ex.cn: 你等着看我发现了什么吧！

senses.def: used to suggest that you should all start doing what you have been discussing
senses.chn: （建议都应开始去做商议中的事）我们还在等什么呢

senses.def: used to tell sb to do sth now rather than later
senses.chn: （让人马上就干而不要往后拖）你还等什么呢

ex.en: If the car needs cleaning, what are you waiting for?
ex.cn: 如果这辆汽车需要清洗，你还在等什么呢？

senses.def: used to emphasize a threat, warning or promise
senses.chn: （用以加强威胁、警告或允诺的语气）你就等着吧，你就等着瞧

ex.en: I'll be famous one day, just you wait!
ex.cn: 我有朝一日会出名的，你就等着瞧吧！

senses.def: to wait for a situation to become clear or certain
senses.chn: 待尘埃落定；待形势明朗

senses.def: ready to take over a particular job or be used in a particular situation when needed
senses.chn: 准备接替某工作；准备就绪

senses.def: to stay in a place, with nothing particular to do, for example because you are expecting sth to happen or sb to arrive
to stay after other people have gone, especially to speak to sb privately
senses.chn: 等到他人走后留下来（尤指为与人私下谈话）

senses.def: to stay at home because you are expecting sb to come, telephone, etc.
to act as a servant to sb, especially by serving food to them
senses.chn: 伺候，服侍，招待（尤指进餐）

senses.def: to wait for sth to happen before you do or decide sth
senses.chn: 等待…（才采取行动或作出决定）

ex.en: She is waiting on the result of a blood test.
ex.cn: 她在等验血结果。

senses.def: to wait until an unpleasant event has finished
senses.chn: 等待（令人不快的事情）结束

ex.en: We sheltered in a doorway to wait out the storm.

ex.cn: 我讨厌她一贯批评我的方式。

ex.en: I told you we should have done it my way!
ex.cn: 我跟你说过我们原本应该用我的方法来做这事。

senses.def: a particular manner or style of behaviour

ex.en: They grinned at her in a friendly way.
ex.cn: 他们友好地对她咧嘴笑了笑。

ex.en: It was not his way to admit that he had made a mistake.
ex.cn: 承认自己犯了错误可不是他一贯的作风。

ex.en: Don't worry, if she seems quiet— it's just her way.
ex.cn: 如果她看上去不爱说话，别担心，她就是这么个人。

ex.en: He was showing off, as is the way with adolescent boys.
ex.cn: 他在炫耀，青春期的男孩都是这个样子。

senses.def: the typical way of behaving and living of a particular group of people
senses.chn: （群体的）行为方式，生活方式，习俗

ex.en: After ten years I'm used to the strange British ways.
ex.cn: 十年之后，我习惯了英国人的奇异习俗。

senses.def: a route or road that you take in order to reach a place

ex.en: the best/quickest/shortest way from A to B
ex.cn: 从甲地到乙地最好的／最快的／最近的路线

ex.en: Can you tell me the way to Leicester Square?
ex.cn: 你能告诉我去莱斯特广场的路吗？

ex.en: to ask sb the way
ex.cn: 向某人问路

ex.en: We went the long way round.
ex.cn: 我们绕了一个大圈子。

senses.def: the route along which sb/sth is moving; the route that sb/sth would take if there was nothing stopping them/it

ex.en: Get out of my way! I'm in a hurry.
ex.cn: 让开！我有急事。

ex.en: Riot police with shields were blocking the demonstrators' way.
ex.cn: 手持盾牌的防暴警察堵住了示威者的路。

ex.en: We fought our way through the dense vegetation.
ex.cn: 我们在茂密的植被中开出一条通路。

ex.en: Unfortunately they ran into a snowstorm along the way.
ex.cn: 他们不幸在途中遇上了暴风雪。

senses.def: a road, path or street for travelling along

ex.en: There's a way across the fields.
ex.cn: 有一条路穿过田地。

senses.def: used in the names of streets

ex.en: 106 Headley Way
ex.cn: 黑德利路 106 号

senses.def: a particular direction; in a particular direction

ex.en: Which way did they go?
ex.cn: 他们往哪边去了？

ex.en: We just missed a car coming the other way.
ex.cn: 我们差点被一辆对面开过来的汽车撞上。

ex.en: Look both ways (= look left and right) before crossing the road.
ex.cn: 横过马路前要朝左右两边看一看。

ex.en: Make sure that sign's the right way up.
ex.cn: 一定不要把这招牌挂颠倒了。

ex.en: Kids were running this way and that (= in all directions).
ex.cn: 孩子们四处奔跑。

ex.en: They decided to split the money four ways (= between four different people).
ex.cn: 他们决定把钱分成四份。

senses.def: a means of going into or leaving a place, such as a door or gate

ex.en: the way in/out
ex.cn: 入口；出口

ex.en: They escaped out the back way.
ex.cn: 他们从后门逃走了。

senses.def: a distance or period of time between two points

ex.en: A little way up on the left is the Museum of Modern Art.
ex.cn: 前面不远左手边就是现代艺术博物馆。

ex.en: September was a long way off.
ex.cn: 那时离九月份还有很长一段时间。

ex.en: The area's wine industry still has a way to go to full maturity.
ex.cn: 这个地区的酿酒业还远远没有完全成熟。

ex.en: You came all this way to see us?
ex.cn: 你大老远地跑来看我们？

ex.en: We still have a ways to go.
ex.cn: 我们还有很大的差距。

senses.def: an area, a part of a country, etc.

ex.en: I think he lives somewhere over Greenwich way.
ex.cn: 我想他住在格林尼治那一带。

ex.en: I'll stop by and see you next time I'm down your way.
ex.cn: 下次我去你那一带时会顺道去看你的。

senses.def: a particular aspect of sth

ex.en: I have changed in every way.
ex.cn: 我已经完完全全变了。

ex.en: It's been quite a day, one way and another (= for several reasons).
ex.cn: 从几方面看，这是不寻常的一天。

senses.def: a particular condition or state

ex.en: The economy's in a bad way.
ex.cn: 经济状况很糟。

ex.en: I don't know how we're going to manage, the way things are.
ex.cn: 按目前这样的情况，我不知道我们要如何应付。

senses.def: on the other side of the street, etc.

ex.en: Music blared from the open window of the house across the way.
ex.cn: 从街对面那栋房子开着的窗户里传出嘈杂的音乐声。

senses.def: during the whole journey/period of time

ex.en: She didn't speak a word to me all the way back home.
ex.cn: 回家的一路上，她没对我说过一句话。

senses.def: completely; as much as it takes to achieve what you want

ex.en: I'm fighting him all the way.
ex.cn: 我在全力和他对抗。

ex.en: You can feel that the audience is with her all the way.
ex.cn: 你可以感觉到听众完全支持她。

senses.def: used to say that things often happen in a particular way, especially when it is not convenient
senses.chn: （表示经常如此，尤用于贬义）总是这样，老是

senses.def: however you choose to look at a situation
to behave or do things in a particular manner because it is part of your character

ex.en: It's not his fault he's so pompous—he was born that way.
ex.cn: 他如此自命不凡并不是他的错，他天生就是这种性格。

senses.def: to have habits or opinions that you have had for a long time and that you do not want to change
senses.chn: 积习难改；禀性难移；执拗

senses.def: used to introduce a comment or question that is not directly related to what you have been talking about
senses.chn: 顺便提一下；捎带说一声；附带问一句

ex.en: By the way, I found that book you were looking for.
ex.cn: 顺便提一下，我找到了你在寻找的那本书。

ex.en: What's the time, by the way?
ex.cn: 顺便问一句，几点钟了？

ex.en: Oh by the way, if you see Jackie, tell her I'll call her this evening.
ex.cn: 啊，对了，你要是看到杰基，告诉她我今晚给她打电话。

senses.def: by a route that includes the place mentioned

ex.en: The artist recently arrived in Paris from Bulgaria by way of Vienna.
ex.cn: 这位艺术家最近从保加利亚途经维也纳到了巴黎。

ex.en: She came to TV by way of drama school.
ex.cn: 她是念过戏剧学校后到电视台的。

senses.def: as a form of sth; for sth; as a means of sth
senses.chn: 作为…的形式；为了；作为…的手段

ex.en: He received £600 by way of compensation from the company.
ex.cn: 他得到那家公司 600 英镑的赔偿。

ex.en: She rolled her eyes by way of an answer and left.
ex.cn: 她转动了一下眼睛作为回答就走了。

senses.def: to happen to you by chance, or when you were not expecting it
senses.chn: 意外落在…头上；偶尔发生在…身上

ex.en: He took whatever came his way.
ex.cn: 无论什么事落到他的头上，他都认了。

senses.def: to have two opposite effects or results
senses.chn: 两面都行得通（或说得通）；有利也有弊

senses.def: used to say that it does not matter which one of two possibilities happens, is chosen or is true

ex.en: Was it his fault or not? Either way, an explanation is due.
ex.cn: 是他的错或不是？无论是不是，都得有个解释。

ex.en: We could meet today or tomorrow—I don't mind one way or the other.
ex.cn: 我们可以在今天或明天见面，哪一天对我都行。

senses.def: in all directions

ex.en: Her hair tumbled every which way.
ex.cn: 她的头发乱得像鸡窝。

senses.def: to become used to doing sth/to lose the habit of doing sth

ex.en: The women had got into the way of going up on the deck every evening.
ex.cn: 这些女人养成了每天晚上到平台去的习惯。

senses.def: to prevent sb from doing sth; to prevent sth from happening

ex.en: He wouldn't allow emotions to get in the way of him doing his job.
ex.cn: 他不会让感情妨碍自己的工作。

senses.def: to get or do what you want, especially when sb has tried to stop you

ex.en: She always gets her own way in the end.
ex.cn: 到最后总是她说了算。

senses.def: to break or fall down

ex.en: The pillars gave way and a section of the roof collapsed.
ex.cn: 这些立柱坍塌了，一部分屋顶坠落下来。

ex.en: Her numb leg gave way beneath her and she stumbled clumsily.
ex.cn: 她那麻木了的腿一软，她便重重地摔了一跤。

senses.def: to stop resisting sb/sth; to agree to do sth that you do not want to do

ex.en: He refused to give way on any of the points.
ex.cn: 他拒绝在任何一点上让步。

senses.def: to allow sb/sth to be or go first

ex.en: Give way to traffic already on the roundabout.
ex.cn: 让已上环状交叉路的车辆先行。

senses.def: to allow yourself to be very strongly affected by sth, especially an emotion
senses.chn: 让自己陷于（某种情绪等）

ex.en: Flinging herself on the bed, she gave way to helpless misery.
ex.cn: 她一头扑倒在床上，痛苦不堪。

senses.def: to be replaced by sth

ex.en: The storm gave way to bright sunshine.
ex.cn: 暴风雨过后阳光灿烂。

senses.def: to have full sexual intercourse with sb
to help very much/a little in achieving sth
senses.chn: （对做某事）帮助很大／不大，作用很大／不大

ex.en: The new law goes a long way towards solving the problem.
ex.cn: 新的法律十分有助于解决这一问题。

senses.def: to make a special effort to do sth

ex.en: He would always go out of his way to be friendly towards her.
ex.cn: 他总是特意向她表示友好。

senses.def: to do as you choose, especially when sb has advised you against it

ex.en: It's best to let her go her own way if you don't want a fight.
ex.cn: 你要不想吵架的话，最好是随她去好了。

senses.def: to travel in the same direction as sb

ex.en: I'm going your way—I'll walk with you.
ex.cn: 咱们同路，我和你一起走。

senses.def: to go well for you; to be in your favour

ex.en: By the third round he knew the fight was going his way.
ex.cn: 拳击打到第三回合，他知道形势对自己很有利。

senses.def: to die
used to say in an angry way that although you are not happy about sth that sb has said, you are not going to argue

ex.en: Oh OK, then. Have it your own way.
ex.cn: 啊，好啦。随你的便吧。

senses.def: to have what you want, especially by opposing other people
used to say that sth often happens in a particular way, especially when it is out of your control
senses.chn: …是常有的事（尤指无法控制的事）

ex.en: First love affairs have a way of not working out.
ex.cn: 第一次恋爱常常不成功。

senses.def: to be good at dealing with sb/sth
senses.chn: 善于应付；善于处理；有办法对付

ex.en: He has a way with small children.
ex.cn: 他很会逗小孩。

ex.en: She has a way with words (= is very good at expressing herself).
ex.cn: 她善于辞令。

senses.def: to have or want to have the advantages of two different situations or ways of behaving that are impossible to combine

ex.en: You can't have it both ways. If you can afford to go out all the time, you can afford to pay off some of your debts.
ex.cn: 你不可能做到两全其美。如果你有钱整天外出玩乐，就能还掉一部分债。

senses.def: to persuade sb to have sex with you
on a large/small scale

ex.en: The new delivery service has taken off in a big way.
ex.cn: 新的递送服务迅速走红。

ex.en: Many people are investing in a small way in the stock market.
ex.cn: 许多人都在小量地向证券市场投资。

senses.def: used to show that a statement has more than one meaning
senses.chn: （所说的话）不只一个意思；在很多方面

ex.en: With the first goal he used his head in more ways than one.
ex.cn: 他进第一个球时从多方面动了脑筋。

senses.def: in a manner that is appropriate to or typical of a person or thing but that may seem unusual to other people

ex.en: I expect she does love you in her own way.
ex.cn: 我想她的确是以她特有的方式爱你。

senses.def: to some extent; not completely
senses.chn: 在某种程度上；不完全地

ex.en: In a way it was one of our biggest mistakes.
ex.cn: 从某种意义上来说，这是我们所犯的最大错误之一。

senses.def: stopping sb from moving or doing sth

ex.en: You'll have to move—you're in my way.
ex.cn: 你得挪一挪，你挡了我的路。

ex.en: I left them alone, as I felt I was in the way.
ex.cn: 我留下他们单独在一起，因为我觉得我碍他们的事。

senses.def: used in questions and negative sentences to talk about the types of sth that are available
senses.chn: （用于问句或否定句）关于，就…而言

ex.en: There isn't much in the way of entertainment in this place.
ex.cn: 这个地方没有多少娱乐活动。

senses.def: to avoid sb
to deliberately avoid seeing sb/sth

ex.en: Prison officers know what's going on, but look the other way.
ex.cn: 狱警知道出了什么事，但扭过头去装作没看见。

senses.def: to become lost

ex.en: We lost our way in the dark.
ex.cn: 我们在黑暗中迷了路。

senses.def: to forget or move away from the purpose or reason for sth

ex.en: I feel that the project has lost its way.
ex.cn: 我觉得这个项目已经背离了原来的意图。

senses.def: to move or get somewhere; to make progress

ex.en: Will you be able to make your own way to the airport (= get there without help, a ride, etc.)?
ex.cn: 你能自己去机场吗？

ex.en: Is this your plan for making your way in the world?
ex.cn: 这就是你要出人头地的计划吗？

senses.def: to allow sb/sth to pass; to allow sb/sth to take the place of sb/sth
senses.chn: 让…通过；给…让路；让出位置

ex.en: Make way for the Lord Mayor!
ex.cn: 给市长大人让路！

ex.en: Tropical forest is felled to make way for grassland.
ex.cn: 热带森林被砍伐，腾出地方做草地。

senses.def: used to say that sb else has either to agree with your opinion or to leave
used to show that you are certain about sth

ex.en: It was the wrong decision—there are no two ways about it.
ex.cn: 这是错误的决定，毫无疑问。

senses.def: used to say that there is no possibility that you will do sth or that sth will happen
senses.chn: 不可能；决不；不行；没门儿

ex.en: 'Do you want to help?' 'No way!'
ex.cn: “你想帮忙吗？” “没门！”

ex.en: No way am I going to drive them there.
ex.cn: 我无论如何都不会开车把他们送到那里去。

ex.en: There's no way we could afford that sort of money.
ex.cn: 我们无论如何都花不起那种钱。

senses.def: going or coming
senses.chn: 即将去（或来）；就要去（或来）

ex.en: I'd better be on my way (= I must leave) soon.
ex.cn: 我最好还是快点儿走。

ex.en: The letter should be on its way to you.
ex.cn: 那封信该快到你那里了。

senses.def: during the journey

ex.en: He stopped for breakfast on the way.
ex.cn: 他中途停下吃早点。

ex.en: She grabbed her camera and bag on her way out.
ex.cn: 她出门时一把抓起照相机和提包。

senses.def: not yet born

ex.en: They've got three kids and one on the way.
ex.cn: 他们有三个孩子，还有一个尚未出生。

senses.def: in the opposite position, direction or order

ex.en: I think it should go on the other way round.
ex.cn: 我想这应该以相反的方式继续下去。

senses.def: the opposite situation

ex.en: I didn't leave you. It was the other way round (= you left me).
ex.cn: 我没有离开你。是你离开了我。

senses.def: no longer stopping sb from moving or doing sth

ex.en: I moved my legs out of the way so that she could get past.
ex.cn: 我挪开腿让她过去。

ex.en: I didn't say anything until Dad was out of the way.
ex.cn: 我直到爸爸不再打扰之后才说话。

senses.def: finished; dealt with

ex.en: Our region is poised for growth once the election is out of the way.
ex.cn: 大选一结束，我们地区就准备大展拳脚。

senses.def: used in negative sentences to mean 'unusual'
senses.chn: （用于否定句）奇特的，不寻常的，罕见的

ex.en: She had obviously noticed nothing out of the way.
ex.cn: 她显然没发现异常情况。

senses.def: not on the route that you planned to take

ex.en: I'd love a ride home—if it's not out of your way.
ex.cn: 我很想搭你的车回家，如果这不叫你绕路的话。

senses.def: to find that it is possible or convenient to do sth
senses.chn: 觉得有可能做某事；认为便于做某事

ex.en: Small builders cannot see their way clear to take on many trainees.
ex.cn: 小建筑商认为不可能招收很多见习生。

senses.def: to get an idea of what is likely to happen before doing sth
senses.chn: 看看风向；观察势头；摸清可能发生的情况

senses.def: to (not) prevent sb from doing sth

ex.en: If you believe you can make her happy, I won't stand in your way.
ex.cn: 如果你相信你能使她幸福，我不会妨碍你的。

senses.def: that is the situation and we cannot change it, so we must accept it
senses.chn: 情况就是这样；没有别的办法

senses.def: there are many different ways to achieve sth
senses.chn: （要做成某事）方法不只一个，有的是办法

senses.def: in my opinion
senses.chn: 我认为；依我看；依我之见

senses.def: having started

ex.en: Preparations are well under way for a week of special events in May.
ex.cn: 五月份特别活动周的准备工作已经顺利开展。

senses.def: the typical pattern of behaviour of a person or group
senses.chn: （个人或群体的）特有的行为模式，典型生活方式

ex.en: the American way of life
ex.cn: 美国人的生活方式

senses.def: the way that most people behave; the way that things happen, which you cannot change
senses.chn: 大多数人的行为模式；世道；事情发生的规律

ex.en: The rich and powerful make the decisions—that's the way of the world.
ex.cn: 有钱有势者说了算，这就是世道。

senses.def: the methods and materials available for doing sth
senses.chn: （做某事现有的）方法和资源，手段和财力

ex.en: ways and means of raising money
ex.cn: 筹资办法

senses.def: something that allows you to join a group of people, an industry, etc. that it is difficult to join, or to understand sth that it is difficult to understand
senses.chn: （加入难以进入的群体、行业等的）敲门砖；（弄懂难以理解的事物的）窍门，诀窍

senses.def: the way to make sb like or love you
senses.chn: 赢得某人喜爱的办法；攻心策

ex.en: The way to a man's heart is through his stomach (= by giving him good food).
ex.cn: 取得男人欢心的方法就是让他吃好。

senses.def: used to tell sb that you are pleased about sth they have done

ex.en: Good work, guys! Way to go!
ex.cn: 伙计们，活儿不错！干得好！

senses.def: to have a job or series of jobs while studying, travelling, etc. in order to pay for your education, etc.
senses.chn: 勤工俭学；半工半读；边挣钱边周游世界

senses.def: to do sth from beginning to end, especially when it takes a lot of time or effort
senses.chn: 自始至终做（尤指耗费时间或力量的事）

ex.en: She worked her way through the pile of documents.
ex.cn: 她从头至尾处理了那一堆文件。

senses.def: to move regularly to a more senior position in a company
senses.chn: 逐步升职；按部就班晋升

ex.en: He worked his way up from messenger boy to account executive.
ex.cn: 他从送信员一步一步晋升为客户经理。

senses.def: to start to live or behave in a different way from before
senses.chn: 开始过另一种生活；换个活法

senses.def: to gradually achieve sth or move somewhere by using a lot of determination and effort
senses.chn: 努力逐步获得；艰难地移动

ex.en: She clawed her way to the top of her profession.
ex.cn: 她努力不懈，终于爬到了职业的顶峰。

ex.en: Slowly, he clawed his way out from under the collapsed building.
ex.cn: 他艰难地从倒塌的大楼废墟底下慢慢爬了出来。

senses.def: to remove things that are stopping the progress or movement of sth

ex.en: The ruling could clear the way for extradition proceedings.
ex.cn: 这项裁决也许能为引渡程序铺平道路。

senses.def: to be easy compared to what came before

ex.en: It's all downhill from here. We'll soon be finished.
ex.cn: 从这以后就容易了。我们很快就会结束。

senses.def: to become worse or less successful
senses.chn: 每况愈下；走下坡路；不断恶化

ex.en: It's been all downhill for his career since then, with four defeats in five games.
ex.cn: 从那时起他的战绩便江河日下，五场比赛输掉了四场。

ex.en: I started work as a journalist and it was downhill all the way for my health.
ex.cn: 我开始当记者后，身体每况愈下。

senses.def: to end a difficult situation by choosing the simplest solution even if it is not the best one
senses.chn: 以最简单的方法解决难题；快刀斩乱麻

senses.def: to realize or admit that you have done sth wrong and decide to change your behaviour
senses.chn: 知过即改；承认自己的做法不对并决心改正

senses.def: (to be/become) pregnant
to move along carefully, for example when it is dark, by touching walls, objects, etc.
to be careful about how you do things, usually because you are in a situation that you are not familiar with

example.en: Everything seemed weighted against them.
example.cn: 一切似乎都与他们过不去。

example.en: The course is heavily weighted in favour of engineering.
example.cn: 这门课程非常侧重于工程学。

senses.def: extra money that you get paid for working in a particular area because it is expensive to live there
senses.chn: （发放给在生活费用高的地区工作的人的）额外津贴，生活补贴

senses.def: a value that you give to each of a number of things to show how important it is compared with the others

ex.en: Each of the factors is given a weighting on a scale of 1 to 10.
ex.cn: 每种因素按 1 至 10 之间的数值加权。

ex.en: Each question in the exam has equal weighting.
ex.cn: 考试中每道题的分值相等。

senses.def: having no weight or appearing to have no weight, for example because there is no gravity
senses.chn: 无重量的；似无重量的；失重的

ex.en: Astronauts work in weightless conditions.
ex.cn: 宇航员在失重的条件下工作。

senses.def: the sport or activity of lifting heavy weights
the combined power, strength or influence of a group
senses.chn: 人多势众；团队力量（或影响）

ex.en: They won the argument by sheer weight of numbers.
ex.cn: 他们纯粹靠人多势众在争论中获胜。

senses.def: important and serious

ex.en: weighty matters
ex.cn: 重大事情

senses.def: heavy

ex.en: a weighty volume/tome
ex.cn: 大部头书

senses.def: to choose your words carefully so that you say exactly what you mean
a low wall or barrier built across a river in order to control the flow of water or change its direction
very strange or unusual and difficult to explain
senses.chn: 奇异的；不寻常的；怪诞的

ex.en: a weird dream
ex.cn: 离奇的梦

ex.en: She's a really weird girl.
ex.cn: 她真是个古怪的女孩。

ex.en: He's got some weird ideas.
ex.cn: 他有些怪念头。

ex.en: It's really weird seeing yourself on television.
ex.cn: 看到自己上了电视感觉怪怪的。

ex.en: the weird and wonderful creatures that live beneath the sea
ex.cn: 奇异美丽的海底生物

senses.def: strange in a mysterious and frightening way

ex.en: She began to make weird inhuman sounds.
ex.cn: 她开始发出可怕的非人的声音。

senses.def: to seem strange or worrying to sb and make them feel uncomfortable
senses.chn: 使感到奇怪；使感到烦恼；使感到不舒服

ex.en: The whole concept really weirds me out.
ex.cn: 这整个想法让我觉得十分怪异。

senses.def: a person who looks strange and/or behaves in a strange way
to seem strange or worrying to sb and make them feel uncomfortable
senses.chn: 使感到奇怪；使感到烦恼；使感到不舒服

ex.en: The whole concept really weirds me out.
ex.cn: 这整个想法让我觉得十分怪异。

senses.def: to say hello to sb in a friendly way when they arrive somewhere

ex.en: They were at the door to welcome us.
ex.cn: 他们在门口迎接我们。

ex.en: a welcoming smile
ex.cn: 欢迎的微笑

ex.en: It is a pleasure to welcome you to our home.
ex.cn: 很高兴欢迎您光临舍下。

senses.def: to be pleased that sb has come or has joined an organization, activity, etc.

ex.en: They welcomed the new volunteers with open arms (= with enthusiasm).
ex.cn: 他们热烈欢迎这些新的志愿者。

senses.def: to be pleased to receive or accept sth

ex.en: I'd welcome any suggestions.
ex.cn: 任何建议我都会愉快地听取。

ex.en: I warmly welcome this decision.
ex.cn: 我热烈欢迎这一决定。

ex.en: In general, the changes they had made were to be welcomed.
ex.cn: 总的来说，他们所作的这些变动都会被欣然接受。

senses.def: that you are pleased to have, receive, etc.

ex.en: a welcome sight
ex.cn: 赏心悦目的景象

ex.en: Your letter was very welcome.
ex.cn: 很高兴收到你的信。

ex.en: The fine weather made a welcome change.
ex.cn: 天气转晴，令人心旷神怡。

senses.def: accepted or wanted somewhere

ex.en: Children are always welcome at the hotel.
ex.cn: 儿童在旅馆里总是受到款待。

ex.en: Our neighbours made us welcome as soon as we arrived.
ex.cn: 我们一到就受到了邻居们的欢迎。

ex.en: I had the feeling we were not welcome at the meeting.
ex.cn: 我有种感觉，人家并不欢迎我们参加这个会议。

senses.def: used to say that you are happy for sb to do sth if they want to
senses.chn: （表示乐于让某人做某事）可随意

ex.en: They're welcome to stay here as long as they like.
ex.cn: 他们在这里愿意住多久就住多久。

senses.def: used to say that you are very happy for sb to have sth because you definitely do not want it
senses.chn: （表示十分乐于让他人取去自己不想要的事物）尽管…好了

ex.en: It's an awful job. If you want it, you're welcome to it!
ex.cn: 这事真难办。你要是想做就交给你做好了！

senses.def: used as a polite reply when sb thanks you for sth

ex.en: 'Thanks for your help.' 'You're welcome.'
ex.cn: “多谢你的帮助。” “别客气。”

senses.def: something that you do or say to sb when they arrive, especially sth that makes them feel you are happy to see them

ex.en: Thank you for your warm welcome.
ex.cn: 感谢你们的热情接待。

ex.en: The winners were given an enthusiastic welcome when they arrived home.
ex.cn: 获胜者奏凯而归时受到了热烈欢迎。

ex.en: a speech/smile of welcome
ex.cn: 欢迎词；欢迎的微笑

ex.en: to receive a hero's welcome
ex.cn: 受到英雄般的欢迎

senses.def: the way that people react to sth, which shows their opinion of it
senses.chn: （表明看法的）反应方式，对待，接受

ex.en: This new comedy deserves a warm welcome.
ex.cn: 这出新喜剧值得受到热烈欢迎。

ex.en: The proposals were given a cautious welcome by the trade unions.
ex.cn: 这些建议得到了工会审慎的接受。

senses.def: to stay somewhere as a guest longer than you are wanted
senses.chn: 做客太久而不再受欢迎

senses.def: used as a greeting to tell sb that you are pleased that they are there

ex.en: Welcome home!
ex.cn: 欢迎归来！

ex.en: Welcome to Oxford!
ex.cn: 欢迎您来到牛津！

ex.en: Good evening everybody. Welcome to the show!
ex.cn: 诸位，晚上好。欢迎观看本次演出！

example.en: They were at the door to welcome us.
example.cn: 他们在门口迎接我们。

example.en: It is a pleasure to welcome you to our home.
example.cn: 很高兴欢迎您光临舍下。

senses.def: to make sb feel welcome; to try to attract visitors, etc.
senses.chn: 使感到受欢迎；设法吸引（客人等）

senses.def: a formal welcome to the traditional land of an Aboriginal people by one or more members of the local Aboriginal community
senses.chn: （澳大利亚由当地土著主持的）土著家园欢迎仪式

senses.def: friendly towards sb who is visiting or arriving
senses.chn: （对来访或到达的人）欢迎的，热情的，友好的

senses.def: attractive and looking comfortable to be in
senses.chn: 令人感到惬意的；舒适的

senses.def: to join pieces of metal together by heating their edges and pressing them together

ex.en: to weld a broken axle
ex.cn: 焊接一条断裂的轴

ex.en: The car has had a new wing welded on.
ex.cn: 这辆汽车焊上了一块新挡泥板。

ex.en: All the parts of the sculpture have to be welded together.
ex.cn: 这件雕塑所有的部件都必须焊接在一起。

senses.def: to unite people or things into a strong and effective group
senses.chn: 使紧密结合；使连成整体

ex.en: They had welded a bunch of untrained recruits into an efficient fighting force.
ex.cn: 他们把一群未经训练的新兵打造成了一支有战斗力的部队。

ex.en: The crisis helped to weld the party together.
ex.cn: 这场危机促使整个党紧密地团结在一起。

senses.def: a joint made by welding

example.en: to weld a broken axle
example.cn: 焊接一条断裂的轴

example.en: The car has had a new wing welded on.
example.cn: 这辆汽车焊上了一块新挡泥板。

example.en: All the parts of the sculpture have to be welded together.
example.cn: 这件雕塑所有的部件都必须焊接在一起。

example.en: They had welded a bunch of untrained recruits into an efficient fighting force.
example.cn: 他们把一群未经训练的新兵打造成了一支有战斗力的部队。

example.en: The crisis helped to weld the party together.
example.cn: 这场危机促使整个党紧密地团结在一起。

senses.def: a person whose job is welding metal
the general health, happiness and safety of a person, an animal or a group
senses.chn: （个体或群体的）幸福，福祉，安康

ex.en: We are concerned about the child's welfare.
ex.cn: 我们关注那个孩子的福祉。

senses.def: practical or financial help that is provided, often by the government, for people or animals that need it

ex.en: The state is still the main provider of welfare.
ex.cn: 政府仍然是福利的主要提供者。

ex.en: child welfare
ex.cn: 儿童福利

ex.en: a social welfare programme
ex.cn: 社会福利计划

ex.en: welfare provision/services/work
ex.cn: 福利供给／机构／工作

senses.def: money that the government pays regularly to people who are poor, unemployed, sick, etc.
senses.chn: 社会保障金（政府定期向贫穷、失业、患病等人员发放）

ex.en: They would rather work than live on welfare.
ex.cn: 他们更愿工作而不愿靠社会保障金过活。

senses.def: a system by which the government provides a range of free services to people who need them, for example medical care, money for people without work, care for old people, etc.
senses.chn: 福利制度（由政府向有需要的人提供各种免费服务，如医疗、失业救济金、对老人的照顾等）

senses.def: a country that has such a system
the sky or heaven
to make a very loud noise
we will
we shall
in a good, right or acceptable way

ex.en: The kids all behaved well.
ex.cn: 孩子们都很有礼貌。

ex.en: The conference was very well organized.
ex.cn: 这次会议组织得很好。

ex.en: Well done! (= expressing admiration for what sb has done)
ex.cn: 干得好！

ex.en: His campaign was not going well.
ex.cn: 他的竞选活动进展得不顺利。

ex.en: These animals make very good pets if treated well (= with kindness).
ex.cn: 这些动物若得到善待会成为很好的宠物。

ex.en: People spoke well of (= spoke with approval of) him.
ex.cn: 人们对他的评价很高。

senses.def: thoroughly and completely

ex.en: Add the lemon juice and mix well.
ex.cn: 加进柠檬汁并搅拌均匀。

ex.en: The surface must be well prepared before you start to paint.
ex.cn: 一定要把表面打磨好再开始油漆。

ex.en: How well do you know Carla?
ex.cn: 你对卡拉有多了解？

ex.en: He's well able to take care of himself.
ex.cn: 他完全能够自理。

ex.en: I was well annoyed, I can tell you.
ex.cn: 我跟你说吧，我那时气坏了。

senses.def: to a great extent or degree

ex.en: He was driving at well over the speed limit.
ex.cn: 他当时开车的速度远远超过了限制。

ex.en: a well-loved tale
ex.cn: 深受喜爱的故事

ex.en: The castle is well worth a visit.
ex.cn: 这座城堡很值得参观。

ex.en: He liked her well enough (= to a reasonable degree) but he wasn't going to make a close friend of her.
ex.cn: 他够喜欢她的，但并不打算和她结为密友。

senses.def: easily

ex.en: She could well afford to pay for it herself.
ex.cn: 她自己完全买得起。

senses.def: probably

ex.en: You may well be right.
ex.cn: 你很可能是对的。

ex.en: It may well be that the train is delayed.
ex.cn: 火车很可能晚点了。

senses.def: with good reason

ex.en: I can't very well leave now.
ex.cn: 我现在离开不太合适。

ex.en: I couldn't very well refuse to help them, could I?
ex.cn: 我没有理由拒绝帮助他们，是不是？

ex.en: 'What are we doing here?' ' You may well ask (= I don't really know either).'
ex.cn: “我们在这儿干什么呢？” “你算问对了（我也不知道）。”

senses.def: in addition to sb/sth; too

ex.en: Are they coming as well?
ex.cn: 他们也来吗？

ex.en: They sell books as well as newspapers.
ex.cn: 他们既卖报也卖书。

ex.en: She is a talented musician as well as being a photographer.
ex.cn: 她不但是个摄影师而且还是个天才的音乐家。

ex.en: I went to New York last year, and I also spent some time in Washington.
ex.cn: 我去年去了纽约，还在华盛顿待了些时间。

ex.en: 'I'm going home now.' 'I'll come too.'
ex.cn: “现在我要回家了。” “我也一起走。”

ex.en: She hasn't phoned and she hasn't written either.
ex.cn: 她没来过电话，也没有写信。

senses.def: to be getting healthier after an illness; to be in good health after a birth
senses.chn: （病后）康复，恢复良好；（产后）平安，健康

ex.en: Mother and baby are doing well.
ex.cn: 母子平安。

senses.def: if you are going to be punished for doing sth wrong, whether it is a big or small thing, you may as well do the big thing
senses.chn: 与其偷羊羔被绞死，不如偷只羊；一不做，二不休

senses.def: to have nearly achieved sth and be going to achieve it soon

ex.en: She is well on the way to recovery.
ex.cn: 她就要康复了。

ex.en: He is well on the way to establishing himself among the top ten players in the world.
ex.cn: 他很快就会成为排名世界前十位的选手。

senses.def: to be lucky that you are not involved in sth
senses.chn: 幸运地与…无关；幸亏没有卷入

senses.def: to know a lot about sth

ex.en: He's well up in all the latest developments.
ex.cn: 他对所有的最新发展情况都了如指掌。

senses.def: to be successful

ex.en: Jack is doing very well at school.
ex.cn: 杰克在学校里学习成绩斐然。

senses.def: to treat sb generously
to become successful or rich
to make a profit or get money from sb/sth
to be sensible or wise to do sth

ex.en: He would do well to concentrate more on his work.
ex.cn: 他最好还是更加集中精力在工作上。

ex.en: You did well to sell when the price was high.
ex.cn: 你在价钱高的时候出售，真明智。

senses.def: to not get involved in sth that does not concern you
senses.chn: 不管闲事；事不关己高高挂起

ex.en: When it comes to other people's arguments, it's better to leave well alone.
ex.cn: 遇到别人争论时，最好别插嘴。

senses.def: to do sth because it seems best in the situation that you are in, although you may not really want to do it
senses.chn: 做…倒也无妨；只好做（某事）

ex.en: If no one else wants it, we might as well give it to him.
ex.cn: 如果没人要这个，我们不妨给他吧。

senses.def: completely

ex.en: By that time we were well and truly lost.
ex.cn: 那时候我们已经完全迷路了。

senses.def: having made good progress

ex.en: If we got Terry to do that, we'd be well away.
ex.cn: 假若我们让特里干这事，我们就会有很大成绩。

senses.def: drunk or fast asleep
to be good friends with sb, especially sb important
senses.chn: 是某人（尤指要人）的好友

ex.en: She seems to be well in with all the right people.
ex.cn: 她似乎和所有大人物都关系很好。

senses.def: used to emphasize an angry statement or an order

ex.en: You can bloody well keep your job—I don't want it!
ex.cn: 你就继续干你那份臭工作吧，我才不稀罕呢！

senses.def: used to emphasize an angry statement or an order

ex.en: You're fucking well coming whether you want to or not.
ex.cn: 不管你想不想来，你他妈的也要给我过来。

senses.def: used to emphasize a statement when you are annoyed about sth
senses.chn: （生气时用以加强语气）当然，无疑，必然

ex.en: If you don't come now, you can jolly well walk home!
ex.cn: 你要是还不来，那就步行回家吧！

senses.def: used to criticize sb by saying that they should realize or understand sth
senses.chn: （用以批评）其实完全明白，哪会不知道，知道得很清楚

ex.en: You know as well as I do that you're being unreasonable.
ex.cn: 其实你完全明白你是在故意胡搅蛮缠。

senses.def: to be very aware of a fact and unable to deny or ignore it
senses.chn: 非常清楚；不可否认；不可忽视

ex.en: He knew full well what she thought of it.
ex.cn: 他非常清楚她对此事的看法。

senses.def: to have good intentions, although their effect may not be good
almost; almost completely

ex.en: One dog looks pretty much like another to me.
ex.cn: 在我看来，狗长得都差不多。

senses.def: in good health

ex.en: I don't feel very well.
ex.cn: 我觉得身体不太好。

ex.en: Is she well enough to travel?
ex.cn: 她身体怎么样，能够旅行吗？

ex.en: Get well soon! (= for example, on a card)
ex.cn: 愿早日康复！

ex.en: I'm better now, thank you.
ex.cn: 我现在好些了，谢谢您。

ex.en: He's not a well man.
ex.cn: 他身体不太好。

ex.en: I'm not feeling very well.
ex.cn: 我感觉身体不太好。

senses.def: in a good state or position

ex.en: It seems that all is not well at home.
ex.cn: 看来家中并非事事如意。

ex.en: All's well that ends well (= used when sth has ended happily, even though you thought it might not).
ex.cn: 结果好就算一切都好。

senses.def: sensible; a good idea

ex.en: It would be just as well to call and say we might be late.
ex.cn: 还是打个电话说一声我们可能到得晚些比较好。

ex.en: It would be well to start early.
ex.cn: 最好还是早点动身。

senses.def: used to criticize or reject a remark that sb has made, especially when they were trying to make you feel happier about sth
senses.chn: （用于批评或反驳）某人尽可做某事

ex.en: It's all very well for you to say it doesn't matter, but I've put a lot of work into this and I want it to be a success.
ex.cn: 你说这无所谓当然容易，可是我却已经花费很大力气而且想要取得成功。

senses.def: quite good but not exactly what is wanted
senses.chn: 好倒是好（但并不完全合乎心意）

ex.en: That's all well and good, but why didn't he call her to say so?
ex.cn: 那好倒是好，可是他为什么不给她打电话这样说呢？

senses.def: used to express surprise, anger or relief
senses.chn: （表示惊奇、愤怒或宽慰）哎呀，哟，啊，好啦

ex.en: Well, well —I would never have guessed it!
ex.cn: 哟，哟，我怎么也不会猜到那儿去！

ex.en: Well, really! What a thing to say!
ex.cn: 啊，真是的！这么说太不像话了！

ex.en: Well, thank goodness that's over!
ex.cn: 好啦，谢天谢地，这件事总算过去了！

senses.def: used to show that you accept that sth cannot be changed

ex.en: Well, it can't be helped.
ex.cn: 唉，这没有办法。

ex.en: 'We lost.' ' Oh, well. Better luck next time.'
ex.cn: “我们输了。” “啊，算了。愿下次交好运。”

senses.def: used to agree to sth, rather unwillingly

ex.en: Well, I suppose I could fit you in at 3.45.
ex.cn: 好吧，我想可以在 3:45 见你。

ex.en: Oh, very well, then, if you insist.
ex.cn: 啊，那好吧，如果你坚持的话。

senses.def: used when continuing a conversation after a pause

ex.en: Well, as I was saying…
ex.cn: 噢，我刚才是说…

senses.def: used to say that sth is uncertain

ex.en: 'Do you want to come?' 'Well, I'm not sure.'
ex.cn: “你想来吗？” “哦，我还说不准。”

senses.def: used to show that you are waiting for sb to say sth

ex.en: Well? Are you going to tell us or not?
ex.cn: 嗯？你想不想告诉我们？

senses.def: used to mark the end of a conversation

ex.en: Well, I'd better be going now.
ex.cn: 就这样，我现在该走了。

senses.def: used when you are pausing to consider your next words

ex.en: I think it happened, well, towards the end of last summer.
ex.cn: 我想事情发生在，对了，快到上个夏末的时候。

senses.def: used when you want to correct or change sth that you have just said
senses.chn: （纠正或改变刚说过的话时用）

ex.en: There were thousands of people there—well, hundreds, anyway.
ex.cn: 那里有数以千计的人，噢，至少几百人。

senses.def: used to express surprise
senses.chn: （表示惊奇）哟，我可从未做过（或听说过）这样的事

senses.def: I agree completely

ex.en: 'We must stand up for ourselves.' 'Well said, John.'
ex.cn: “我们必须自己起来保护自己。” “说得好，约翰。”

senses.def: a deep hole in the ground from which people obtain water. The sides of wells are usually covered with brick or stone and there is usually some covering or a small wall at the top of the well.
a narrow space in a building that drops down from a high to a low level and usually contains stairs or a lift/elevator
the space in front of the judge in a court, where the lawyers sit
to rise to the surface of sth and start to flow

ex.en: Tears were welling up in her eyes.
ex.cn: 她热泪盈眶。

senses.def: to become stronger

ex.en: Hate welled up inside him as he thought of the two of them together.
ex.cn: 他一想到他们俩在一起就恨得咬牙切齿。

senses.def: able to deal with people, problems and life in general in a normal, sensible way
senses.chn: 能适应环境的；能自如地待人接物的；稳重的

ex.en: You have to pay the full whack. There are no reductions.
ex.cn: 你得付全额。没有折扣。

ex.en: He charges top whack (= the highest amount possible).
ex.cn: 他索要最高价。

senses.def: no longer correct or working properly
senses.chn: 不对头；有毛病；运行不正常

ex.en: The system is clearly out of whack.
ex.cn: 这个系统明显是运行不正常。

ex.en: All the traveling had thrown my body out of whack.
ex.cn: 这一路旅行已经使我的身体出了毛病。

senses.def: not agreeing with or the same as sth else

ex.en: Expectations and reality got out of whack.
ex.cn: 期望和现实之间出现了差距。

senses.def: very tired

ex.en: I'm whacked!
ex.cn: 我累死了！

senses.def: used to emphasize how big or how much sth is
senses.chn: （强调体积或数额）巨大的，极大的

ex.en: a whacking great hole in the roof
ex.cn: 房顶上一个巨大的窟窿

ex.en: They were fined a whacking £100 000.
ex.cn: 他们被罚了 10 万英镑的巨款。

senses.def: crazy
a very large animal that lives in the sea and looks like a very large fish. There are several types of whale, some of which are hunted.

ex.en: whale meat
ex.cn: 鲸肉

senses.def: to enjoy yourself very much; to have a very good time
senses.chn: 玩得很痛快；过得非常快活

senses.def: a thin hard substance found in the upper jaw of some types of whale, used in the past to make some clothes stiffer
senses.chn: 鲸须，鲸骨（几种鲸上腭的角质薄片，旧时用以支撑衣服）

senses.def: a ship used for hunting whales
a person who hunts whales
the activity or business of hunting and killing whales
used to represent the sound of a sudden, loud hit

ex.en: The bombs went down—wham!—right on target.
ex.cn: 炸弹落了下来，砰！正好击中目标。

senses.def: used to show that sth that is unexpected has suddenly happened

ex.en: I saw him yesterday and—wham!—I realized I was still in love with him.
ex.cn: 我昨天看到他了。我猛地一下子意识到我仍然爱着他。

senses.def: an unpleasant situation or event that causes problems for sb/sth

ex.en: With this government we've had a double whammy of tax increases and benefit cuts.
ex.cn: 自从这任政府上台以来，我们又是增加税收又是减少补贴，倒了双倍的霉。

senses.def: a family or community of related families who live together in the same area
senses.chn: （生活在同一地区的）大家庭，家族

senses.def: a flat structure built beside the sea or a river where boats can be tied up and goods unloaded
used in questions to ask for particular information about sb/sth

ex.en: What is your name?
ex.cn: 你叫什么名字？

ex.en: What (= what job) does he do?
ex.cn: 他是做什么工作的？

ex.en: What time is it?
ex.cn: 现在什么时候了？

ex.en: What kind of music do you like?
ex.cn: 你喜欢什么音乐？

senses.def: the thing or things that; whatever
senses.chn: …的事物；无论什么；凡是…的事物

ex.en: What you need is a good meal.
ex.cn: 你需要的是一顿美餐。

ex.en: Nobody knows what will happen next.
ex.cn: 没有人知道接下来将会发生什么事。

ex.en: I spent what little time I had with my family.
ex.cn: 我仅有的一点儿时间都和家人在一起度过了。

senses.def: used to say that you think that sth is especially good, bad, etc.

ex.en: What awful weather!
ex.cn: 天气太糟糕了！

ex.en: What a beautiful house!
ex.cn: 多么漂亮的房子啊！

senses.def: and other things of the same type
senses.chn: 以及其他同样的东西；诸如此类

ex.en: It's full of old toys, books and what not.
ex.cn: 这里全都是旧玩具、书籍，以及诸如此类的东西。

senses.def: to be punished/punish sb severely
senses.chn: （受到）严惩；（被）痛打一顿，申斥一顿

ex.en: I'll give her what for if she does that again.
ex.cn: 她若再这样做，看我怎么收拾她。

senses.def: used to emphasize your opinion

ex.en: Is he stupid or what?
ex.cn: 他真是傻透了。

senses.def: used when you are not sure about sth

ex.en: I don't know if he's a teacher or what.
ex.cn: 我不知道他是个教师还是别的什么。

ex.en: Are we going now or what?
ex.cn: 我们现在走还是不走？

senses.def: used when you have not heard or have not understood sth

ex.en: What? I can't hear you.
ex.cn: 什么？我听不见你说话。

senses.def: used to show that you have heard sb and to ask what they want
senses.chn: （听到对方的话并问他们要什么）什么事，要什么

ex.en: 'Mummy!' 'What?' 'I'm thirsty.'
ex.cn: “妈咪！” “什么事？” “我渴。”

senses.def: used to express surprise or anger
senses.chn: （惊讶或愤怒时说）什么，竟有这种事，真的

ex.en: 'It will cost $500.' 'What?'
ex.cn: “这东西要花 500 美元。” “真的？”

ex.en: 'I asked her to marry me.' ' You what? '
ex.cn: “我向她求婚了。” “你说什么？”

senses.def: used to make a suggestion

ex.en: What about a trip to France?
ex.cn: 到法国去旅游一趟如何？

senses.def: used to introduce sb/sth into the conversation

ex.en: What about you, Joe? Do you like football?
ex.cn: 你呢，乔？你喜欢足球吗？

senses.def: used instead of a name that you cannot remember
senses.chn: （记不得名字时说）你叫他（或她、它、他们）什么来着

ex.en: She's just gone out with old what-d'you-call-him.
ex.cn: 她刚和老…，你叫他什么来着，一块儿出去的。

senses.def: for what purpose or reason?

ex.en: What is this tool for?
ex.cn: 这个工具是干什么用的？

ex.en: What did you do that for (= why did you do that)?
ex.cn: 你为何做那事？

ex.en: 'I need to see a doctor.' 'What for?'
ex.cn: “我得去看医生。” “看什么病？”

senses.def: what would happen if?

ex.en: What if the train is late?
ex.cn: 火车要是晚点会怎么样呢？

ex.en: What if she forgets to bring it?
ex.cn: 要是她忘记带来，会怎么样呢？

senses.def: used when admitting that sth is true, to ask why it should be considered important
senses.chn: （承认某事属实，想知道为何重要）那又怎么样呢，那有什么关系呢

ex.en: Yes, I wrote the article. What of it?
ex.cn: 是的，文章是我写的。那又怎么样呢？

senses.def: used to suggest that sth you have heard is a stupid idea or does not make sense
senses.chn: 怎么回事（表示听到的话愚蠢或无聊）

ex.en: They dropped their best player. What's up with that?
ex.cn: 他们弃用了最佳队员。怎么回事？

senses.def: what things are useful, important, etc.
senses.chn: 什么事物有用（或重要等）

ex.en: She certainly knows what's what.
ex.cn: 她当然知道轻重缓急。

senses.def: used to ask why sb is behaving in a strange way
senses.chn: （询问某人为何行为古怪）…怎么啦

ex.en: What's with you? You haven't said a word all morning.
ex.cn: 你怎么啦？整个上午你一句话都没说。

senses.def: used to ask the reason for sth

ex.en: What's with all this walking? Can't we take a cab?
ex.cn: 怎么就这么一直走？难道我们就不能打辆出租车吗？

senses.def: used to list the various reasons for sth

ex.en: What with the cold weather and my bad leg, I haven't been out for weeks.
ex.cn: 由于天气很冷，我的腿又不好，我已经好几个星期没有出门了。

senses.def: used when you cannot think of the name of sth
senses.chn: （想不起名称时说）叫什么来着

ex.en: Have you got a whatchamacallit? You know… a screwdriver?
ex.cn: 你有一把…叫什么来着的？嗯…螺丝刀吗？

senses.def: any or every; anything or everything
senses.chn: 任何；每一；任何事物；一切事物

ex.en: Take whatever action is needed.
ex.cn: 采取任何必要的行动。

ex.en: Do whatever you like.
ex.cn: 你喜欢做什么就做什么。

senses.def: used when you are saying that it does not matter what sb does or what happens, because the result will be the same
senses.chn: （表示做什么或发生什么都没关系，因结果都一样）无论什么，不管什么

ex.en: Whatever decision he made I would support it.
ex.cn: 无论他作出什么决定我都会支持的。

ex.en: You have our support, whatever you decide.
ex.cn: 不管你作何决定，都会得到我们的支持。

senses.def: used in questions to express surprise or confusion
senses.chn: （用于问句，表示惊讶或困惑）到底是什么，究竟是什么

ex.en: Whatever do you mean?
ex.cn: 你究竟是什么意思？

ex.en: Chocolate-flavoured carrots! Whatever next?
ex.cn: 巧克力味的胡萝卜！接下来到底还想吃什么？

senses.def: used as a reply to tell sb that you do not care what happens or that you are not interested in what they are talking about
senses.chn: （用于回应，表示不在乎或不感兴趣）或许吧，无所谓

ex.en: 'You should try a herbal remedy.' 'Yeah, whatever.'
ex.cn: “你应该试一试草药疗法。” “是啊，或许吧。”

senses.def: used to say that you do not mind what you do, have, etc. and that anything is acceptable
senses.chn: （表示不在乎，什么都可接受）什么都可以

ex.en: 'What would you like to do today?' 'Whatever.'
ex.cn: “今天你想做什么呢？” “做什么都可以。”

senses.def: or sth of a similar type

ex.en: It's the same in any situation: in a prison, hospital or whatever.
ex.cn: 这在什么场合都一样：在监狱、医院或诸如此类的地方。

senses.def: used to warn sb not to do sth under any circumstances
senses.chn: （警告某人绝不要做某事）无论如何

ex.en: Don't tell Paul, whatever you do!
ex.cn: 无论如何都不要告诉保罗！

senses.def: not at all; not of any kind
senses.chn: 一点儿都（不）；丝毫（不）；什么都（没有）

ex.en: They received no help whatever.
ex.cn: 他们没有得到一点儿帮助。

ex.en: 'Is there any doubt about it?' 'None whatsoever.'
ex.cn: “对此有怀疑吗？” “丝毫没有。”

senses.def: used to say that it does not matter what sb does, or what happens, because the result will be the same

ex.en: We told him we'd back him whatever.
ex.cn: 我们告诉他，在任何情况下我们都会支持他。

senses.def: used to warn sb not to do sth under any circumstances
senses.chn: （警告某人绝不要做某事）无论如何

ex.en: Don't tell Paul, whatever you do!
ex.cn: 无论如何都不要告诉保罗！

senses.def: used to agree to sb's suggestion because you do not want to argue
senses.chn: （因不想争论而同意）由你，随你

senses.def: whatever
senses.chn: 无所谓；什么都可以；诸如此类

ex.en: I don't even really care. Well, okay, I do, but whatevs.
ex.cn: 我不怎么在乎。好吧，我有点在乎，但随便啦。

ex.en: It's made with about 100 gms raw nuts (cashew or whatev), 2 handfuls dates, carob or cocoa to taste.
ex.cn: 它是用约 100 克生坚果（腰果或类似的坚果）做成的，再按口味加两把椰枣、角豆或可可粉。

senses.def: the way sb behaves towards other people will affect the way those people behave towards them in the future
senses.chn: 你怎么待人，人就怎么待你

senses.def: something that is not fashionable now will become fashionable again in the future
senses.chn: 现在过时的还会再时兴起来

senses.def: other things, people, etc. of the same kind
senses.chn: 诸如此类的事物（或人等）

ex.en: There's room in the cellar to store old furniture and what have you.
ex.cn: 地下室有地方存放旧家具之类的东西。

senses.def: used to add a point that is even more important
senses.chn: 更有甚者；更为重要的是

ex.en: You're wrong, and what's more you know it!
ex.cn: 你错了！而且你明明知道你错了！

ex.en: Bilingual children do better in IQ tests than children who speak only one language. In addition / What is more, they seem to find it easier to learn third or even fourth languages.
ex.cn: 讲两种语言的儿童比只讲一种语言的儿童智商测试得分更高。此外／而且，讲两种语言的儿童似乎在学习第三种甚至第四种语言时觉得更容易。

ex.en: Learning another language not only improves children's job prospects in later life, but also boosts their self-esteem.
ex.cn: 学习另一种语言不仅可以提升儿童未来的职业前景，而且可以增强他们的自尊心。

ex.en: Teaching children a second language improves their job prospects in later life. Other benefits include increased self-esteem and greater tolerance of other cultures.
ex.cn: 教儿童第二语言可以提升他们未来的职业前景。此外，还可以使他们获得更强的自尊心、对其他文化更包容。

ex.en: Another / One further / One additional reason for encouraging bilingual education is that it boosts children's self-esteem.
ex.cn: 另一个鼓励双语教育的原因是它能增强儿童的自尊心。

ex.en: Studies suggest that bilingual children find it easier to learn additional languages. There is, moreover, increasing evidence that bilingual children perform better across a range of school subjects, not just foreign languages.
ex.cn: 研究表明，讲两种语言的儿童学习其他语言觉得更容易。此外，越来越多的证据表明，讲两种语言的儿童不仅在外语学习上，同时在其他各门学科的学习上都表现得更好。

senses.def: what makes sb behave in the way that they do

ex.en: I've never really understood what makes her tick.
ex.cn: 我从未真正弄懂她为什么这么做。

senses.def: used when you are referring to sth, but are not being exact and do not mention its name
senses.chn: （由于拿不准而不指名）某种东西，不可名状的东西

ex.en: It's a new firm. They make toys and whatnot.
ex.cn: 这是家新的公司。他们制作玩具和别的小玩意儿。

senses.def: the thing sb is trying to say
senses.chn: 某人的用意；某人话中的意思

ex.en: I wish I knew what they were driving at.
ex.cn: 我要是知道他们的用意就好了。

senses.def: how sb reacts in a difficult situation
senses.chn: 某人有多厉害（在困境中表现出来的应对能力）

senses.def: used when you cannot think of the word or name you want, or do not want to use a particular word
senses.chn: （想不起名称或不想指明时说）什么来着，某某玩意儿

ex.en: I've got to make a whatsit for the party. That's it—a flan.
ex.cn: 我得给聚会制作一个什么东西来着。想起来了，一个果馅饼。

senses.def: what things are useful, important, etc.
senses.chn: 什么事物有用（或重要等）

ex.en: She certainly knows what's what.
ex.cn: 她当然知道轻重缓急。

senses.def: used to list the various reasons for sth

ex.en: What with the cold weather and my bad leg, I haven't been out for weeks.
ex.cn: 由于天气很冷，我的腿又不好，我已经好几个星期没有出门了。

senses.def: a plant grown for its grain that is used to produce the flour for bread, cakes, pasta, etc.; the grain of this plant

ex.en: wheat flour
ex.cn: 小麦制的面粉

senses.def: to distinguish useful or valuable people or things from ones that are not useful or have no value
senses.chn: 识别优劣；分清好坏；去芜存菁

senses.def: the centre of the wheat grain, which is especially good for your health
(of a person's skin or face) light brown or pale gold, like wheat that is fully grown and ready to be picked
senses.chn: （人的皮肤或脸）浅棕色的，淡金色的，小麦色的

ex.en: He has a wheatish complexion.
ex.cn: 他面色是小麦色。

senses.def: a type of flour made from wheat, that uses more of the grain than white flour
used to express excitement
to persuade sb to give you sth or do sth by saying nice things that you do not mean

ex.en: The kids can always wheedle money out of their father.
ex.cn: 孩子们总是能从父亲那里哄出钱来。

ex.en: She wheedled me into lending her my new coat.
ex.cn: 她用花言巧语哄我把新大衣借给了她。

ex.en: 'Come on, Em,' he wheedled.
ex.cn: “快点，爱玛。” 他哄道。

example.en: The kids can always wheedle money out of their father.
example.cn: 孩子们总是能从父亲那里哄出钱来。

example.en: She wheedled me into lending her my new coat.
example.cn: 她用花言巧语哄我把新大衣借给了她。

example.en: 'Come on, Em,' he wheedled.
example.cn: “快点，爱玛。” 他哄道。

senses.def: one of the round objects under a car, bicycle, bus, etc. that turns when it moves

ex.en: He braked suddenly, causing the front wheels to skid.
ex.cn: 他猛然刹车，使得前车轮打滑了。

ex.en: One of the boys was pushing the other along in a little box on wheels.
ex.cn: 一个男孩用下面装着轮子的小箱子推着另一个男孩。

senses.def: the round object used to steer a car, etc. or ship
senses.chn: （汽车等的）方向盘；（轮船的）舵轮

ex.en: This is the first time I've sat behind the wheel since the accident.
ex.cn: 这是出车祸以来我头一次坐在方向盘前。

ex.en: A car swept past with Laura at the wheel.
ex.cn: 劳拉驱车疾驰而过。

ex.en: Do you want to take the wheel (= drive) now?
ex.cn: 你现在想开车吗？

senses.def: a car

ex.en: At last he had his own wheels.
ex.cn: 他终于有了自己的汽车。

senses.def: a flat round part in a machine

ex.en: gear wheels
ex.cn: 齿轮

senses.def: an organization or a system that seems to work like a complicated machine that is difficult to understand
senses.chn: 错综复杂的机构（或系统）

ex.en: the wheels of bureaucracy/commerce/government, etc.
ex.cn: 复杂的官僚、商务、政府等机构

ex.en: It was Rob's idea. I merely set the wheels in motion (= started the process).
ex.cn: 这是罗布的主意。我只不过是让它运作起来而已。

senses.def: having the number or type of wheels mentioned

ex.en: a sixteen-wheeled lorry
ex.cn: 十六轮大卡车

senses.def: a car, bicycle, etc. with the number of wheels mentioned
senses.chn: 有…轮子的汽车（或自行车等）

ex.en: a three-wheeler
ex.cn: 三轮机动车

senses.def: a situation which is difficult to understand because it involves complicated or secret processes and decisions

ex.en: There are wheels within wheels in this organization—you never really know what is going on.
ex.cn: 这个机构里错综复杂，你永远搞不清到底是怎么回事。

senses.def: a person who is a small part of a large organization
to help sth to happen easily and without problems, especially in business or politics
senses.chn: （尤指在商业上或政治上）起促进作用

senses.def: to help sth to happen easily and without problems, especially in business or politics
senses.chn: （尤指在商业上或政治上）起促进作用

senses.def: to waste time creating sth that already exists and works well
senses.chn: 重复发明；无谓地重复；浪费时间做无用功

senses.def: to start working very hard at a particular task
senses.chn: 着手大干起来；全力以赴

senses.def: to prevent sb from putting their plans into operation
senses.chn: 破坏某人的计划；阻挠某人实行计划

senses.def: to push or pull sth that has wheels

ex.en: She wheeled her bicycle across the road.
ex.cn: 她推着自行车穿过了马路。

senses.def: to move sb/sth that is in or on sth that has wheels
senses.chn: 用有轮之物推动（或拉动、移动）…

ex.en: The nurse wheeled him along the corridor.
ex.cn: 护士推着他沿楼道走。

senses.def: to move or fly in a circle

ex.en: Birds wheeled above us in the sky.
ex.cn: 鸟儿在我们上空盘旋。

senses.def: to turn quickly or suddenly and face the opposite direction; to make sb/sth do this

ex.en: She wheeled around and started running.
ex.cn: 她突然转身就跑。

ex.en: He wheeled his horse back to the gate.
ex.cn: 他突然掉转马头返回到大门。

senses.def: to do a lot of complicated deals in business or politics, often in a dishonest way
senses.chn: （在商界或政界）工于心计；（以不正当的方式）进行纷繁复杂的交易，周旋

senses.def: to show or use sth to help you do sth, even when it has often been seen or heard before

ex.en: They wheeled out the same old arguments we'd heard so many times before.
ex.cn: 他们又弹起了我们听过多次的老调。

senses.def: to do a lot of complicated deals in business or politics, often in a dishonest way
senses.chn: （在商界或政界）工于心计；（以不正当的方式）进行纷繁复杂的交易，周旋

senses.def: a space in the body of a vehicle over a wheel, shaped like an arch
a large open container with a wheel and two handles that you use outside to carry things
the distance between the front and back wheels of a car or other vehicle
senses.chn: （汽车或其他机动车辆的）轴距；（机车的）轮组定距

senses.def: a special chair with wheels, used by people who cannot walk because of illness, an accident, etc.

ex.en: Does the hotel have wheelchair access?
ex.cn: 这家旅馆有轮椅通道吗？

ex.en: He's been confined to a wheelchair since the accident.
ex.cn: 他从那次出事以后就离不开轮椅了。

ex.en: wheelchair users
ex.cn: 坐轮椅的人

senses.def: a person who does a lot of complicated deals in business or politics, often in a dishonest way
senses.chn: （商界或政界的）工于心计的人，进行复杂交易的人

senses.def: a small cabin with walls and a roof on a ship where the person steering stands at the wheel
a trick that you can do on a bicycle or motorcycle by balancing on the back wheel, with the front wheel off the ground
senses.chn: （骑自行车或摩托车将前轮抬起的）后轮支撑车技

ex.en: to do a wheelie
ex.cn: 做后轮支撑的特技

senses.def: a large container with a lid and wheels, that you keep outside your house and use for putting rubbish in
a situation which is difficult to understand because it involves complicated or secret processes and decisions

ex.en: There are wheels within wheels in this organization—you never really know what is going on.
ex.cn: 这个机构里错综复杂，你永远搞不清到底是怎么回事。

senses.def: a person whose job is making and repairing wheels, especially wooden ones
senses.chn: 车轮修造工（尤指木轮的）

senses.def: to breathe noisily and with difficulty

ex.en: He was coughing and wheezing all night.
ex.cn: 他整夜又咳嗽又喘。

ex.en: 'I have a chest infection,' she wheezed.
ex.cn: “我胸部受到了感染。” 她呼哧呼哧地说。

senses.def: the high whistling sound that your chest makes when you cannot breathe easily
senses.chn: 喘息声；喘鸣声；呼吸发出的哨音；呼哧呼哧声

senses.def: a clever trick or plan

example.en: 'I have a chest infection,' she wheezed.
example.cn: “我胸部受到了感染。” 她呼哧呼哧地说。

senses.def: making the high whistling sound that your chest makes when you cannot breathe easily
senses.chn: 喘息的；喘鸣的；气喘吁吁的；呼哧呼哧响的

ex.en: I'm wheezy today.
ex.cn: 我今天感到喘不上气来。

ex.en: a wheezy cough
ex.cn: 喘鸣性咳

senses.def: a small shellfish that can be eaten
a young animal of the dog family; a puppy or cub
senses.chn: 小狗；幼犬；（犬科动物的）幼兽

senses.def: to give birth to a puppy or puppies
at what time; on what occasion
senses.chn: 什么时候；何时；什么情况下；什么场合下

ex.en: When did you last see him?
ex.cn: 你上次什么时候见到他的？

ex.en: When can I see you?
ex.cn: 我什么时候可以见你？

ex.en: When (= in what circumstances) would such a solution be possible?
ex.cn: 什么情况下可以这么解决？

senses.def: used after an expression of time to mean 'at which' or 'on which'
senses.chn: （用于时间的表达方式之后）在那时，其时

ex.en: Sunday is the only day when I can relax.
ex.cn: 星期日是我唯一可以休息的日子。

ex.en: There are times when I wonder why I do this job.
ex.cn: 有时候我也不明白自己为什么要干这个工作。

senses.def: at which time; on which occasion

ex.en: The last time I went to Scotland was in May, when the weather was beautiful.
ex.cn: 我上次去苏格兰是在五月份，那时的天气好极了。

senses.def: what/which time

ex.en: Until when can you stay?
ex.cn: 你可以待到什么时候？

ex.en: 'I've got a new job.' 'Since when?'
ex.cn: “我有了份新工作。” “什么时候开始的？”

senses.def: at or during the time that

ex.en: I loved history when I was at school.
ex.cn: 我上学时喜欢历史。

senses.def: after

ex.en: Call me when you've finished.
ex.cn: 你完成后就打电话给我。

senses.def: at any time that; whenever

ex.en: Can you spare five minutes when it's convenient?
ex.cn: 方便时能占用你五分钟时间吗？

senses.def: just after which

ex.en: He had just drifted off to sleep when the phone rang.
ex.cn: 他刚睡着电话铃就响了。

senses.def: considering that

ex.en: How can they expect to learn anything when they never listen?
ex.cn: 既然他们从不听讲，他们怎么能指望学到东西呢？

senses.def: although

ex.en: She claimed to be 18, when I know she's only 16.
ex.cn: 她自称是 18 岁，可是我知道她才 16 岁。

senses.def: used to say that sth may happen at some time in the future, but only when sth else has happened
senses.chn: （用于在特定条件下才会发生的事情）将来…时，到时候

ex.en: We'll decide on the team as and when we qualify.
ex.cn: 将来我们具备了条件时就会决定成立这个队。

ex.en: I'll tell you more as and when (= as soon as I can).
ex.cn: 我一有可能就会告诉你更多情况。

when all is said and done.lemma: when all is said and done

senses.def: when everything is considered

ex.en: I know you're upset, but when all's said and done it isn't exactly a disaster.
ex.cn: 我知道你挺沮丧的，但说到底，事情并没什么大不了的。

senses.def: from where

ex.en: They returned whence they had come.
ex.cn: 他们从哪里来又回到哪里去了。

senses.def: at any time that; on any occasion that
senses.chn: 在任何…的时候；无论何时；在任何…的情况下

ex.en: You can ask for help whenever you need it.
ex.cn: 你如果需要帮助随时可以提出来。

senses.def: every time that

ex.en: Whenever she comes, she brings a friend.
ex.cn: 她每次来都带着个朋友。

ex.en: The roof leaks whenever it rains.
ex.cn: 屋顶每逢下雨就漏。

ex.en: We try to help whenever possible.
ex.cn: 只要有可能我们都尽量帮忙。

senses.def: used when the time when sth happens is not important
senses.chn: 别的什么时候（也可以）；任何时间（都行）

ex.en: 'When do you need it by?' 'Saturday or Sunday. Whenever.'
ex.cn: “你什么时候需要这个东西？” “星期六或星期日。哪一天都行。”

ex.en: It's not urgent—we can do it next week or whenever.
ex.cn: 这不着急，我们可以在下星期或别的什么时候做。

senses.def: used in questions to mean 'when', expressing surprise
senses.chn: （用于问句，表示惊奇）究竟什么时候

ex.en: Whenever did you find time to do all that cooking?
ex.cn: 你怎么有时间做了这么多菜？

senses.def: when there is no other choice; when everything else has failed
senses.chn: 别无选择时；须孤注一掷时

senses.def: when the trouble that you are expecting begins
senses.chn: 意料中的麻烦出现时；（不出所料）出乱子时

when the cat's away the mice will play.lemma: when the cat's away the mice will play

senses.def: people enjoy themselves more and behave with greater freedom when the person in charge of them is not there
senses.chn: 猫儿不在，老鼠玩得自在（指管事的不在，下面的玩个痛快）

senses.def: used to refer to a difficult situation in which you are forced to decide what is important to you
senses.chn: 在危急关头；在关键时刻

ex.en: I'm not sure what I'll do when the chips are down.
ex.cn: 我拿不准到了关键时刻我会干出些什么事来。

when the shit hits the fan.lemma: when the shit hits the fan

senses.def: when sb in authority finds out about sth bad or wrong that sb has done
senses.chn: 做了坏事（或错事）被发现

ex.en: When the shit hits the fan, I don't want to be here.
ex.cn: 事情一旦败露，我就不想待在这儿了。

senses.def: in or to what place or situation
senses.chn: 在哪里；到哪里；处于哪种情形

ex.en: Where do you live?
ex.cn: 你住在哪儿？

ex.en: I wonder where they will take us to.
ex.cn: 我不知道他们要把我们带到哪里去。

ex.en: Where (= at what point) did I go wrong in my calculations?
ex.cn: 我计算中什么地方出了差错？

ex.en: Where (= in what book, newspaper, etc.) did you read that?
ex.cn: 你在哪儿读到这个的？

ex.en: Just where (= to what situation or final argument) is all this leading us?
ex.cn: 这一切到底是要将我们引向何处？

senses.def: used after words or phrases that refer to a place or situation to mean 'at, in or to which'
senses.chn: （用于表示地点或情况的词语后）在那（地方），到那（地方）

ex.en: It's one of the few countries where people drive on the left.
ex.cn: 这是为数不多的几个靠左行驶的国家之一。

senses.def: the place or situation in which
senses.chn: 在那里；在该处；在该情况下

ex.en: We then moved to Paris, where we lived for six years.
ex.cn: 我们随后移居巴黎，在那里住了六年。

senses.def: (in) the place or situation in which

ex.en: This is where I live.
ex.cn: 这是我住的地方。

ex.en: Sit where I can see you.
ex.cn: 坐在我能看到你的地方。

ex.en: Where people were concerned, his threshold of boredom was low.
ex.cn: 涉及人的事情，他便极易感到厌烦。

ex.en: That's where (= the point in the argument at which) you're wrong.
ex.cn: 这就是你的错误所在。

senses.def: the place where sb/sth is
senses.chn: （人或物）所在的地方；下落；行踪

ex.en: His whereabouts are/is still unknown.
ex.cn: 他仍下落不明。

senses.def: used to ask the general area where sb/sth is
senses.chn: （用以询问大概的地方）在什么地方，在哪里

ex.en: Whereabouts did you find it?
ex.cn: 你在哪儿找到它的？

senses.def: used to compare or contrast two facts
senses.chn: （用以比较或对比两个事实）然而，但是，尽管

ex.en: Some of the studies show positive results, whereas others do not.
ex.cn: 有一些研究结果令人满意，然而其他的则不然。

ex.en: This survey highlights a number of differences in the way that teenage boys and girls in the UK spend their free time.
ex.cn: 这项民意测验凸显出英国十几岁的男孩和女孩在打发闲暇时间上的诸多不同。

ex.en: One of the main differences between the girls and the boys who took part in the research was the way in which they use the Internet.
ex.cn: 参与了这项研究的女生和男生之间的主要差异之一在于他们使用互联网的方式。

ex.en: Unlike the girls, who use the Internet mainly to keep in touch with friends, the boys questioned in this survey tend to use the Internet for playing computer games.
ex.cn: 女生使用互联网主要是和朋友联系，这一点和男生不同，参与调查的男生往往是使用互联网来玩电脑游戏。

ex.en: The girls differ from the boys in that they tend to spend more time keeping in touch with friends on the telephone or on social networking websites.
ex.cn: 与男生不同的是，女生往往花更多的时间通过电话或社交网站与朋友保持联系。

ex.en: Compared to the boys, the girls spend much more time chatting to friends on the telephone.
ex.cn: 与男生相比，女生花在与朋友电话聊天上的时间要多得多。

senses.def: used at the beginning of a sentence in an official document to mean 'because of the fact that…'
senses.chn: （用于正式文件中句子的开头）鉴于

senses.def: by which; because of which

ex.en: They have introduced a new system whereby all employees must undergo regular training.
ex.cn: 他们采用了新的制度，所有的雇员都必须定期培训。

senses.def: the reasons for sth

ex.en: I had no intention of going into the whys and the wherefores of the situation.
ex.cn: 我无意深入调查这一情况的来龙去脉。

senses.def: in which place, situation or thing; in what way
senses.chn: 其中；在那里；在那种情况下；以什么方式

ex.en: Wherein lies the difference between conservatism and liberalism?
ex.cn: 保守主义和自由主义的区别在哪里？

senses.def: a place or an activity that is very popular or fashionable
senses.chn: 盛大活动（场合）；流行活动（地方）

ex.en: Judging by the crowds waiting to get in, this seems to be where it's at.
ex.cn: 从等待入场的人群来看，这好像是个盛大活动。

senses.def: of what or which

ex.en: I know whereof I speak (= I know a lot about what I am talking about).
ex.cn: 我知道自己在说些什么。

senses.def: somebody's ideas, beliefs, personality, etc. that makes them say what they have said
senses.chn: （决定某人言论的）某人的全部背景

ex.en: I see where you're coming from (= I understand what you mean).
ex.cn: 我明白你究竟是什么意思。

where there's a will there's a way.lemma: where there's a will there's a way

senses.def: if you really want to do sth then you will find a way of doing it
used to say that a business activity that is unpleasant or dirty can bring in a lot of money
senses.chn: 哪儿有脏活哪儿有钱赚；要挣大钱就别怕脏

where the rubber meets the road.lemma: where the rubber meets the road

senses.def: the point at which sth is tested and you really find out whether it is successful or true
senses.chn: 接受考验的时刻；检验成败的时刻；检验真伪的时刻

ex.en: Here's where the rubber meets the road: will consumers actually buy the product?
ex.cn: 检验成败的时刻到了：消费者真的会购买这种产品吗？

senses.def: and then; as a result of this
senses.chn: 然后；于是；随之；据此；因此

ex.en: He told her she was a liar, whereupon she walked out.
ex.cn: 他对她说她在说谎，她便愤然而去。

senses.def: in any place

ex.en: Sit wherever you like.
ex.cn: 你爱坐在哪儿就坐哪儿。

ex.en: He comes from Boula, wherever that may be (= I don't know where it is).
ex.cn: 他的原籍是布拉，管它在什么地方呢。

senses.def: in all places that
senses.chn: 在…的各个地方；各处；处处

ex.en: Wherever she goes, there are crowds of people waiting to see her.
ex.cn: 她所到之处都有成群的人等着见她。

senses.def: in all cases that

ex.en: Use wholegrain breakfast cereals wherever possible.
ex.cn: 只要有可能就用全谷物早餐食品。

senses.def: or any other place

ex.en: tourists from Spain, France or wherever
ex.cn: 来自西班牙、法国或任何别的地方的游客

senses.def: used in questions to mean 'where', expressing surprise
senses.chn: （用于问句，表示惊讶）究竟在哪里，究竟到哪儿

ex.en: Wherever can he have gone to?
ex.cn: 他究竟会到哪儿去了呢？

senses.def: to increase your desire for or interest in sth
senses.chn: 刺激…的欲望；增强…的兴趣

ex.en: The book will whet your appetite for more of her work.
ex.cn: 你看了这本书就会更想多读她的著作。

senses.def: used to express a doubt or choice between two possibilities
senses.chn: （表示迟疑或两个可能性之间的选择）是否

ex.en: He seemed undecided whether to go or stay.
ex.cn: 他似乎还没有决定去留。

ex.en: It remains to be seen whether or not this idea can be put into practice.
ex.cn: 这一想法能否付诸实践还有待于观察。

ex.en: I asked him whether he had done it all himself or whether someone had helped him.
ex.cn: 我问过他这都是他自己做的还是有人帮他做的。

ex.en: I'll see whether she's at home (= or not at home).
ex.cn: 我来看看她在不在家。

ex.en: It's doubtful whether there'll be any seats left.
ex.cn: 看来未必还有座位。

ex.en: She asked if/whether I wanted a drink.
ex.cn: 她问我要不要喝点什么。

senses.def: used to show that sth is true in either of two cases
senses.chn: （表示两种情况都真实）是…（还是），或者…（或者），不管…（还是）

ex.en: You are entitled to a free gift whether you accept our offer of insurance or not.
ex.cn: 无论你接不接受我们的保险提议，你都可以免费得到一份礼物。

ex.en: I'm going whether you like it or not.
ex.cn: 不管你愿意不愿意，我都要走了。

ex.en: Whether or not we're successful, we can be sure that we did our best.
ex.cn: 不管成功与否，我们确已尽了最大努力。

senses.def: a stone that is used to make tools, knives and weapons sharp
a sound that people make to show that they are surprised or relieved about sth or that they are very hot or tired
senses.chn: （惊讶、宽慰或感到很热、疲劳时发出的声音）哟，噢

ex.en: Whew—and I thought it was serious!
ex.cn: 嚯，我原以为它有多么严重呢！

ex.en: Ten grand? Whew!
ex.cn: 一万英镑？哟！

senses.def: the thin liquid that is left from sour milk after the solid part (called curds) has been removed
senses.chn: 乳清，乳水（酸奶中的凝乳去掉后剩下的含水成分）

senses.def: used in questions to ask sb to be exact about one or more people or things from a limited number

ex.en: Which is better exercise—swimming or tennis?
ex.cn: 游泳和网球，哪种运动比较好？

ex.en: Which of the applicants has got the job?
ex.cn: 哪一位应聘者得到了这份工作？

ex.en: Which of the patients have recovered?
ex.cn: 哪些患者已经康复了？

ex.en: Which way is the wind blowing?
ex.cn: 风朝哪个方向刮？

senses.def: used to be exact about the thing or things that you mean
senses.chn: （明确所指的事物）…的那个，…的那些

ex.en: Houses which overlook the lake cost more.
ex.cn: 俯瞰湖泊的房子要价高些。

ex.en: It was a crisis for which she was totally unprepared.
ex.cn: 这是一场她完全没有防备的危机。

ex.en: It was a crisis that she was totally unprepared for.
ex.cn: 这是一场她完全没有防备的危机。

senses.def: used to give more information about sth
senses.chn: （进一步提供有关某事物的信息）那个，那些

ex.en: His best movie, which won several awards, was about the life of Gandhi.
ex.cn: 他最优秀的电影，就是荣获几项大奖的那一部，是关于甘地生平的。

ex.en: Your claim ought to succeed, in which case the damages will be substantial.
ex.cn: 你的索赔应当能成功，假如这样的话，损害赔偿金将会相当可观。

senses.def: used to talk about distinguishing one person or thing from another
senses.chn: （区分人或事物）谁是谁，哪个是哪个

ex.en: The twins are so alike I can't tell which is which.
ex.cn: 这一对双胞胎长得一模一样，我分不清谁是谁。

senses.def: used to say what feature or quality is important in deciding sth
senses.chn: （表示什么特征或品质在作决定时重要）…的那个，…的那些

ex.en: Choose whichever brand you prefer.
ex.cn: 挑选你喜欢的那个品牌。

ex.en: Pensions should be increased annually in line with earnings or prices, whichever is the higher.
ex.cn: 养老金每年应该按照收入或物价中升幅较高的那一项增长。

ex.en: Whichever of you gets here first will get the prize.
ex.cn: 你们谁第一个到达这里谁就获奖。

senses.def: used to say that it does not matter which, as the result will be the same

ex.en: It takes three hours, whichever route you take.
ex.cn: 无论你走哪一条路都需要三个小时。

ex.en: The situation is an awkward one, whichever way you look at it.
ex.cn: 无论从哪一方面看，这个局面都很尴尬。

ex.en: Whichever they choose, we must accept their decision.
ex.cn: 无论他们如何选择，我们都必须接受他们的决定。

senses.def: used to talk about distinguishing one person or thing from another
senses.chn: （区分人或事物）谁是谁，哪个是哪个

ex.en: The twins are so alike I can't tell which is which.
ex.cn: 这一对双胞胎长得一模一样，我分不清谁是谁。

senses.def: a smell, especially one that you only smell for a short time

ex.en: a whiff of cigar smoke
ex.cn: 一股雪茄烟味

ex.en: He caught a whiff of perfume as he leaned towards her.
ex.cn: 他探身靠近她时闻到一股香水味。

senses.def: a slight sign or feeling of sth
senses.chn: 轻微的迹象（或感觉）；一点点；些许

ex.en: a whiff of danger
ex.cn: 一点点危险

senses.def: an unsuccessful attempt to hit the ball
to smell bad
to try without success to hit the ball
smelling bad
in Britain in the past, a member of a party that supported progress and reform and that later became the Liberal Party
senses.chn: 辉格党党员（属于英国旧时的激进党派，自由党的前身）

senses.def: during the time that sth is happening

ex.en: We must have been burgled while we were asleep.
ex.cn: 我们肯定是在睡着时遭遇了入室盗窃。

ex.en: Her parents died while she was still at school.
ex.cn: 她还在读书时父母就去世了。

ex.en: While I was waiting at the bus stop, three buses went by in the opposite direction.
ex.cn: 我在公共汽车站等车时，路对面驶过了三辆公共汽车。

senses.def: at the same time as sth else is happening

ex.en: You can go swimming while I'm having lunch.
ex.cn: 我吃午饭时你可以去游泳。

ex.en: shoes mended while you wait
ex.cn: 在你等候的时候修好的鞋

senses.def: used to contrast two things

ex.en: While Tom's very good at science, his brother is absolutely hopeless.
ex.cn: 汤姆很擅长理科，而他的弟弟绝对是不可救药。

ex.en: This survey highlights a number of differences in the way that teenage boys and girls in the UK spend their free time.
ex.cn: 这项民意测验凸显出英国十几岁的男孩和女孩在打发闲暇时间上的诸多不同。

ex.en: One of the main differences between the girls and the boys who took part in the research was the way in which they use the Internet.
ex.cn: 参与了这项研究的女生和男生之间的主要差异之一在于他们使用互联网的方式。

ex.en: Unlike the girls, who use the Internet mainly to keep in touch with friends, the boys questioned in this survey tend to use the Internet for playing computer games.
ex.cn: 女生使用互联网主要是和朋友联系，这一点和男生不同，参与调查的男生往往是使用互联网来玩电脑游戏。

ex.en: The girls differ from the boys in that they tend to spend more time keeping in touch with friends on the telephone or on social networking websites.
ex.cn: 与男生不同的是，女生往往花更多的时间通过电话或社交网站与朋友保持联系。

ex.en: Compared to the boys, the girls spend much more time chatting to friends on the telephone.
ex.cn: 与男生相比，女生花在与朋友电话聊天上的时间要多得多。

ex.cn: 尽管我愿意帮忙，但是没有多少时间。

ex.en: While the film is undoubtedly too long, it is nevertheless an intriguing piece of cinema.
ex.cn: 虽然这部电影的确太长了，但它不失为一部有趣的影片。

ex.en: It can be argued that the movie is too long. It is nonetheless an intriguing piece of cinema.
ex.cn: 可以认为这部电影太长了，但它不失为一部有趣的影片。

ex.en: The film is undoubtedly too long. Still, it is an intriguing piece of cinema.
ex.cn: 这部电影的确太长了，但它仍不失为一部有趣的影片。

ex.en: Of course, huge chunks of the book have been sacrificed in order to make a two-hour movie, but it is nevertheless a successful piece of storytelling.
ex.cn: 当然，为了制作一部两小时的电影，该书中的大部分内容都被舍弃了，不过它仍不失为一部成功的故事片。

ex.en: Critics are wrong to argue that the film's plot is too complicated. Certainly there are a couple of major twists, but audiences will have no difficulty following them.
ex.cn: 批评家认为这部电影的情节过于复杂，这种观点是不恰当的。影片中确实有几次大的情节变化，但观众还是不难看懂的。

senses.def: until

ex.en: I waited while six o'clock.
ex.cn: 我一直等到了六点钟。

senses.def: used to suggest that sb could do sth while they are doing sth else

ex.cn: “我正想去买明信片。” “你能顺便给我买些邮票吗？”

senses.def: a period of time

ex.cn: 他们聊了一会儿。

ex.en: I'll be back in a little while (= a short time).
ex.cn: 我一会儿就回来。

ex.en: I haven't seen him for quite a while (= a fairly long time).
ex.cn: 我有好一阵子没有见到他了。

ex.en: They walked back together, talking all the while (= all the time).
ex.cn: 他们一起边走边聊着回去的。

ex.en: It will be worth your while to come to the meeting.
ex.cn: 你来参加会议对你会大有好处。

ex.en: He'll do the job if you make it worth his while (= pay him well).
ex.cn: 你要是给他的报酬丰厚，他会做这份工作的。

senses.def: to spend time in a pleasant lazy way

ex.cn: 我们靠看书和玩纸牌消磨时间。

senses.def: before a situation changes and it is no longer possible to do sth
senses.chn: 趁形势还未变化时；趁情况还有利时

senses.def: before a situation changes and it is no longer possible to do sth
senses.chn: 趁形势还未变化时；趁情况还有利时

ex.en: Don't you think we should quit while the going is good?
ex.cn: 你不认为我们应该及早脱身吗？

ex.cn: 她每次心血来潮他都不得不依随她。

ex.en: We bought the house on a whim.
ex.cn: 我们一时冲动买了这所房子。

ex.en: My duties seem to change daily at the whim of the boss.
ex.cn: 我的职责似乎随着老板的兴致每天改变。

ex.en: the whims of fashion
ex.cn: 时尚的变化多端

ex.en: She hires and fires people at whim.
ex.cn: 她随心所欲地雇用人和解雇人。

senses.def: to make low, weak crying noises; to speak in this way
senses.chn: 抽泣；呜咽；啜泣；泣诉；抽搭着说

ex.cn: 那孩子迷了路，抽抽搭搭地哭起来。

ex.en: 'Don't leave me alone,' he whimpered.
ex.cn: “别丢下我不管。” 他呜咽着说。

example.cn: “别丢下我不管。” 他呜咽着说。

senses.def: unusual and not serious in a way that is either amusing or annoying

ex.cn: 有离奇的幽默感

ex.en: Much of his writing has a whimsical quality.
ex.cn: 他的大部分作品都很出奇。

senses.def: a way of thinking or behaving, or a style of doing sth that is unusual and not serious, in a way that is either amusing or annoying
senses.chn: 怪念头；古怪可笑的举动；吊儿郎当；随心所欲

senses.def: to complain in an annoying, crying voice

ex.cn: 别哭哭啼啼的！

ex.cn: “我要回家。” 托比哭嚷道。

ex.cn: 我要就这件事向经理投诉。

ex.cn: 学生走上街头抗议这项决定。

ex.en: If nobody objects, we'll postpone the meeting till next week.
ex.cn: 如果没有人反对，我们就把会议推迟到下周。

ex.en: He objected that the police had arrested him without sufficient evidence.
ex.cn: 他抗辩说警察没有充分证据就逮捕了他。

ex.cn: 那狗嗷嗷地叫着抓门。

senses.def: to make a long high unpleasant sound

ex.cn: 发动机不停的嘎吱声

senses.chn: （儿童发出的）哭喊声；（狗发出的）号叫声

ex.cn: 她总是嘟囔着说一切都太不公平了。

ex.cn: 他甩了个响鞭，马儿就奋蹄向前奔去。

senses.chn: （政党发给党员的）投票通知书，投票指示

a reasonable opportunity to show that you can do sth

ex.cn: 我觉得我们没有得到适当的机会。

senses.def: to hit a person or an animal hard with a whip, as a punishment or to make them go faster or work harder

ex.cn: 一条树枝突然划过车窗。

ex.cn: 她的头发随风在脸际飘拂。

ex.cn: 时速 50 英里的大风卷起了波浪。

ex.cn: 她刷地一下子把脸上的面具摘掉了。

ex.cn: 那个人突然抽出一把刀来。

ex.cn: 馅饼得配搅打奶油。

ex.en: Whip the egg whites up into stiff peaks.
ex.cn: 把蛋白打得起稠尖儿。

ex.cn: 这个队以 35 分的优势轻松击败对手。

senses.def: to steal sth
to do or finish sth very quickly

ex.cn: 我们十分钟便办完了海关手续。

senses.def: to deliberately try and make people excited or feel strongly about sth

ex.cn: 这些广告是为了激起公众的舆论。

ex.en: He was a speaker who could really whip up a crowd.
ex.cn: 他是个真正有感召力的演说者。

senses.def: to quickly make a meal or sth to eat

ex.cn: 她用了 15 分钟就给我们备好了一顿可口的午餐。

example.en: A branch whipped across the car window.
example.cn: 一条树枝突然划过车窗。

example.cn: 时速 50 英里的大风卷起了波浪。

example.en: Whip the egg whites up into stiff peaks.
example.cn: 把蛋白打得起稠尖儿。

senses.chn: 挥鞭伤，鞭打损伤（尤指车祸造成的颈部过度屈伸损伤）

senses.chn: 小灵狗（类似灵𤟥，常用于赛狗）

senses.chn: 代人受过者；替罪羊；出气筒

ex.en: We whipped through customs in ten minutes.
ex.cn: 我们十分钟便办完了海关手续。

senses.def: to make a continuous low sound like the parts of a machine moving

ex.en: The clock began to whir before striking the hour.
ex.cn: 钟在敲响整点前先嘎啦嘎啦地响。

senses.def: a continuous low sound, for example the sound made by the regular movement of a machine or the wings of a bird

ex.en: the whir of a motor
ex.cn: 发动机的嗡嗡声

ex.en: There was a whirring of machinery.
ex.cn: 有机器发出的嗡嗡声。

senses.def: to move, or make sb/sth move, around quickly in a circle or in a particular direction

ex.en: Leaves whirled in the wind.
ex.cn: 落叶在风中旋转。

ex.en: She whirled around to face him.
ex.cn: 她猛地转过身子面对着他。

ex.en: the whirling blades of the helicopter
ex.cn: 直升机旋转着的桨叶

ex.en: Tom whirled her across the dance floor.
ex.cn: 汤姆拥着她从舞池的一边旋转到另一边。

senses.chn: （头脑、思想等）混乱不清，激动，恍惚

ex.cn: 我睡不着，所发生的一切一直在脑子里转来转去。

ex.en: So many thoughts whirled around in her mind.
ex.cn: 她思绪万千，脑子里乱作一团。

senses.def: a movement of sth spinning round and round

ex.cn: 尘土飞扬

ex.cn: 她脑子里乱糟糟的。

ex.cn: 她的生活就是接连不断的聚会。

ex.en: It's easy to get caught up in the social whirl.
ex.cn: 很容易被纷繁的社交活动缠得脱不开身。

senses.def: to try sth to see if you like it or can do it

example.en: Leaves whirled in the wind.
example.cn: 落叶在风中旋转。

example.en: Tom whirled her across the dance floor.
example.cn: 汤姆拥着她从舞池的一边旋转到另一边。

senses.def: something that is very active and always changing

ex.cn: 时尚的千变万化

a place in a river or the sea where currents of water spin round very fast

ex.cn: 她觉得自己被卷入了感情的旋涡。

a very strong wind that moves very fast in a spinning movement and causes a lot of damage
a situation or series of events where a lot of things happen very quickly

ex.cn: 为了从离婚中恢复过来，我马不停蹄地投身于一系列的活动。

senses.chn: 快速的；匆匆忙忙的；旋风似的

ex.cn: 旋风式恋爱

ex.en: a whirlwind tour of America
ex.cn: 旋风式的美国之行

ex.cn: 把蛋白搅打稠。

ex.cn: 苏格兰威士忌

ex.en: highland whiskies
ex.cn: 高地威士忌

ex.cn: 你们两人在低声说些什么？

ex.cn: “你今晚能和我见面吗？” 他小声问。

ex.cn: 她探过身去附耳跟他说了些什么。
