senses.chn: 变得激动（或焦虑、生气）；发狂

senses.def: a type of wild duck
to move from side to side or up and down in short quick movements; to make sth move in this way

ex.en: He removed his shoes and wiggled his toes.
ex.cn: 他脱掉鞋子，扭动着脚趾。

ex.en: Her bottom wiggled as she walked past.
ex.cn: 她屁股一扭一扭地走了过去。

senses.def: a small movement from side to side or up and down
the chance to change sth or to understand it in a different way

ex.en: The buyer still has some wiggle room when the deal is under contract.
ex.cn: 根据合同，买方在交易时仍有一定的回旋余地。

ex.en: The amendment leaves no wiggle room for lawmakers.
ex.cn: 修正案没有给立法者留下漏洞。

senses.def: having many curves in it
senses.chn: 弯弯曲曲的；波浪形的；起伏的

senses.def: a ghost or other spirit
a person, considered in a particular way

ex.en: a poor wight
ex.cn: 可怜鬼

senses.def: to become very excited, very anxious or angry about sth; to go crazy
senses.chn: 变得激动（或焦虑、生气）；发狂

senses.def: a type of tent, shaped like a dome or cone , used by Native Americans in the past
senses.chn: （旧时印第安人使用的圆顶或锥形的）棚屋

senses.def: a website that allows any user to change or add to the information it contains
senses.chn: 维基（允许用户修改或添加信息的网站）

ex.en: There's a wiki page hosted by the conference where you can share ideas and information.
ex.cn: 大会建立了维基网页，供大家交流想法和共享信息。

senses.def: people say Wilco! in communication by radio to show that they agree to do sth
living or growing in natural conditions; not kept in a house or on a farm
senses.chn: 自然生长的；野的；野生的

ex.en: wild animals/flowers
ex.cn: 野生动物；野花

ex.en: a wild rabbit
ex.cn: 野生兔

ex.en: wild strawberries
ex.cn: 野草莓

ex.en: The plants grow wild along the banks of rivers.
ex.cn: 沿河两岸生长着野生植物。

senses.def: in its natural state; not changed by people

ex.en: wild moorland
ex.cn: 荒凉的高沼地

senses.def: lacking discipline or control
senses.chn: 缺乏管教的；无法无天的；放荡的

ex.en: The boy is wild and completely out of control.
ex.cn: 这男孩缺乏管教，简直是无法无天。

ex.en: He had a wild look in his eyes.
ex.cn: 他的眼神很不安分。

senses.def: full of very strong feeling

ex.en: wild laughter
ex.cn: 开怀大笑

ex.en: The crowd went wild.
ex.cn: 群情激昂。

ex.en: It makes me wild (= very angry) to see such waste.
ex.cn: 看到这种浪费现象让我非常生气。

senses.def: not carefully planned; not sensible or accurate

ex.en: He made a wild guess at the answer.
ex.cn: 他胡乱猜了个答案。

ex.en: wild accusations
ex.cn: 无端的指责

senses.def: very good, enjoyable or exciting
senses.chn: 很棒的；高兴的；令人激动的

ex.en: We had a wild time in New York.
ex.cn: 我们在纽约玩得痛快极了。

senses.def: very enthusiastic about sb/sth

ex.en: She's totally wild about him.
ex.cn: 她对他简直是着了迷。

ex.en: I'm not wild about the idea.
ex.cn: 我对这个想法不太感兴趣。

senses.def: affected by storms and strong winds

ex.en: a wild night
ex.cn: 暴风雨之夜

ex.en: The sea was wild.
ex.cn: 大海波涛汹涌。

senses.def: far more, better, etc. than you could ever have imagined or hoped for
senses.chn: 做梦都没想到；远远出乎所料；大大超出希望

senses.def: used to say that sth has happened in a way that sb did not expect at all
senses.chn: （表示完全出乎意料）做梦都没有，从来没有想到

ex.en: Never in my wildest dreams did I think I'd meet him again.
ex.cn: 我连做梦都没想到会再见他。

senses.def: to grow or develop freely without any control
senses.chn: 变得荒芜；自由生长；任其发展

ex.en: The ivy has run wild.
ex.cn: 常春藤长疯了。

ex.en: Let your imagination run wild and be creative.
ex.cn: 让你的想象力自由驰骋发挥创意吧。

senses.def: if children or animals run wild, they behave as they like because nobody is controlling them
used to say that nothing would prevent sb from doing sth or make them do sth they do not want to do
senses.chn: 任何事情都不能阻止（或促使某人做某事）；八匹马拉不了某人回头

senses.def: to go through a period of wild behaviour while young, especially having a lot of romantic or sexual relationships
a natural environment that is not controlled by people

ex.en: The bird is too tame now to survive in the wild.
ex.cn: 这只鸟养得太温驯了，现在很难在野生环境中生存。

senses.def: areas of a country far from towns or cities, where few people live
senses.chn: 偏远地区；人烟稀少的地区

ex.en: the wilds of Alaska
ex.cn: 阿拉斯加人烟稀少的地区

ex.en: They live on a farm somewhere out in the wilds.
ex.cn: 他们住在边远地区的一个农场里。

senses.def: a card that has no value of its own and takes the value of any card that the player chooses
senses.chn: （由持牌人自由决定牌值的）百搭牌，变牌

senses.def: an opportunity for sb to play in a competition when they have not qualified in the usual way; a player who enters a competition in this way
senses.chn: “外卡” 参赛，“外卡” 选手（指没有正常参赛资格而参赛）

senses.def: a symbol that can represent any letter or number
a person or thing whose behaviour or effect is difficult to predict
senses.chn: 难以预测的人（或事物）；未知因素；未知数

senses.def: a wildcat strike happens suddenly and without the official support of a trade/labor union
senses.chn: （罢工）未经工会同意的，突然自发进行的

senses.def: that has not been carefully planned and that will probably not be successful; that does not follow normal standards and methods
senses.chn: （计划不周密而）不稳妥的；不按正常标准的

senses.def: to look for oil in a place where nobody has found any yet
a type of small wild cat that lives in mountains and forests
senses.chn: 野猫（生活在山区或森林里）

senses.def: a large antelope with curved horns

ex.en: a herd of wildebeest
ex.cn: 一群牛羚

senses.def: a large area of land that has never been developed or used for growing crops because it is difficult to live there
senses.chn: 未开发的地区；荒无人烟的地区；荒野

ex.en: The Antarctic is the world's last great wilderness.
ex.cn: 南极洲是世界上最后一个大荒原。

ex.en: a wilderness area (= one where it is not permitted to build houses or roads)
ex.cn: （政府划定的）保留自然环境面貌地区

ex.en: the barren wilderness of modern life
ex.cn: 现代生活贫瘠的荒漠

senses.def: a place that people do not take care of or control
senses.chn: 荒芜的地方；杂草丛生处

ex.en: Their garden is a wilderness of grass and weeds.
ex.cn: 他们的花园杂草丛生。

senses.def: no longer in an important position, especially in politics
to become known by more and more people very quickly
senses.chn: 像野火般蔓延；迅速传开

senses.def: birds that people hunt for sport or food, especially birds that live near water such as ducks and geese
senses.chn: （尤指生活在水边被人猎食的）野禽，野鸭，野鹅

senses.def: a search for sth that is impossible for you to find or that does not exist, that makes you waste a lot of time
senses.chn: 徒劳的寻找；白费力气的追逐

senses.def: animals, birds, insects, etc. that are wild and live in a natural environment

ex.en: Development of the area would endanger wildlife.
ex.cn: 开发这一地区将会危及野生动物。

ex.en: a wildlife habitat/sanctuary
ex.cn: 野生动物栖息地／保护区

senses.def: in a way that is not controlled

ex.en: She looked wildly around for an escape.
ex.cn: 她环顾四周，拼命寻找逃路。

ex.en: His heart was beating wildly.
ex.cn: 他的心脏剧烈地跳着。

senses.def: extremely; very

ex.en: The story had been wildly exaggerated.
ex.cn: 这件事被过分地夸大了。

ex.en: It is not a wildly funny play.
ex.cn: 这并不是一出太滑稽的戏剧。

senses.def: clever tricks that sb uses in order to get what they want or to make sb behave in a particular way
done deliberately, although the person doing it knows that it is wrong

ex.en: wilful damage
ex.cn: 蓄意破坏

senses.def: determined to do what you want; not caring about what other people want

ex.en: a wilful child
ex.cn: 任性的孩子

senses.def: used for talking about or predicting the future

ex.en: You'll be in time if you hurry.
ex.cn: 你要是抓紧一点儿就会来得及。

ex.en: How long will you be staying in Paris?
ex.cn: 你将在巴黎待多久？

ex.en: Fred said he'd be leaving soon.
ex.cn: 弗雷德说他很快就要走了。

ex.en: By next year all the money will have been spent.
ex.cn: 到明年所有的钱都将花光了。

senses.def: used for showing that sb is willing to do sth

ex.en: I'll check this letter for you, if you want.
ex.cn: 你要是愿意，我会给你查查这封信的。

ex.en: They won't lend us any more money.
ex.cn: 他们不愿再借给我们钱了。

ex.en: He wouldn't come—he said he was too busy.
ex.cn: 他不愿来，他说他太忙。

ex.en: We said we would keep them.
ex.cn: 我们说过要保存它们的。

senses.def: used for asking sb to do sth

ex.en: Will you send this letter for me, please?
ex.cn: 请你替我把这封信寄出去行吗？

ex.en: You'll water the plants while I'm away, won't you?
ex.cn: 我外出的时候请你给花草浇浇水，行不行？

ex.en: I asked him if he wouldn't mind calling later.
ex.cn: 我问他能否过会儿再来电话。

senses.def: used for ordering sb to do sth

ex.en: You'll do it this minute!
ex.cn: 你现在就要做这事！

ex.en: Will you be quiet!
ex.cn: 安静点儿！

senses.def: used for stating what you think is probably true

ex.en: That'll be the doctor now.
ex.cn: 这会儿准是医生来了。

ex.en: You'll have had dinner already, I suppose.
ex.cn: 我想，到时候你大概已经吃过饭了。

senses.def: used for stating what is generally true

ex.en: If it's made of wood it will float.
ex.cn: 这要是木材做的就能浮在水面上。

ex.en: Engines won't run without lubricants.
ex.cn: 没有润滑油发动机就不能运转。

senses.def: used for stating what is true or possible in a particular case
senses.chn: （叙述在某种情况下是真实或可能的事）

ex.en: This jar will hold a kilo.
ex.cn: 这个罐子能盛一千克。

ex.en: The door won't open!
ex.cn: 那扇门就是打不开！

senses.def: used for talking about habits

ex.en: She'll listen to music, alone in her room, for hours.
ex.cn: 她总是独自一个人在屋里听音乐，一听就是几个小时。

ex.en: He would spend hours on the telephone.
ex.cn: 他一打电话往往就是几个小时。

ex.en: He will comb his hair at the table, even though he knows I don't like it.
ex.cn: 他喜欢在桌子旁梳头，即便他知道我讨厌他这个习惯。

senses.def: to want or like

ex.en: Call it what you will, it's still a problem.
ex.cn: 不管怎么说，这仍然是个问题。

senses.def: to use the power of your mind to do sth or to make sth happen

ex.en: As a child he had thought he could fly, if he willed it enough.
ex.cn: 他小时候曾经以为，只要有足够决心，想要飞就能飞起来。

ex.en: She willed her eyes to stay open.
ex.cn: 她使劲睁着眼睛。

ex.en: He willed himself not to panic.
ex.cn: 他竭力让自己不要恐慌。

senses.def: to intend or want sth to happen

ex.en: They thought they had been victorious in battle because God had willed it.
ex.cn: 他们以为自己打了胜仗是上帝的旨意。

senses.def: to formally give your property or possessions to sb after you have died, by means of a will (3)
senses.chn: 立遗嘱将（财产等）赠与（某人）；立遗嘱赠与

ex.en: Joe had willed them everything he possessed.
ex.cn: 乔把自己拥有的一切都遗赠给了他们。

ex.en: Joe had willed everything he possessed to them.
ex.cn: 乔把自己拥有的一切都遗赠给了他们。

senses.def: the ability to control your thoughts and actions in order to achieve what you want to do; a feeling of strong determination to do sth that you want to do

ex.en: to have a strong will
ex.cn: 有坚强的意志

ex.en: to have an iron will/a will of iron
ex.cn: 有钢铁般的意志

ex.en: Her decision to continue shows great strength of will.
ex.cn: 她决心坚持下去，显示出了很大的意志力。

ex.en: In spite of what happened, he never lost the will to live.
ex.cn: 尽管如此遭遇，他从未丧失活下去的意志。

ex.en: The meeting turned out to be a clash of wills.
ex.cn: 这次会议结果成了一次意志的角力。

ex.en: She always wants to impose her will on other people (= to get what she wants).
ex.cn: 她总是想把自己的意志强加于人。

senses.def: what sb wants to happen in a particular situation

ex.en: I don't want to go against your will.
ex.cn: 我不想违背您的意愿。

ex.en: It is God's will.
ex.cn: 这是上帝的旨意。

senses.def: a legal document that says what is to happen to sb's money and property after they die

ex.en: I ought to make a will.
ex.cn: 我应该立份遗嘱。

ex.en: My father left me the house in his will.
ex.cn: 我父亲在遗嘱中把这所房子遗赠给了我。

senses.def: having the type of will mentioned

ex.en: a strong-willed young woman
ex.cn: 意志坚强的年轻女子

ex.en: weak-willed greedy people
ex.cn: 意志薄弱而贪婪的人

senses.def: when you do not want to

ex.en: I was forced to sign the agreement against my will.
ex.cn: 我被迫违心地签了这份协议。

senses.def: whenever or wherever you like

ex.en: They were able to come and go at will.
ex.cn: 他们能够来去自由。

senses.def: if you really want to do sth then you will find a way of doing it
in a willing and enthusiastic way
used to say that you cannot do sth, even though you really want to
senses.chn: 尽管已尽心竭力；尽管真心愿意

ex.en: With the best will in the world I could not describe him as a good father.
ex.cn: 尽管我心里极想美言几句，却怎么也不能说他是位好父亲。

example.en: As a child he had thought he could fly, if he willed it enough.
example.cn: 他小时候曾经以为，只要有足够决心，想要飞就能飞起来。

example.en: She willed her eyes to stay open.
example.cn: 她使劲睁着眼睛。

example.en: Joe had willed them everything he possessed.
example.cn: 乔把自己拥有的一切都遗赠给了他们。

example.en: Joe had willed everything he possessed to them.
example.cn: 乔把自己拥有的一切都遗赠给了他们。

senses.def: a service by which items, especially tickets, can be paid for and then collected later
senses.chn: 预售寄存服务（为顾客保存已付款商品，待以后领取）

ex.en: Up to the day of the event, will-call is located at the main Ticket Office.
ex.cn: 到活动当天为止，在主售票处提供预订票领取服务。

ex.en: He was standing in the will-call line to collect two tickets.
ex.cn: 他在预售票队列排队领取两张票。

senses.def: not objecting to doing sth; having no reason for not doing sth

ex.en: They keep a list of people (who are) willing to work nights.
ex.cn: 他们有一份愿意夜间工作的人的名单。

ex.en: I'm perfectly willing to discuss the problem.
ex.cn: 我十分乐意讨论这个问题。

senses.def: ready or pleased to help and not needing to be persuaded; done or given in an enthusiastic way
senses.chn: 自愿的；乐于相助的；积极肯干的

ex.en: willing helpers/volunteers
ex.cn: 主动帮忙的人；志愿工作者

ex.en: willing support
ex.cn: 自愿的支持

ex.en: She's very willing.
ex.cn: 她非常积极肯干。

senses.def: used to say that you hope that things will happen as you have planned and that there will be no problems
senses.chn: （希望事情能按计划顺利进行）如系天意，如上帝许可，如一切顺利

ex.en: I'll be back next week, God willing.
ex.cn: 如一切顺利，我下星期就回来。

senses.def: to show that you are ready to help, work hard, etc. if necessary
senses.chn: 表示愿意；有乐于…的意思

senses.def: you intend to do good things but you are too lazy, weak or busy to actually do them
senses.chn: 心灵固然愿意，肉体却软弱；心有余而力不足；力不从心

senses.def: a thing that is impossible to obtain; a person that you cannot depend on
senses.chn: 难以捉摸的人（或事物）；镜花水月；虚无之物

senses.def: a blue light that is sometimes seen at night on soft wet ground and is caused by natural gases burning
a tree with long thin branches and long thin leaves, that often grows near water
the wood of the willow tree, used especially for making cricket bats
senses.chn: 柳木（常用以制作板球拍）

senses.def: tall, thin and attractive
senses.chn: 修长苗条的；婀娜多姿的

senses.def: the ability to control your thoughts and actions in order to achieve what you want to do
a word for a penis, used especially by children or when speaking to children
whether you want to or not
senses.chn: 不管愿意不愿意；无论想要不想要

ex.en: She was forced willy-nilly to accept the company's proposals.
ex.cn: 她被迫无奈接受了公司的提议。

senses.def: in a careless way without planning

ex.en: Don't use your credit card willy-nilly.
ex.cn: 别拿着你的信用卡随便花。

senses.def: a city in the US state of Delaware
senses.chn: 威尔明顿（美国特拉华州城市）

senses.def: if a plant or flower wilts, or sth wilts it, it bends towards the ground because of the heat or a lack of water
to become weak or tired or less confident
senses.chn: 变得委靡不振；发蔫；变得又累又乏；失去自信

ex.en: The spectators were wilting visibly in the hot sun.
ex.cn: 看得出观众在炎热的阳光下快支撑不住了。

ex.en: He was wilting under the pressure of work.
ex.cn: 他被工作压得喘不过气来。

senses.def: used to mean 'you will', when talking to one person
senses.chn: （同一个人谈话时用，即 you will）

senses.def: wilted vegetable leaves, for example lettuce leaves, have been cooked for a short time and then used in a salad
clever at getting what you want, and willing to trick people
senses.chn: 狡猾的；诡计多端的；爱捉弄人的

ex.en: The boss is a wily old fox.
ex.cn: 老板是个狡猾的老狐狸。

senses.def: a person who is not strong, brave or confident
to not do sth that you intended to do because you are too frightened or not confident enough to do it
senses.chn: 畏缩而不敢做；怯而不做

senses.def: a head covering made of cloth folded around the head and neck, worn by women in the Middle Ages and now by some nuns
senses.chn: （中世纪妇女和当今某些修女戴的）温帕尔头巾

senses.def: to be the most successful in a competition, race, battle, etc.
senses.chn: （在比赛、赛跑、战斗等中）获胜，赢

ex.en: Which team won?
ex.cn: 哪个队赢了？

ex.en: to win at cards/chess, etc.
ex.cn: 赢牌、赢棋等

ex.en: France won by six goals to two against Denmark.
ex.cn: 法国队以六比二战胜丹麦队。

ex.en: to win an election/a game/a war, etc.
ex.cn: 赢得选举、比赛、战争等

ex.en: She loves to win an argument.
ex.cn: 她喜欢在辩论中获胜。

senses.def: to get sth as the result of a competition, race, election, etc.
senses.chn: （在比赛、赛跑、选举等中）赢得，夺取，获得，挣得

ex.en: Britain won five gold medals.
ex.cn: 英国夺取了五块金牌。

ex.en: He won £3 000 in the lottery.
ex.cn: 他中彩得了 3 000 英镑。

ex.en: How many states did the Republicans win?
ex.cn: 共和党在多少个州的选举中获胜？

ex.en: The Conservatives won the seat from Labour in the last election.
ex.cn: 在上次选举中保守党从工党手中夺得了这个议席。

ex.en: You've won yourself a trip to New York.
ex.cn: 你赢得了一次纽约之旅。

senses.def: to achieve or get sth that you want, especially by your own efforts
senses.chn: （尤指通过自己的努力）取得，获得

ex.en: They are trying to win support for their proposals.
ex.cn: 他们在努力争取人们支持他们的建议。

ex.en: The company has won a contract to supply books and materials to schools.
ex.cn: 这家公司得到了一份向学校供应图书资料的合同。

ex.en: She won the admiration of many people in her battle against cancer.
ex.cn: 她在与癌症的对抗中赢得了许多人的钦佩。

senses.def: used to say that there is no acceptable way of dealing with a particular situation
senses.chn: 怎么做都不讨好；没有令人满意的方法

ex.en: I question the wisdom of giving a child so much money.
ex.cn: 我对给孩子这么多钱是否明智怀有疑问。

senses.def: the knowledge that a society or culture has gained over a long period of time
senses.chn: （社会或文化长期积累的）知识，学问

ex.en: the collective wisdom of the Native American people
ex.cn: 美洲原住民的集体智慧

senses.def: the view or belief that most people hold
senses.chn: 大多数人的看法；普遍信念

ex.en: Conventional wisdom has it that riots only ever happen in cities.
ex.cn: 人们普遍认为，只有城市里才发生暴乱。

senses.def: used when you are saying that you do not understand why sb has done sth
senses.chn: （表示不理解他人的无知）以其（无限的）智慧

ex.en: The government in its wisdom has decided to support the ban.
ex.cn: 政府竟愚蠢到决定支持这项禁令。

senses.def: a wise remark

ex.en: Thank you for those pearls of wisdom.
ex.cn: 谢谢你的金玉良言。

senses.def: any of the four large teeth at the back of the mouth that do not grow until you are an adult
able to make sensible decisions and give good advice because of the experience and knowledge that you have
senses.chn: 充满智慧的；明智的；英明的；明察善断的

ex.en: a wise old man
ex.cn: 智叟

ex.en: I'm older and wiser after ten years in the business.
ex.cn: 在商界混了十年之后，我变得老成聪明了。

senses.def: sensible; based on good judgement
senses.chn: 明智的；高明的；有判断力的

ex.en: a wise decision
ex.cn: 明智的决定

ex.en: It was very wise to leave when you did.
ex.cn: 你那时离开非常明智。

ex.en: The wisest course of action is just to say nothing.
ex.cn: 最明智的做法就是缄默不言。

ex.en: I was grateful for her wise counsel.
ex.cn: 我感激她为我指点迷津。

senses.def: to not understand sth, even after it has been explained to you
senses.chn: （解释之后）依然不懂，仍不明白

ex.en: I've read the instructions, but I'm still none the wiser.
ex.cn: 我看了用法说明，但仍然弄不明白。

senses.def: to not know or find out about sth bad that sb has done
senses.chn: 不知道，发现不了（某人做的坏事）

ex.en: If you put the money back, no one will be any the wiser.
ex.cn: 只要你把钱放回去，谁都不会察觉。

senses.def: to understand sth, or realize what you should have done, only after sth has happened
to become aware that sb is being dishonest
senses.chn: 明白，察觉（某人的不轨行为）

ex.en: He thought he could fool me but I got wise to him.
ex.cn: 他以为能耍得了我，其实我清楚他是怎么一号人。

senses.def: to inform sb about sth
to become aware of the unpleasant truth about a situation
senses.chn: 意识到，觉察（令人不愉快的实情）

senses.def: a person who is annoying because they are very confident and think they know a lot
senses.chn: 自以为无所不知的人；自以为是的人

senses.def: a clever remark or joke

example.en: He plays a wisecracking detective.
example.cn: 他扮演一位满嘴俏皮话的侦探。

senses.def: a person who speaks or behaves as if they know more than other people
senses.chn: 自以为无所不知的人；万事通

senses.def: a member of the Mafia
a woman with knowledge of traditional medicines and magic
senses.chn: （深谙传统医术和幻术的）神婆，巫婆

senses.def: to want sth to happen or to be true even though it is unlikely or impossible
senses.chn: 希望（不大可能的事）发生；怀着（不可能实现的）愿望

ex.en: I wish I were taller.
ex.cn: 我要是个子高一些就好了。

ex.en: I wish I was taller.
ex.cn: 我要是个子高一些就好了。

ex.en: I wish I hadn't eaten so much.
ex.cn: 我倒希望我没有吃这么多。

ex.en: 'Where is he now?' ' I only wish I knew!'
ex.cn: “他现在在哪儿？” “我要是知道就好了！”

ex.en: I wish you wouldn't leave your clothes all over the floor.
ex.cn: 我真希望你不把衣服丢得满地都是。

ex.en: He's dead and it's no use wishing him alive again.
ex.cn: 他死了，希望他死而复生是无济于事的。

senses.def: to want to do sth; to want sth to happen
senses.chn: 希望（做某事）；想要（某事发生）

ex.en: You may stay until morning, if you wish.
ex.cn: 如果你愿意，你可以一直待到早晨。

ex.en: 'I'd rather not talk now.' ' (Just) as you wish.'
ex.cn: “现在我最好还是不说话。” “悉听尊便。”

ex.en: This course is designed for people wishing to update their computer skills.
ex.cn: 这门课程是为想要提高电脑技术的人而设的。

ex.en: I wish to speak to the manager.
ex.cn: 我想跟经理说话。

ex.en: I don't wish (= I don't mean) to be rude, but could you be a little quieter?
ex.cn: 我不想无礼，但请您安静一点儿好吗？

ex.en: She could not believe that he wished her harm.
ex.cn: 她不能相信他希望她受到伤害。

senses.def: to think very hard that you want sth, especially sth that can only be achieved by good luck or magic

ex.en: She shut her eyes and wished for him to get better.
ex.cn: 她闭上眼睛盼祷他好起来。

ex.en: If you wish really hard, maybe you'll get what you want.
ex.cn: 心诚则灵。

ex.en: It's no use wishing for the impossible.
ex.cn: 企求不可能的事情是徒劳无益的。

ex.en: He has everything he could possibly wish for.
ex.cn: 他可能想要的一切东西他都有了。

senses.def: to say that you hope that sb will be happy, lucky, etc.

ex.en: I wished her a happy birthday.
ex.cn: 我祝她生日快乐。

ex.en: Wish me luck!
ex.cn: 祝我交好运吧！

ex.en: We wish them both well in their retirement.
ex.cn: 我们祝愿他们两位退休后颐养天年。

senses.def: used to say that sth is impossible or very unlikely, although you wish it were possible
senses.chn: 但愿如此（但不可能或不大可能）

ex.en: 'You'll have finished by tomorrow.' 'I wish!'
ex.cn: “你到明天就完成了。” “但愿如此！”

senses.def: to try to get rid of sth by wishing it did not exist
senses.chn: 从心里竭力摆脱；希望…不再存在

senses.def: to want sb to have sth unpleasant

ex.en: I wouldn't wish something like that on my worst enemy.
ex.cn: 即使是我的死对头，我也不想他出那样的事。

senses.def: a desire or a feeling that you want to do sth or have sth

ex.en: She expressed a wish to be alone.
ex.cn: 她表示希望一个人待着。

ex.en: He had no wish to start a fight.
ex.cn: 他无意挑衅。

ex.en: His dearest wish (= what he wants most of all) is to see his grandchildren again.
ex.cn: 他最大的愿望是能再次见到自己的孙子孙女。

ex.en: I can understand her wish for secrecy.
ex.cn: 我可以理解她想保守秘密的愿望。

ex.en: It was her dying wish that I should have it.
ex.cn: 她的临终愿望是把这东西留给我。

senses.def: a thing that you want to have or to happen

ex.en: to carry out sb's wishes
ex.cn: 实现某人的愿望

ex.en: I'm sure that you will get your wish.
ex.cn: 我相信你会心想事成。

ex.en: She married against her parents' wishes.
ex.cn: 她违背父母的愿望嫁给了别的人。

senses.def: an attempt to make sth happen by thinking hard about it, especially in stories when it often happens by magic

ex.en: Throw some money in the fountain and make a wish.
ex.cn: 往喷泉里扔些钱，许个愿。

ex.en: The genie granted him three wishes.
ex.cn: 精灵答应满足他三个心愿。

ex.en: The prince's wish came true.
ex.cn: 王子的愿望实现了。

senses.def: used especially in a letter or card to say that you hope that sb will be happy, well or successful
senses.chn: （书信或贺卡等中的）祝愿，祝福

ex.en: We all send our best wishes for the future.
ex.cn: 我们都对未来致以最好的祝愿。

ex.en: Give my good wishes to the family.
ex.cn: 请替我向全家致意。

ex.en: With best wishes (= for example, at the end of a letter)
ex.cn: 祝好（如信中结尾语）

senses.def: wishing for sth does not make it happen
senses.chn: 想有不见得就有；愿望不等于事实

senses.def: used to say that you are ready to do whatever sb asks you to do
we believe a thing because we want it to be true

example.en: I wish I were taller.
example.cn: 我要是个子高一些就好了。

example.en: He's dead and it's no use wishing him alive again.
example.cn: 他死了，希望他死而复生是无济于事的。

example.en: She wished herself a million miles away.
example.cn: 她恨不得自己远在百万英里之外。

example.en: This course is designed for people wishing to update their computer skills.
example.cn: 这门课程是为想要提高电脑技术的人而设的。

example.en: She could not believe that he wished her harm.
example.cn: 她不能相信他希望她受到伤害。

example.en: He was not sure whether he wished her to stay or go.
example.cn: 他说不准他到底是希望她留下还是离开。

example.en: We wish them both well in their retirement.
example.cn: 我们祝愿他们两位退休后颐养天年。

example.en: She expressed a wish to be alone.
example.cn: 她表示希望一个人待着。

example.en: I can understand her wish for secrecy.
example.cn: 我可以理解她想保守秘密的愿望。

example.en: It was her dying wish that I should have it.
example.cn: 她的临终愿望是把这东西留给我。

senses.def: a V-shaped bone between the neck and breast of a chicken, duck, etc. When the bird is eaten, this bone is sometimes pulled apart by two people, and the person who gets the larger part can make a wish.
senses.chn: 叉骨，许愿骨（吃禽肉时两人将颈与胸之间的 V 形骨拉开，得较大块者可许愿）

senses.def: the belief that sth that you want to happen is happening or will happen, although this is actually not true or very unlikely
senses.chn: 不实际的幻想；一厢情愿

ex.en: I've got a feeling that Alex likes me, but that might just be wishful thinking.
ex.cn: 我感觉亚历克斯喜欢上我了，但那可能只是我一厢情愿的想法。

senses.def: a well that people drop a coin into and make a wish
all the things that you would like to have, or that you would like to happen
senses.chn: 希望一览表（指所有希望得到的东西或全部希望发生的事情）

senses.def: to try to get rid of sth by wishing it did not exist
senses.chn: 从心里竭力摆脱；希望…不再存在

senses.def: not having clear or firm ideas or beliefs
senses.chn: （思想或信仰）稀里糊涂的，不清楚的，不坚定的

ex.en: a wishy-washy liberal
ex.cn: 不坚定的自由主义者

senses.def: not bright in colour

ex.en: a wishy-washy blue
ex.cn: 淡淡的蓝色

senses.def: a small, thin piece of hair, grass, etc.
senses.chn: （头发、草等的）小缕，小绺，小把，小束

senses.def: a long thin line of smoke or cloud
consisting of small, thin pieces; not thick
senses.chn: 一绺绺的；一缕缕的；成束的；纤细的

ex.en: wispy hair/clouds
ex.cn: 一缕缕头发／云彩

ex.en: a wispy beard
ex.cn: 一绺绺胡须

senses.def: a climbing plant with bunches of pale purple or white flowers that hang down
thinking sadly about sth that you would like to have, especially sth in the past that you can no longer have
senses.chn: 伤感的；（对已不可能发生之事）徒然神往的

ex.en: a wistful smile
ex.cn: 伤感的微笑

senses.def: the ability to say or write things that are both clever and amusing
senses.chn: 措辞巧妙的能力；风趣；才思

ex.en: to have a quick/sharp/dry/ready wit
ex.cn: 才思敏捷；敏锐机智；假装正经的诙谐；头脑机敏

ex.en: a woman of wit and intelligence
ex.cn: 才思敏捷、聪颖的女子

ex.en: a book full of the wit and wisdom of his 30 years in politics
ex.cn: 一本有关他 30 年政治生涯中才思与智慧的书

senses.def: a person who has the ability to say or write things that are both clever and amusing
senses.chn: 才思敏捷说话诙谐的人；机智幽默的人

ex.en: a well-known wit and raconteur
ex.cn: 一位闻名遐迩、妙语连珠的故事大王

senses.def: your ability to think quickly and clearly and to make good decisions
senses.chn: 理解力；颖悟力；头脑；智力

ex.en: He needed all his wits to find his way out.
ex.cn: 他需要绞尽脑汁找到出路。

ex.en: The game was a long battle of wits.
ex.cn: 这场游戏是长时间的斗智。

ex.en: Kate paused and gathered her wits.
ex.cn: 凯特停下来恢复一下理智。

ex.en: a chance to pit your wits against (= compete with, using your intelligence) our quiz champion
ex.cn: 用你的智慧同我们的知识竞赛冠军进行较量的机会

senses.def: having the type of intelligence mentioned

ex.en: a quick-witted group of students
ex.cn: 一群头脑聪明的学生

senses.def: the intelligence or good sense to know what is the right thing to do

ex.en: At least you had the wit to ask for help.
ex.cn: 你起码还能意识到要求救。

ex.en: It should not be beyond the wit of man to resolve this dispute.
ex.cn: 解决这一纠纷应当是人力所能及的事。

senses.def: to be so worried by a problem that you do not know what to do next
senses.chn: 智穷计尽；全然不知所措

senses.def: to be very frightened
to be aware of what is happening around you and ready to think and act quickly
senses.chn: 时刻保持头脑冷静；随机应变

senses.def: you use to wit when you are about to be more exact about sth that you have just referred to

ex.en: Pilot error, to wit failure to follow procedures, was the cause of the accident.
ex.cn: 飞行员的失误，即没有遵守操作程序，是事故的原因。

senses.def: to earn money by clever or sometimes dishonest means
senses.chn: 靠耍小聪明赚钱；（有时）靠玩花招捞钱

senses.def: a woman who is believed to have magic powers, especially to do evil things. In stories, she usually wears a black pointed hat and flies on a broomstick.
an ugly unpleasant old woman
an unpleasant drink that is a mixture of different things
the use of magic powers, especially evil ones
(especially in Africa) a person who is believed to have special magic powers that can be used to heal people
a liquid that is used for treating injuries on the skin
senses.chn: 金缕梅酊剂（用于治疗皮肤创伤）

senses.def: an attempt to find and punish people who hold opinions that are thought to be unacceptable or dangerous to society
senses.chn: （对被认为持不为社会所接受或危及社会政见者的）搜捕，政治迫害

senses.def: in the company or presence of sb/sth

ex.en: She lives with her parents.
ex.cn: 她同父母住在一起。

ex.en: I have a client with me right now.
ex.cn: 我现在有个客户。

ex.en: a nice steak with a bottle of red wine
ex.cn: 一份美味牛排再加上一瓶红葡萄酒

senses.def: having or carrying sth

ex.en: a girl with (= who has) red hair
ex.cn: 一位红发女郎

ex.en: a jacket with a hood
ex.cn: 带风帽的短上衣

ex.en: He looked at her with a hurt expression.
ex.cn: 他带着受伤害的神情看着她。

ex.en: They're both in bed with flu.
ex.cn: 他们双双患流感卧病在床。

ex.en: a man with a suitcase
ex.cn: 提行李箱的男子

senses.def: using sth

ex.en: Cut it with a knife.
ex.cn: 用刀把它切开。

ex.en: It is treated with acid before being analysed.
ex.cn: 对它先用酸处理再进行分析。

senses.def: used to say what fills, covers, etc. sth

ex.en: The bag was stuffed with dirty clothes.
ex.cn: 袋子里塞满了脏衣服。

ex.en: Sprinkle the dish with salt.
ex.cn: 在这盘菜上撒上盐。

senses.def: in opposition to sb/sth; against sb/sth

ex.en: to fight with sb
ex.cn: 与某人打架

ex.en: to play tennis with sb
ex.cn: 与某人打网球

ex.en: at war with a neighbouring country
ex.cn: 与邻国交战

ex.en: I had an argument with my boss.
ex.cn: 我跟老板吵了一架。

senses.def: concerning; in the case of

ex.en: Be careful with the glasses.
ex.cn: 小心这些玻璃杯。

ex.en: Are you pleased with the result?
ex.cn: 你对结果满意吗？

ex.en: Don't be angry with her.
ex.cn: 别生她的气。

ex.en: With these students it's pronunciation that's the problem.
ex.cn: 对这些学生来说，成问题的是发音。

senses.def: used when considering one fact in relation to another

ex.en: She won't be able to help us with all the family commitments she has.
ex.cn: 她有这么多家务事，帮不了我们。

ex.en: It's much easier compared with last time.
ex.cn: 这与上次相比容易得多。

senses.def: including

ex.en: The meal with wine came to $20 each.
ex.cn: 包括酒这顿饭每人 20 美元。

ex.en: With all the lesson preparation I have to do I work 12 hours a day.
ex.cn: 加上必须的备课在内，我每天工作 12 个小时。

senses.def: used to show the way in which sb does sth

ex.en: He behaved with great dignity.
ex.cn: 他举止庄重威严。

ex.en: She sleeps with the window open.
ex.cn: 她爱开着窗户睡觉。

ex.en: Don't stand with your hands in your pockets.
ex.cn: 站着的时候别把双手插在口袋里。

senses.def: because of; as a result of

ex.en: She blushed with embarrassment.
ex.cn: 她难为情得脸红了。

ex.en: His fingers were numb with cold.
ex.cn: 他的手指冻麻了。

senses.def: because of sth and as it happens

ex.en: The shadows lengthened with the approach of sunset.
ex.cn: 随着太阳西沉，影子越来越长。

ex.en: Skill comes with practice.
ex.cn: 熟能生巧。

senses.def: in the same direction as sth

ex.en: Marine mammals generally swim with the current.
ex.cn: 海洋哺乳动物一般顺水而游。

senses.def: used to show who has possession of or responsibility for sth

ex.en: The keys are with reception.
ex.cn: 钥匙在服务台。

ex.en: Leave it with me.
ex.cn: 把这交给我吧。

senses.def: employed by; using the services of
senses.chn: 为…工作；受雇于；利用…的服务

ex.en: She acted with a touring company for three years.
ex.cn: 她在一巡回剧团里演出了三年。

ex.en: I bank with HSBC.
ex.cn: 我的钱存在汇丰银行里。

senses.def: showing separation from sth/sb

ex.en: I could never part with this ring.
ex.cn: 我永远也不摘掉这枚戒指。

ex.en: Can we dispense with the formalities?
ex.cn: 我们可以免去这些客套吗？

senses.def: despite sth

ex.en: With all her faults I still love her.
ex.cn: 尽管她有种种缺点，我依然爱着她。

senses.def: used in exclamations

ex.en: Off to bed with you!
ex.cn: 你给我睡觉去！

ex.en: Down with school!
ex.cn: 取缔学校！

senses.def: to be able to understand what sb is talking about

ex.en: Are you with me?
ex.cn: 你明白我说的话吗？

ex.en: I'm afraid I'm not quite with you.
ex.cn: 对不起，我不太懂你的意思。

senses.def: to support sb and agree with what they say
senses.chn: 支持；与…站在一起；同意…说的话

ex.en: We're all with you on this one.
ex.cn: 在这个问题上我们都支持你。

senses.def: knowing about current fashions and ideas

ex.en: Don't you have anything more with it to wear?
ex.cn: 难道你没有更时髦一点儿的衣服穿？

senses.def: understanding what is happening around you

ex.en: You don't seem very with it today.
ex.cn: 你今天脑瓜子似乎不太管用。

senses.def: straight after that; then

ex.en: He muttered a few words of apology and with that he left.
ex.cn: 他低声叽咕了几句道歉的话，然后就走了。

senses.def: very successfully

ex.en: The party went with a bang.
ex.cn: 聚会十分圆满。

senses.def: in a way that everyone notices; with a powerful effect

ex.en: The team won their last four games, ending the season with a bang.
ex.cn: 该队赢了最后四场比赛，给本赛季画了一个亮丽的句号。

senses.def: used to show that sth is interesting or unusual

ex.en: The traditional backpack with a difference—it's waterproof.
ex.cn: 这个传统背包有个与众不同的特点，它能防水。

with a flea in your ear.lemma: with a flea in your ear

senses.def: if sb sends a person away with a flea in their ear, they tell them angrily to go away
senses.chn: 以气愤的言语，以责难（把人轰走）

senses.def: that considers the needs of ordinary people
senses.chn: 考虑老百姓需要的；有人情味的；人性化的

ex.en: This was science with a human face.
ex.cn: 这是大众需要的科学。

senses.def: used when you are going to disagree, usually quite strongly, with sb
senses.chn: （通常在表示强烈不同意之前说）恕我直言

ex.en: With all due respect, the figures simply do not support you on this.
ex.cn: 恕我直言，这些数字根本不能支持你的观点。

senses.def: to a greater degree than is expected or usual
senses.chn: 程度更深地；出乎意料地

ex.en: She set to work with a vengeance.
ex.cn: 她加倍努力地工作起来。

senses.def: in a willing and enthusiastic way
feeling very anxious or excited

ex.en: We waited with bated breath for the winner to be announced.
ex.cn: 我们屏住呼吸等待宣布冠军是谁。

senses.def: quickly and efficiently
to move back or away from a place or situation; to make sb/sth do this

ex.en: Government troops were forced to withdraw.
ex.cn: 政府部队被迫撤走了。

ex.en: Both powers withdrew their forces from the region.
ex.cn: 两个大国都把部队撤离了这个地区。

ex.en: She withdrew her hand from his.
ex.cn: 她把手从他的手里抽了回来。

senses.def: to stop giving or offering sth to sb

ex.en: Workers have threatened to withdraw their labour (= go on strike).
ex.cn: 工人扬言要罢工。

ex.en: He withdrew his support for our campaign.
ex.cn: 他停止了对我们运动的支持。

ex.en: The drug was withdrawn from sale after a number of people suffered serious side effects.
ex.cn: 这药因许多人服后产生严重副作用而被停止销售。

senses.def: to stop taking part in an activity or being a member of an organization; to stop sb/sth from doing these things

ex.en: There have been calls for Britain to withdraw from the EU.
ex.cn: 一直有人呼吁英国退出欧盟。

ex.en: The horse had been withdrawn from the race.
ex.cn: 那匹马被停赛了。

senses.def: to take money out of a bank account

ex.en: I'd like to withdraw £250 please.
ex.cn: 劳驾，我想提取 250 英镑。

senses.def: to say that you no longer believe that sth you previously said is true
senses.chn: 收回，撤回，撤销（说过的话）

ex.en: The newspaper withdrew the allegations the next day.
ex.cn: 这家报纸第二天收回了这些说法。

senses.def: to become quieter and spend less time with other people

ex.en: She's beginning to withdraw into herself.
ex.cn: 她开始变得不爱与人交往了。

example.en: Both powers withdrew their forces from the region.
example.cn: 两个大国都把部队撤离了这个地区。

example.en: Workers have threatened to withdraw their labour (= go on strike).
example.cn: 工人扬言要罢工。

example.en: The drug was withdrawn from sale after a number of people suffered serious side effects.
example.cn: 这药因许多人服后产生严重副作用而被停止销售。

example.en: There have been calls for Britain to withdraw from the EU.
example.cn: 一直有人呼吁英国退出欧盟。

example.en: The horse had been withdrawn from the race.
example.cn: 那匹马被停赛了。

senses.def: the act of moving or taking sth away or back

ex.en: the withdrawal of support
ex.cn: 不再支持

ex.en: the withdrawal of the UN troops from the region
ex.cn: 联合国部队从该地区的撤离

ex.en: the withdrawal of a product from the market
ex.cn: 从市场上召回一种产品

senses.def: the act of no longer taking part in sth or being a member of an organization

ex.en: his withdrawal from the election
ex.cn: 他从选举中退出

ex.en: a campaign for Britain's withdrawal from the EU
ex.cn: 争取英国退出欧盟的运动

senses.def: the act of taking an amount of money out of your bank account

ex.en: You can make withdrawals of up to $250 a day.
ex.cn: 你一天可以从银行账户中提取最多不超过 250 美元。

senses.def: the period of time when sb is getting used to not taking a drug that they have become addicted to, and the unpleasant effects of doing this

ex.en: I got withdrawal symptoms after giving up smoking.
ex.cn: 我戒烟之后出现了脱瘾症状。

senses.def: the act of saying that you no longer believe that sth you have previously said is true

ex.en: The newspaper published a withdrawal the next day.
ex.cn: 报纸第二天发表了撤销声明。

senses.def: the behaviour of sb who wants to be alone and does not want to communicate with other people
not wanting to talk to other people; extremely quiet and shy
senses.chn: 沉默寡言的；怕羞的；内向的

senses.def: if a plant withers or sth withers it, it dries up and dies

ex.en: The grass had withered in the warm sun.
ex.cn: 这些草在温暖的阳光下枯死了。

senses.def: to become less or weaker, especially before disappearing completely
senses.chn: 萎缩；（尤指渐渐）破灭，消失

ex.en: All our hopes just withered away.
ex.cn: 我们所有的希望都渐渐破灭了。

senses.def: dried up and dead

ex.en: withered leaves
ex.cn: 枯叶

senses.def: looking old because they are thin and weak and have very dry skin
senses.chn: 衰老憔悴的；枯槁的；干瘪的

senses.def: thin and weak and not fully developed because of disease
senses.chn: 瘦弱的；发育不良的；病态的

ex.en: withered limbs
ex.cn: 干瘪的四肢

senses.def: intended to make sb feel silly or ashamed
senses.chn: 尖刻的；使人难堪的；令人无地自容的

ex.en: withering scorn
ex.cn: 使人难堪的轻蔑

ex.en: She gave him a withering look.
ex.cn: 她极其蔑视地看了他一眼。

senses.def: the highest part of a horse's back, between its shoulders
senses.chn: 鬐甲（马肩胛骨间隆起部分）

senses.def: very well; with a very high mark/grade

ex.en: She passed the exam with flying colours.
ex.cn: 她以优异成绩通过了考试。

senses.def: without thinking about the results or effects of a particular action
without giving your full attention to what is being said, etc.
to refuse to give sth to sb

ex.en: She was accused of withholding information from the police.
ex.cn: 她被指控对警方知情不报。

senses.def: (in the US) an amount of money that an employer takes out of sb's income as tax and pays directly to the government
senses.chn: （美国由雇主从员工收入中扣除并直接交给政府的）须扣税款

senses.def: starting now; starting from…
senses.chn: 立即生效；从…起开始生效

ex.en: The government has cut interest rates with effect from the beginning of next month.
ex.cn: 政府已削减利率，从下月初开始生效。

senses.def: before a particular period of time has passed; during a particular period of time
senses.chn: 不出（某段时间）；在（某段时间）之内

ex.en: You should receive a reply within seven days.
ex.cn: 你会在七天之内收到答复。

ex.en: The ambulance arrived within minutes of the call being made.
ex.cn: 打电话后几分钟内救护车就到了。

ex.en: Two elections were held within the space of a year.
ex.cn: 在一年的时间之内举行了两次选举。

senses.def: not further than a particular distance from sth
senses.chn: 不出（某段距离）；在（某段距离）之间

ex.en: a house within a mile of the station
ex.cn: 离车站不到一英里的一所房子

ex.en: Is it within walking distance?
ex.cn: 那里步行走得到吗？

senses.def: inside the range or limits of sth
senses.chn: 不出（某范围或限度）；在（某范围）之内

ex.en: That question is not within the scope of this talk.
ex.cn: 那个问题不在本次会谈范围之内。

ex.en: We are now within range of enemy fire.
ex.cn: 我们现在处于敌人的火力射程以内。

ex.en: He finds it hard to live within his income (= without spending more than he earns).
ex.cn: 他觉得靠自己的收入生活难以为继。

senses.def: inside sth/sb

ex.en: The noise seems to be coming from within the building.
ex.cn: 吵闹声像是从楼房里传出来的。

ex.en: There is discontent within the farming industry.
ex.cn: 农业界内部存在不满。

senses.def: inside

ex.en: Cleaner required. Apply within. (= on a sign)
ex.cn: 招聘清洁工。应聘者请进。

senses.def: to some extent; with some restrictions
senses.chn: 在某种程度上；有一定限制

ex.en: I'm willing to help, within limits.
ex.cn: 我愿意帮忙，可有一定的限度。

senses.def: very close
knowing about current fashions and ideas

ex.en: Don't you have anything more with it to wear?
ex.cn: 难道你没有更时髦一点儿的衣服穿？

senses.def: understanding what is happening around you

ex.en: You don't seem very with it today.
ex.cn: 你今天脑瓜子似乎不太管用。

senses.def: used to say that sth is a more complicated version of what you mention
senses.chn: 有过之而无不及；更是如此；尤其突出

ex.en: It isn't art—it's just a horror movie with knobs on!
ex.cn: 那不是艺术，只是更加惊悚的恐怖片而已！

senses.def: with the deliberate intention of committing a crime or harming sb
if people do sth with one accord, they do it at the same time, because they agree with each other
as a group; with everyone agreeing

ex.en: The various opposition parties speak with one voice on this issue.
ex.cn: 在这个问题上各反对党派众口一词。

senses.def: if you welcome sb with open arms, you are extremely happy and pleased to see them
not having, experiencing or showing sth

ex.en: They had gone two days without food.
ex.cn: 他们两天没吃东西了。

ex.en: He found the place without difficulty.
ex.cn: 他毫不费力地找到了那地方。

ex.en: She spoke without much enthusiasm.
ex.cn: 她说话冷冰冰的。

senses.def: not in the company of sb

ex.en: Don't go without me.
ex.cn: 别甩下我就走。

senses.def: not using or taking sth

ex.en: Can you see without your glasses?
ex.cn: 你不戴眼镜能看见吗？

ex.en: Don't go out without your coat.
ex.cn: 别不穿大衣就出去。

senses.def: not doing the action mentioned

ex.en: He left without saying goodbye.
ex.cn: 他不辞而别。

ex.en: You can't make an omelette without breaking eggs.
ex.cn: 你不可能不打破鸡蛋就做成煎蛋卷。

ex.en: Without wanting to criticize, I think you could have done better. (= used before you make a critical comment)
ex.cn: 我不是想要批评谁，只是认为你本可以做得更好一些。

ex.en: The party was organized without her knowing anything about it.
ex.cn: 聚会已操办妥当，她却一无所知。

senses.def: not having or showing sth

ex.en: Do you want a room with a bath or one without?
ex.cn: 你要不要带洗澡间的房间？

ex.en: If there's none left we'll have to do without.
ex.cn: 如果没有剩余的我们就只得将就了。

ex.en: I'm sure we'll manage without.
ex.cn: 我相信我们能凑合的。

example.en: He left without saying goodbye.
example.cn: 他不辞而别。

example.en: The party was organized without her knowing anything about it.
example.cn: 聚会已操办妥当，她却一无所知。

senses.def: immediately; without stopping to think about sth further

ex.en: He dived in after her without a second thought.
ex.cn: 他不假思索地随她跳入水中。

senses.def: without stopping what you are doing
in a very rough or informal way
senses.chn: 粗鲁无礼；不拘礼节；随便

ex.en: He found himself pushed without ceremony out of the house and the door slammed in his face.
ex.cn: 他被毫不客气地推出屋子，门砰的一声当着他的面关上了。

senses.def: without objecting or hesitating

ex.en: They accepted without demur.
ex.cn: 他们接受了，没有提出异议。

senses.def: used to emphasize that the statement you are making is always true and everyone or everything is included

ex.en: All students without exception must take the English examination.
ex.cn: 所有学生都必须参加英语考试，无一例外。

senses.def: when you tell sb to do sth without fail, you are telling them that they must do it

ex.en: I want you here by two o'clock without fail.
ex.cn: 我要你两点钟务必来到这里。

senses.def: always

ex.en: He emails every week without fail.
ex.cn: 他每周必定发电子邮件。

senses.def: in a fair way
without being prevented from doing sth; freely
senses.chn: 毫无阻碍；顺畅地；自由地

senses.def: if there is no rhyme or reason to sth or it happens without rhyme or reason, it happens in a way that cannot be easily explained or understood
senses.chn: 毫无道理；无规律可循；莫名其妙

senses.def: used as a polite way of accepting or agreeing to sth
senses.chn: （客气地接受或同意）当然了，很愿意

ex.en: 'May I sit here?' 'Yes, with pleasure.'
ex.cn: “我可以坐在这儿吗？” “当然可以。”

senses.def: used to describe an insurance policy or an investment where the amount paid includes a share in the company's profits
senses.chn: （保单或投资）分红的，共享利润的

senses.def: used when you are going to disagree, usually quite strongly, with sb
senses.chn: （通常在表示强烈不同意之前说）恕我直言

ex.en: With all due respect, the figures simply do not support you on this.
ex.cn: 恕我直言，这些数字根本不能支持你的观点。

senses.def: concerning

ex.en: The two groups were similar with respect to income and status.
ex.cn: 这两组在收入和地位方面是相似的。

senses.def: to be strong enough not to be hurt or damaged by extreme conditions, the use of force, etc.

ex.en: The materials used have to be able to withstand high temperatures.
ex.cn: 所使用的材料必须能够耐高温。

ex.en: They had withstood siege, hunger and deprivation.
ex.cn: 他们经受了围困、饥饿和贫穷。

senses.def: straight after that; then

ex.en: He muttered a few words of apology and with that he left.
ex.cn: 他低声叽咕了几句道歉的话，然后就走了。

with the best will in the world.lemma: with the best will in the world

senses.def: used to say that you cannot do sth, even though you really want to
senses.chn: 尽管已尽心竭力；尽管真心愿意

ex.en: With the best will in the world I could not describe him as a good father.
ex.cn: 尽管我心里极想美言几句，却怎么也不能说他是位好父亲。

with the pedal to the metal.lemma: with the pedal to the metal

senses.def: (to go) at full speed; (to drive) with the accelerator of the car pressed to the floor
senses.chn: 全速（前进）；（开车时）将油门踩到底

ex.en: We drove through the night flat-out, with the pedal to the metal.
ex.cn: 我们将油门踩到底，在夜色里全速前进。

senses.def: to use as much effort as possible; with as much effort as possible

ex.en: I'm still putting the pedal to the metal here at work.
ex.cn: 我还在这里竭尽全力地工作。

senses.def: when the sun rises or sets

ex.en: I get up with the sun.
ex.cn: 我日出即起。

senses.def: if you say sth with your tongue in your cheek, you are not being serious and mean it as a joke
without weapons or tools

ex.en: He was capable of killing a man with his bare hands.
ex.cn: 他赤手空拳就能取人性命。

senses.def: fully aware of the possible problems or results of a particular course of action
senses.chn: 明知后果如何；明知有问题；心中有数

ex.en: I went into this with my eyes open so I guess I only have myself to blame.
ex.cn: 我是明明知道做这事的后果的，所以我想只能责怪我自己。

with your nose in the air.lemma: with your nose in the air

senses.def: in a way that is unfriendly and suggests that you think that you are better than other people
senses.chn: 傲慢；看不起人；鼻孔朝天，自高自大

with your tail between your legs.lemma: with your tail between your legs

senses.def: feeling ashamed or unhappy because you have been defeated or punished
senses.chn: 无地自容；垂头丧气；灰溜溜

with your tongue in your cheek.lemma: with your tongue in your cheek

senses.def: if you say sth with your tongue in your cheek, you are not being serious and mean it as a joke
silly or stupid; not sensible
to be extremely frightened or bored
senses.chn: 被吓破了胆；乏味得要命

senses.def: a person who sees sth happen and is able to describe it to other people

ex.en: Police have appealed for witnesses to the accident.
ex.cn: 警方呼吁这起事故的目击者出来作证。

ex.en: a witness to the killing
ex.cn: 杀人案的目击证人

senses.def: a person who gives evidence in court

ex.en: a defence/prosecution witness
ex.cn: 被告的／控方的证人

ex.en: to appear as (a) witness for the defence/prosecution
ex.cn: 出庭为被告／控方作证

ex.en: Police have appealed for witnesses to the accident.
ex.cn: 警方呼吁这起事故的目击者出来作证。

ex.en: According to observers, the plane exploded shortly after take-off.
ex.cn: 据目击者说，飞机起飞后不久就爆炸了。

ex.en: A crowd of onlookers gathered at the scene of the crash.
ex.cn: 在撞车地点聚集了一大群围观者。

ex.en: Police asked passers-by if they had witnessed the accident.
ex.cn: 警察询问过路的人是否目击了这次事故。

senses.def: a person who is present when an official document is signed and who also signs it to prove that they saw this happen

ex.en: He was one of the witnesses at our wedding.
ex.cn: 他是我们婚礼的证婚人之一。

senses.def: evidence of a person's strong religious beliefs, that they show by what they say and do in public
to see sth take place

ex.en: He has been witness to a terrible murder.
ex.cn: 他目击了一起残忍的凶杀事件。

senses.def: to show that sth is true; to provide evidence for sth

ex.en: His good health is a witness to the success of the treatment.
ex.cn: 他身体健康证明这种疗法是成功的。

senses.def: to provide evidence of the truth of sth
to see sth happen (typically a crime or an accident)
senses.chn: 当场看到，目击（尤指罪行或事故）

ex.en: She was shocked by the violent scenes she had witnessed.
ex.cn: 她被亲眼目睹的暴虐场面惊呆了。

ex.en: Police have appealed for anyone who witnessed the incident to contact them.
ex.cn: 警方呼吁凡是目击这一事件的人与他们联系。

ex.en: We are now witnessing an unprecedented increase in violent crime.
ex.cn: 我们现在亲眼看到暴力犯罪空前增多。

ex.en: The first thing I noticed about the room was the smell.
ex.cn: 我首先注意到的是这屋子里的气味。

ex.en: Please note (that) the office will be closed on Monday.
ex.cn: 请注意办事处星期一将关闭。

ex.en: Note that the prices are inclusive of VAT.
ex.cn: 注意这些价格含增值税。

senses.def: to be the place, period, organization, etc. in which particular events take place
senses.chn: 是发生…的地点（或时间、组织等）；见证

ex.en: Recent years have witnessed a growing social mobility.
ex.cn: 近年来人们的社会流动性越来越大。

ex.en: The retail trade is witnessing a sharp fall in sales.
ex.cn: 零售业的销售额在急剧下降。

senses.def: to be present when an official document is signed and sign it yourself to prove that you saw this happen
senses.chn: （为正式文件的签署）作证，联署

ex.en: to witness a signature
ex.cn: 联署作证

senses.def: to be a sign or proof of sth

ex.en: There has been increasing interest in her life and work, as witnessed by the publication of two new biographies.
ex.cn: 从两部新传记的出版可以看出，人们对她的生活和工作越来越感兴趣。

ex.en: The huge attendance figures for the exhibition witness to a healthy interest in modern art.
ex.cn: 从展览会参观人数之多可以看出，人们对现代艺术具有浓厚兴趣。

senses.def: used when giving an example that proves sth you have just said

ex.en: Authentic Italian cooking is very healthy—witness the low incidence of heart disease in Italy.
ex.cn: 正宗的意大利烹饪对健康非常有益，在意大利心脏病发病率低就是证据。

senses.def: to speak to people about your strong religious beliefs

example.en: The huge attendance figures for the exhibition witness to a healthy interest in modern art.
example.cn: 从展览会参观人数之多可以看出，人们对现代艺术具有浓厚兴趣。

senses.def: the place in court where people stand to give evidence
to talk about sth unimportant and boring for a long time

ex.en: What's he wittering on about?
ex.cn: 他在唠叨什么？

senses.def: a clever and amusing remark
in a way that shows that you are aware of what you are doing

ex.en: It was clear that, wittingly or unwittingly, he had offended her.
ex.cn: 很显然，不管是有意还是无意，他反正得罪了她。

senses.def: able to say or write clever, amusing things
senses.chn: 言辞诙谐的；巧妙的；妙趣横生的；机智的

ex.en: a witty speaker
ex.cn: 幽默的演讲人

ex.en: a witty remark
ex.cn: 机智的话

ex.en: a funny story
ex.cn: 滑稽的故事

ex.en: He was a very funny guy.
ex.cn: 他这个人很滑稽。

ex.en: It's a very amusing game to play.
ex.cn: 这种游戏玩起来非常有趣。

ex.en: It was a very entertaining evening.
ex.cn: 那是一场非常令人开心的晚会。

senses.def: (in stories) a man with magic powers
a person who is especially good at sth

ex.en: a computer/financial, etc. wizard
ex.cn: 计算机、金融等奇才

senses.def: a program that makes it easy to use another program or perform a task by giving you a series of simple choices
a very impressive and clever achievement; great skill
senses.chn: 杰出的成就；非凡的才能

ex.en: electronic wizardry
ex.cn: 电子方面的非凡才能

ex.en: The second goal was sheer wizardry.
ex.cn: 第二记入球真是神奇。

senses.def: looking smaller and having many folds and lines in the skin, because of being old
senses.chn: （由于年老）干瘪的，多皱的，干枯的

ex.en: a wizened little man
ex.cn: 干瘪的小老头

ex.en: wizened apples
ex.cn: 皱瘪的苹果

senses.def: wireless local area network (a system for communicating by computer within a large building or group of buildings, that does not use wires)
senses.chn: 无线局域网（全写为 wireless local area network）

senses.def: would like to meet (used in personal advertisements)
senses.chn: （用于个人广告）愿意见面，希望见面

senses.def: weapon of mass destruction
a blue substance that people used to paint their bodies and faces with in ancient times
senses.chn: 靛蓝（古时人们用来涂染身体和脸）

senses.def: to move from side to side in an unsteady way; to make sth do this

ex.en: This chair wobbles.
ex.cn: 这把椅子不稳。

senses.def: to make a material into a particular shape or form by pressing, stretching, hitting it, etc.
senses.chn: （通过压挤、拉长、锤击等）使成形，使定形

ex.en: to work clay
ex.cn: 制陶

ex.en: to work gold
ex.cn: 打制金器

ex.en: to work the mixture into a paste
ex.cn: 把混合物调成糊状

senses.def: to use a particular material to produce a picture or other item
senses.chn: 用某种材料作画（或编制、编织等）

ex.en: an artist working in oils
ex.cn: 油画画家

ex.en: a craftsman working with wool
ex.cn: 毛织手工艺人

senses.def: to move violently

ex.en: He stared at me in horror, his mouth working.
ex.cn: 他恐惧地盯着我，嘴在抽搐着。

senses.def: to move or pass to a particular place or state, usually gradually
senses.chn: （逐渐地）移动（到某位置）；（逐步）变成（某状态）

ex.en: It will take a while for the drug to work out of your system.
ex.cn: 这药需要一段时间才能从你体内排出。

ex.en: He worked his way to the top of his profession.
ex.cn: 他一步一步努力，终于成为行业内的翘楚。

ex.en: I was tied up, but managed to work myself free.
ex.cn: 我被捆绑起来，但设法挣脱了绳索。

ex.en: The screw had worked loose.
ex.cn: 这螺丝钉松动了。

senses.def: to arrange sth in a particular way, especially by being clever

ex.en: Can you work it so that we get free tickets?
ex.cn: 你能不能为我们搞到些免费票？

senses.def: to gradually turn a conversation towards a particular topic, subject, etc.

ex.en: It was some time before he worked around to what he really wanted to say.
ex.cn: 他东拉西扯了一会才绕到真正要说的事情上来。

senses.def: to make great efforts to achieve sth or do sth well

ex.en: He's working at losing weight.
ex.cn: 他正在努力减肥。

ex.en: Learning to play the piano isn't easy. You have to work at it.
ex.cn: 学弹钢琴不容易，你非得下功夫不可。

senses.def: to try to include sth

ex.en: Can't you work a few more jokes into your speech?
ex.cn: 难道你就不能在讲话中再增加几句笑话吗？

senses.def: to add one substance to another and mix them together

ex.en: Gradually work in the butter.
ex.cn: 逐渐掺进黄油。

senses.def: to get rid of sth, especially a strong feeling, by using physical effort

ex.en: She worked off her anger by going for a walk.
ex.cn: 她散散步气就消了。

senses.def: to earn money in order to be able to pay a debt

ex.en: They had a large bank loan to work off.
ex.cn: 他们有一大笔银行贷款需要偿还。

senses.def: to try to persuade sb to agree to sth or to do sth
senses.chn: 努力说服（使某人答应或做某事）

ex.en: He hasn't said he'll do it yet, but I'm working on him.
ex.cn: 他还没说他会做这事，不过我正在设法说服他。

senses.def: to try hard to improve or achieve sth

ex.en: You need to work on your pronunciation a bit more.
ex.cn: 你需要再加把劲改进发音。

ex.en: 'Have you sorted out a babysitter yet?' 'No, but I'm working on it.'
ex.cn: “你找到临时看孩子的保姆了吗？” “还没有，我正在找呢。”

senses.def: to train the body by physical exercise

ex.en: I work out regularly to keep fit.
ex.cn: 我经常做运动以保持健康。

senses.def: to develop in a successful way

ex.en: My first job didn't work out.
ex.cn: 我的第一份工作干得不好。

ex.en: Things have worked out quite well for us.
ex.cn: 事情的结果对我们很不错。

senses.def: if sth works out at sth, you calculate that it will be a particular amount

ex.en: It'll work out cheaper to travel by bus.
ex.cn: 算来还是乘公共汽车便宜些。

senses.def: to understand sb's character

ex.en: I've never been able to work her out.
ex.cn: 我从未能摸准她的秉性。

senses.def: to calculate sth

ex.en: to work out the answer
ex.cn: 计算出答案

senses.def: to find the answer to sth

ex.en: to work out a problem
ex.cn: 解决问题

ex.en: Can you work out what these squiggles mean?
ex.cn: 你能辨认出这些潦草的字迹是什么意思吗？

ex.en: I couldn't work out where the music was coming from.
ex.cn: 我弄不清这音乐是从哪里传来的。

senses.def: to plan or think of sth

ex.en: I've worked out a new way of doing it.
ex.cn: 我想出了做这事的一个新方法。

senses.def: to remove all the coal, minerals, etc. from a mine over a period of time

ex.en: a worked-out silver mine
ex.cn: 开采光了的银矿

senses.def: to attack sb and hit them, for example to make them give you information
to follow a plan, schedule, etc.
senses.chn: 按照（计划、时间表等）；根据…行事

ex.en: to work to a budget
ex.cn: 按照预算办事

ex.en: We're working to a very tight deadline (= we have little time in which to do the work).
ex.cn: 我们的工期很紧。

senses.def: to try to reach or achieve a goal
senses.chn: 努力达到，设法完成（目标）

senses.def: to develop or improve sth with some effort

ex.en: I can't work up any enthusiasm for his idea.
ex.cn: 我对他的想法怎么也热心不起来。

ex.en: She went for a long walk to work up an appetite.
ex.cn: 她为了增加食欲散步了很长时间。

senses.def: to make sb/yourself reach a state of great excitement, anger, etc.

ex.en: Don't work yourself up into a state about it. It isn't worth it.
ex.cn: 别为此大动肝火。这不值得。

ex.en: What are you so worked up about?
ex.cn: 什么事使得你这么激动？

senses.def: to bring sth to a more complete or more acceptable state

ex.en: I'm working my notes up into a dissertation.
ex.cn: 我正在把我的笔记整理成一篇论文。

senses.def: to develop or move gradually towards sth, usually sth more exciting or extreme
senses.chn: 逐步发展到，逐渐达到（更高或更深的程度）

ex.en: The music worked up to a rousing finale.
ex.cn: 乐曲渐变到一个激动人心的末乐章。

ex.en: I began by jogging in the park and worked up to running five miles a day.
ex.cn: 我开始在公园里慢跑，后来逐渐增加到一天跑五英里。

senses.def: the job that a person does especially in order to earn money

ex.en: She had been out of work (= without a job) for a year.
ex.cn: 她已经失业一年了。

ex.en: They are in work (= have a job).
ex.cn: 他们有工作。

ex.en: He started work as a security guard.
ex.cn: 他开始工作时做保安员。

ex.en: It is difficult to find work in the present economic climate.
ex.cn: 在目前这种经济大气候下很难找到工作。

ex.en: I'm still looking for work.
ex.cn: 我仍在找工作。

ex.en: She's planning to return to work once the children start school.
ex.cn: 她正计划孩子一入学就恢复上班。

senses.def: the duties that you have and the activities that you do as part of your job

ex.en: Police work is mainly routine.
ex.cn: 警察的工作主要都是按常规的。

ex.en: The accountant described his work to the sales staff.
ex.cn: 会计师向销售部的职员介绍了自己的职责。

senses.def: tasks that need to be done

ex.en: There is plenty of work to be done in the garden.
ex.cn: 花园里有很多活儿要干。

ex.en: Taking care of a baby is hard work.
ex.cn: 照看婴儿是件苦差。

ex.en: I have some work for you to do.
ex.cn: 我有些事要你做。

ex.en: Stop talking and get on with your work.
ex.cn: 别说话了，继续干你们的活儿吧。

senses.def: materials needed or used for doing work, especially books, papers, etc.
senses.chn: 工作所需的材料（或档案等）

ex.en: She often brings work (= for example, files and documents) home with her from the office.
ex.cn: 她经常把办公室里的工作带回家。

ex.en: His work was spread all over the floor.
ex.cn: 他工作的材料摊了一地。

senses.def: the place where you do your job
senses.chn: 工作地点；工作单位；工作场所

ex.en: I go to work at 8 o'clock.
ex.cn: 我 8 点钟去上班。

ex.en: When do you leave for work?
ex.cn: 你什么时候去上班？

ex.en: The new legislation concerns health and safety at work.
ex.cn: 这项新法规涉及工作场所的健康与安全。

ex.en: I have to leave work early today.
ex.cn: 我今天得早点儿下班。

ex.en: Her friends from work came to see her in the hospital.
ex.cn: 她工作单位的朋友来医院看望她。

senses.def: the use of physical strength or mental power in order to do or make sth

ex.en: She earned her grades through sheer hard work.
ex.cn: 她的学习成绩完全是靠刻苦用功得来的。

ex.en: We started work on the project in 2009.
ex.cn: 我们从 2009 年开始干这个项目。

ex.en: Work continues on renovating the hotel.
ex.cn: 修整这家旅馆的工作在继续。

ex.en: The work of building the bridge took six months.
ex.cn: 修建这座桥的工作用了六个月的时间。

ex.en: The art collection was his life's work.
ex.cn: 收集艺术品是他一生的工作。

ex.en: She set them to work painting the fence.
ex.cn: 她让他们粉刷围墙。

senses.def: a thing or things that are produced as a result of work

ex.en: She's an artist whose work I really admire.
ex.cn: 她这位艺术家的作品令我赞赏不已。

ex.en: Is this all your own work (= did you do it without help from others)?
ex.cn: 这件作品是你独立完成的吗？

ex.en: The book is a detailed and thorough piece of work covering all aspects of the subject.
ex.cn: 这本书包括了这一学科的方方面面，是一部缜密翔实的大作。

senses.def: the result of an action; what is done by sb

ex.en: The damage is clearly the work of vandals.
ex.cn: 这毁损显然是些恣意破坏公物的人所为。

senses.def: a book, piece of music, painting, etc.

ex.en: the collected/complete works of Tolstoy
ex.cn: 托尔斯泰选集／全集

ex.en: works of fiction/literature
ex.cn: 小说／文学作品

ex.en: Beethoven's piano works
ex.cn: 贝多芬的钢琴曲

senses.def: activities involving building or repairing sth

ex.en: roadworks
ex.cn: 道路施工

ex.en: They expanded the shipyards and started engineering works.
ex.cn: 他们扩建造船厂，开始了工程施工。

senses.def: a place where things are made or industrial processes take place

ex.en: an engineering works
ex.cn: 机器制造厂

ex.en: a brickworks
ex.cn: 砖厂

ex.en: a chocolate/cigarette/clothing factory
ex.cn: 巧克力厂；香烟厂；制衣厂

ex.en: a nuclear power plant
ex.cn: 核电厂

ex.en: a manufacturing plant
ex.cn: 制造厂

ex.en: a cotton/paper/textile/woollen mill
ex.cn: 棉纺厂；造纸厂；纺织厂；毛纺厂

senses.def: the moving parts of a machine, etc.
everything

ex.en: We went to the chip shop and had the works: fish, chips, gherkins, mushy peas.
ex.cn: 我们去薯条店吃了套餐：炸鱼、炸薯条、小黄瓜、豆泥。

senses.def: the use of force to produce movement
it is not healthy to spend all your time working; you need to relax too
senses.chn: 只工作不玩耍，聪明的孩子也变傻

senses.def: having an effect on sth

ex.en: She suspected that secret influences were at work.
ex.cn: 她怀疑有些秘密势力在作祟。

senses.def: busy doing sth

ex.en: He is still at work on the painting.
ex.cn: 他仍在忙着画那幅画。

ex.en: Danger—men at work.
ex.cn: 危险——施工进行中。

senses.def: to begin; to make a start

ex.en: We set to work on the outside of the house (= for example, painting it).
ex.cn: 我们从屋子的外部开始干了起来。

senses.def: to give or tell sb everything
kind acts to help others
to do/start to do your work
senses.chn: 做（或着手做）自己的工作

ex.en: She went cheerfully about her work.
ex.cn: 她高高兴兴地做自己的工作。

senses.def: to be likely to have difficulty doing sth

ex.en: You'll have your work cut out to get there by nine o'clock.
ex.cn: 你九点钟前赶到那里可不容易。

senses.def: something that is in the works is being discussed, planned or prepared and will happen or exist soon
senses.chn: 在讨论（或计划、筹备等）中；在酝酿中

senses.def: a thing that takes a very short time to do
part of your normal working life and not unusual
senses.chn: 日常工作的一部分；习以为常；不足为奇

senses.def: people who do not have enough to do often start to do wrong

ex.en: She blamed the crimes on the local jobless teenagers. 'The devil makes work for idle hands,' she would say.
ex.cn: 她认为那些违法活动是当地的无业青少年所为，总是说：“人一闲，惹麻烦。”

senses.def: (to do) the unpleasant or dishonest jobs that sb else does not want to do
senses.chn: （干）没人愿干的事，卑鄙的勾当

senses.def: used to say that a job is made easier if a lot of people help
senses.chn: 人多好办事；众人拾柴火焰高

senses.def: to use more time or energy on a task than is necessary
senses.chn: 在某事上耗费过多时间（或精力）；费冤枉力

senses.def: needing too much effort

ex.en: I can't be bothered making a hot meal—it's too much like hard work.
ex.cn: 我懒得做热饭热菜，太麻烦了。

senses.def: work that you are paid to do or that must be done
senses.chn: 分内的事；必须干的工作

ex.en: There was a job of work waiting for him that he was not looking forward to.
ex.cn: 有一件他不想干但又必须完成的工作在等待着他。

senses.def: to do sth quickly and with little effort
a person who is unpleasant, unkind or dishonest
senses.chn: 恶棍；令人讨厌的人；靠不住的人

senses.def: used to show you are pleased when sb has done sth well

ex.en: You did a good job today. Nice work, James!
ex.cn: 你今天干得不错。好样的，詹姆斯！

senses.def: used when you wish that you had sb's success or good luck and think they have achieved it with little effort
senses.chn: （认为对方耕耘少，收获多）能有这样的好事儿就好了

senses.def: to defeat, deal with sth/sb quickly
senses.chn: 干净利落地打败（或处理）；三下五除二就打垮（或解决）

ex.en: Liverpool made short work of the opposition (= in a football/soccer game).
ex.cn: 利物浦队干净利落地击败了对手。

ex.en: He made short work of his lunch (= ate it quickly).
ex.cn: 他三下两下吃完午饭。

senses.def: (to cause) a delay or problem with sth that sb is planning or doing

example.en: I've been working at my assignment all day.
example.cn: 我整天都在做作业。

example.en: He is working on a new novel.
example.cn: 他正在写一部新小说。

example.en: Doctors often work very long hours.
example.cn: 医生经常长时间工作。

example.en: She works for an engineering company.
example.cn: 她在一家工程公司工作。

example.en: I've always worked in education.
example.cn: 我一直从事教育工作。

example.en: Do you enjoy working with children?
example.cn: 你喜欢做儿童工作吗？

example.en: My son is working as a teacher.
example.cn: 我的儿子是当老师的。

example.en: She dedicated her life to working for peace.
example.cn: 她为争取和平奉献了自己的一生。

example.en: The committee is working to get the prisoners freed.
example.cn: 委员会正在设法营救那些被监禁的人出狱。

example.en: His charm doesn't work on me (= does not affect or impress me).
example.cn: 我不为他的魅力所动。

example.en: Your age can work against you in this job.
example.cn: 你的年纪会妨碍你干这个工作。

example.en: Speaking Italian should work in his favour.
example.cn: 会说意大利语应对他有好处。

example.en: to work the mixture into a paste
example.cn: 把混合物调成糊状

example.en: It will take a while for the drug to work out of your system.
example.cn: 这药需要一段时间才能从你体内排出。

example.en: He worked his way to the top of his profession.
example.cn: 他一步一步努力，终于成为行业内的翘楚。

example.en: I was tied up, but managed to work myself free.
example.cn: 我被捆绑起来，但设法挣脱了绳索。

example.en: The screw had worked loose.
example.cn: 这螺丝钉松动了。

senses.def: that can be used successfully and effectively

ex.en: a workable plan
ex.cn: 切实可行的计划

senses.def: that you can shape, spread, dig, etc.
senses.chn: 可成形（或延长、挖掘等）的

ex.en: Add more water until the dough is workable.
ex.cn: 往面团里再加点儿水，直到能揉成形为止。

senses.def: that can still be used and will make a profit
ordinary; not very interesting
senses.chn: 普通的；平凡的；平淡无奇的

senses.def: a person who works very hard and finds it difficult to stop working and do other things
senses.chn: 工作狂；工作迷；醉心于工作的人

senses.def: a way of working with a piece of software in order to avoid a particular problem even though you do not solve that problem
senses.chn: （处理软件问题的）绕路，变通方法（虽不能解决问题，但能避开其不良影响）

senses.def: to make great efforts to achieve sth or do sth well

ex.en: He's working at losing weight.
ex.cn: 他正在努力减肥。

ex.en: Learning to play the piano isn't easy. You have to work at it.
ex.cn: 学弹钢琴不容易，你非得下功夫不可。

senses.def: a container for the things you need for sewing
a long heavy table used for doing practical jobs, working with tools, etc.
a book with exercises in it, often with spaces for students to write answers in, to help them practise what they have learnt
the part of a day during which you work
senses.chn: 工作日（一天中的工作时间）

ex.en: an 8-hour workday
ex.cn: 8 小时工作日

senses.def: very excited or upset about sth

ex.en: There's no point in getting worked up about it.
ex.cn: 为此大发脾气也无济于事。

senses.def: a person who works, especially one who does a particular kind of work

ex.en: farm/factory/office workers
ex.cn: 农场／工厂工人；职员

ex.en: rescue/aid/research workers
ex.cn: 救援／援助／研究人员

ex.en: temporary/part-time/casual workers
ex.cn: 临时工；兼职工；零工

ex.en: manual/skilled/unskilled workers
ex.cn: 体力劳动者；熟练／非熟练工人

senses.def: a person who is employed in a company or industry, especially sb who does physical work rather than organizing things or managing people

ex.en: Conflict between employers and workers intensified and the number of strikes rose.
ex.cn: 劳资矛盾加剧，罢工次数增多。

ex.en: talks between workers and management
ex.cn: 劳资谈判

senses.def: a person who works in a particular way

ex.en: a hard/fast/quick/slow worker
ex.cn: 做事努力／快／麻利／慢的人

senses.def: a female bee that helps do the work of the group of bees but does not reproduce
a person who knows how to get what they want quickly, especially when beginning a sexual relationship with sb
senses.chn: 善于迅速达到目的的人；（尤指恋爱方面）善于一下子获得青睐的人

senses.def: the work or jobs that you have done in your life so far

ex.en: The opportunities available will depend on your previous work experience and qualifications.
ex.cn: 能否有机会要看你的工作经历和学历。

senses.def: a period of time that a young person, especially a student, spends working in a company as a form of training
a system in which unemployed people have to work in order to get money for food, rent, etc. from the government
senses.chn: 工作福利制（领取福利金的失业者须要参与公益工作等）

senses.def: the series of stages that a particular piece or type of work passes through from the beginning until it is finished; the rate at which it passes through these stages
all the people who work for a particular company, organization, etc.

ex.en: The factory has a 1 000-strong workforce.
ex.cn: 这家工厂的职工多达千人。

ex.en: Two thirds of the workforce is/are women.
ex.cn: 职工中的三分之二是妇女。

senses.def: all the people in a country or an area who are available for work
senses.chn: （国家或行业等的）劳动力，劳动大军，劳动人口

ex.en: A quarter of the local workforce is/are unemployed.
ex.cn: 本地四分之一的劳动力都失业了。

senses.def: a person or machine that you can rely on to do hard and/or boring work
senses.chn: 埋头苦干的人；老黄牛（指吃苦耐劳的人）；耐用的机器

senses.def: (in Britain in the past) a building where very poor people were sent to live and given work to do
senses.chn: （英国旧时的）济贫院，劳动救济所

senses.def: having a job for which you are paid

ex.en: the working population
ex.cn: 劳动人口

ex.en: a working mother
ex.cn: 在职母亲

senses.def: having a job that involves hard physical work rather than office work, studying, etc.
senses.chn: 做工的；从事体力劳动的

ex.en: a working man
ex.cn: 工人

ex.en: a working men's club
ex.cn: 工人俱乐部

senses.def: connected with your job and the time you spend doing it

ex.en: long working hours
ex.cn: 长的工作时间

ex.en: poor working conditions
ex.cn: 恶劣的工作环境

ex.en: I have a good working relationship with my boss.
ex.cn: 我和老板的工作关系很好。

ex.en: She spent most of her working life as a teacher.
ex.cn: 她一生中大部分工作时间都当教师。

ex.en: recent changes in working practices
ex.cn: 工作做法方面最近的变化

senses.def: a working breakfast or lunch is one at which you discuss business
senses.chn: （早餐或午餐等）边吃边谈公事的

senses.def: used as a basis for work, discussion, etc. but likely to be changed or improved in the future

ex.en: a working theory
ex.cn: 初步的理论

ex.en: Have you decided on a working title for your thesis yet?
ex.cn: 你选了论文的暂定题目吗？

senses.def: if you have a working knowledge of sth, you can use it at a basic level
senses.chn: 尚可应付工作的；基本够用的

senses.def: the working parts of a machine are the parts that move in order to make it function
senses.chn: （机械部件）操纵用的，用于启动的

senses.def: a working majority is a small majority that is enough to enable a government to win votes in parliament and make new laws
working well

ex.en: The engine is now in perfect working order.
ex.cn: 发动机现在运转完全正常。

senses.def: the way in which a machine, a system, an organization, etc. works
senses.chn: （机器、系统、组织等的）运作，工作方法

ex.en: an introduction to the workings of Congress
ex.cn: 对国会运作方式的介绍

ex.en: the workings of the human mind
ex.cn: 人脑的活动方式

ex.en: the machine's inner workings
ex.cn: 这台机器的内部运转情况

senses.def: the parts of a mine or quarry where coal, metal, stone, etc. is or has been dug from the ground
senses.chn: （矿山或采石场的）矿，巷道，作业区

senses.def: the money that is needed to run a business rather than the money that is used to buy buildings and equipment when starting the business
senses.chn: 流动资本；运营资本；周转资金

senses.def: the part of a day during which you work

ex.en: I spend most of my working day sitting at a desk.
ex.cn: 我一天之中大部分工作时间都坐在办公桌旁。

senses.def: a day on which you usually work or on which most people usually work

ex.en: Sunday is a normal working day for me.
ex.cn: 星期日是我的正常工作日。

ex.en: Thousands of working days were lost through strikes last year.
ex.cn: 去年因罢工损失了数以千计的工作日。

ex.en: Allow two working days (= not Saturday or Sunday) for delivery.
ex.cn: 发货需两个工作日。

senses.def: a prostitute. People say 'working girl' to avoid saying 'prostitute'.
a woman who has a paid job
senses.chn: 劳动女子；女工；职业妇女

senses.def: a report written by a group of people chosen to study an aspect of law, education, health, etc.
(in the US) an official document that enables sb under 16 years old or born outside the US to have a job
senses.chn: （美国 16 岁以下或侨居者的）工作证，雇佣证书

senses.def: a group of people chosen to study a particular problem or situation in order to suggest ways of dealing with it
the total amount of time that you spend at work during the week
senses.chn: 一周的工作时间；工作周

ex.en: a 40-hour working week
ex.cn: 40 个小时的工作周

senses.def: the number of hours per week you spend working, compared with the number of hours you spend with your family, relaxing, etc.
senses.chn: 工作与生活的平衡；劳逸结合

ex.en: Part-time working is often the best way to improve your work-life balance.
ex.cn: 兼职工作往往是更好地平衡工作与生活的最佳方式。

senses.def: to be immediately and completely successful
to work very hard
the amount of work that has to be done by a particular person or organization

ex.en: a heavy workload
ex.cn: 沉重的工作负担

ex.en: We have taken on extra staff to cope with the increased workload.
ex.cn: 我们已经额外雇用员工来应付增加了的工作量。

senses.def: a man who is employed to do physical work
a person who works in the way mentioned

ex.en: a good/bad workman
ex.cn: 工作好的／差的人

senses.def: done, made, etc. in a skilful and thorough way but not usually very original or exciting
the skill with which sb makes sth, especially when this affects the way it looks or works

ex.en: Our buyers insist on high standards of workmanship and materials.
ex.cn: 我们的买主对工艺和材料坚持要高标准。

senses.def: a person that you work with, often doing the same job, in an office, a factory, etc.
senses.chn: 一起工作的人；同事；工友

senses.def: a painting, statue, etc.
senses.chn: 艺术品；（绘画、雕塑等）艺术作品

ex.en: A number of priceless works of art were stolen from the gallery.
ex.cn: 美术馆中许多价值连城的艺术品被盗。

senses.def: something that is attractive and skilfully made
senses.chn: 令人赏心悦目的东西；精致的物品

ex.en: The bride's dress was a work of art.
ex.cn: 新娘的礼服十分精美。

senses.def: to try to persuade sb to agree to sth or to do sth
senses.chn: 努力说服（使某人答应或做某事）

ex.en: He hasn't said he'll do it yet, but I'm working on him.
ex.cn: 他还没说他会做这事，不过我正在设法说服他。

senses.def: to try hard to improve or achieve sth

ex.en: You need to work on your pronunciation a bit more.
ex.cn: 你需要再加把劲改进发音。

ex.en: 'Have you sorted out a babysitter yet?' 'No, but I'm working on it.'
ex.cn: “你找到临时看孩子的保姆了吗？” “还没有，我正在找呢。”

senses.def: to train the body by physical exercise

ex.en: I work out regularly to keep fit.
ex.cn: 我经常做运动以保持健康。

senses.def: to develop in a successful way

ex.en: My first job didn't work out.
ex.cn: 我的第一份工作干得不好。

ex.en: Things have worked out quite well for us.
ex.cn: 事情的结果对我们很不错。

senses.def: a period of physical exercise that you do to keep fit

ex.en: She does a 20-minute workout every morning.
ex.cn: 她每天早晨做运动 20 分钟。

senses.def: an official document that sb needs in order to work in a particular foreign country
an item that is being worked on with a tool or a machine
senses.chn: 工件（指使用工具或机器加工或生产的物件）

ex.en: Clamp smaller workpieces to a bench.
ex.cn: 将较小的工件夹紧到工作台上。

senses.def: the office, factory, etc. where people work

ex.en: the introduction of new technology into the workplace
ex.cn: 把新技术引进工厂

senses.def: a system that allows prisoners to leave prison during the day to go to work
senses.chn: 监外就业（允许囚犯日间离开监狱外出工作的制度）

senses.def: a room in which work is done, especially work that involves making things

ex.en: The jeweller has a workroom at the back of his shop.
ex.cn: 珠宝商在他的店铺后面有一间作坊。

senses.def: a group of employees who represent all the employees at a factory, etc. in discussions with their employers over conditions of work
senses.chn: 职工委员会（负责和雇主协商工作条件等）

senses.def: a piece of paper on which there is a series of questions and exercises to be done by a student
a piece of paper on which work that has been done or has to be done is recorded
a room or building in which things are made or repaired using tools or machinery

ex.en: a chocolate/cigarette/clothing factory
ex.cn: 巧克力厂；香烟厂；制衣厂

ex.en: a nuclear power plant
ex.cn: 核电厂

ex.en: a manufacturing plant
ex.cn: 制造厂

ex.en: a cotton/paper/textile/woollen mill
ex.cn: 棉纺厂；造纸厂；纺织厂；毛纺厂

ex.en: a brickworks
ex.cn: 砖厂

ex.en: a steelworks
ex.cn: 炼钢厂

senses.def: a period of discussion and practical work on a particular subject, in which a group of people share their knowledge and experience

ex.en: a drama workshop
ex.cn: 戏剧研讨班

ex.en: a poetry workshop
ex.cn: 诗歌讲习班

senses.def: unwilling to work
senses.chn: 不愿工作的；怕干活的；懒惰的

senses.def: a space in which to work, especially in an office
a place where information that is being used by one person on a computer network is stored
the desk and computer at which a person works; one computer that is part of a computer network
to try to include sth

ex.en: Can't you work a few more jokes into your speech?
ex.cn: 难道你就不能在讲话中再增加几句笑话吗？

senses.def: to add one substance to another and mix them together
