ex.cn: 逐渐掺进黄油。

senses.def: to try to include sth

ex.en: Can't you work a few more jokes into your speech?
ex.cn: 难道你就不能在讲话中再增加几句笑话吗？

senses.def: to add one substance to another and mix them together

ex.en: Gradually work in the butter.
ex.cn: 逐渐掺进黄油。

senses.def: to bring sth to a more complete or more acceptable state

ex.en: I'm working my notes up into a dissertation.
ex.cn: 我正在把我的笔记整理成一篇论文。

senses.def: a flat surface in a kitchen for preparing food on
to follow the rules of your job in a very strict way in order to cause delay, as a form of protest against your employer or your working conditions
a situation in which workers refuse to do any work that is not in their contracts, in order to protest about sth
senses.chn: 按章工作（为表示抗议而拒绝做超出合同规定的工作）

senses.def: to follow a plan, schedule, etc.
senses.chn: 按照（计划、时间表等）；根据…行事

ex.en: to work to a budget
ex.cn: 按照预算办事

ex.en: We're working to a very tight deadline (= we have little time in which to do the work).
ex.cn: 我们的工期很紧。

senses.def: to try to reach or achieve a goal
senses.chn: 努力达到，设法完成（目标）

senses.def: to develop or move gradually towards sth, usually sth more exciting or extreme
senses.chn: 逐步发展到，逐渐达到（更高或更深的程度）

ex.en: The music worked up to a rousing finale.
ex.cn: 乐曲渐变到一个激动人心的末乐章。

ex.en: I began by jogging in the park and worked up to running five miles a day.
ex.cn: 我开始在公园里慢跑，后来逐渐增加到一天跑五英里。

senses.def: the total amount of time that you spend at work during the week
senses.chn: 一周的工作时间；工作周

senses.def: to achieve very good results
senses.chn: 创造奇迹；取得优良的成绩；产生良好的效果

ex.en: Her new diet and exercise programme has worked wonders for her.
ex.cn: 她新的饮食和锻炼计划对她产生了奇效。

senses.def: to work very hard

work your fingers to the bone.lemma: work your fingers to the bone

senses.def: to work very hard
to get anxious or angry about sth, especially when it is not necessary
senses.chn: （尤指不必要地）焦躁不安，发怒

senses.def: to do sth from beginning to end, especially when it takes a lot of time or effort
senses.chn: 自始至终做（尤指耗费时间或力量的事）

ex.en: She worked her way through the pile of documents.
ex.cn: 她从头至尾处理了那一堆文件。

senses.def: to move regularly to a more senior position in a company
senses.chn: 逐步升职；按部就班晋升

ex.en: He worked his way up from messenger boy to account executive.
ex.cn: 他从送信员一步一步晋升为客户经理。

senses.def: the earth, with all its countries, peoples and natural features

ex.en: to sail around the world
ex.cn: 环球航行

ex.en: travelling (all over) the world
ex.cn: 周游世界

ex.en: a map of the world
ex.cn: 世界地图

ex.en: French is spoken in many parts of the world.
ex.cn: 世界上许多地方都说法语。

ex.en: Which is the largest city in the world?
ex.cn: 世界上最大的城市是哪个？

ex.en: He's the world's highest paid entertainer.
ex.cn: 他是世界上薪酬最高的演艺人。

senses.def: a particular part of the earth; a particular group of countries or people; a particular period of history and the people of that period
senses.chn: 某地域（或民族、历史时期等）的人类社会；世界

ex.en: the Arab world
ex.cn: 阿拉伯世界

ex.en: the English-speaking world
ex.cn: 讲英语的地区

ex.en: the industrialized and developing worlds
ex.cn: 工业化国家和发展中国家

ex.en: the ancient/modern world
ex.cn: 古代／现代社会

senses.def: a planet like the earth

ex.en: There may be other worlds out there.
ex.cn: 那里可能有其他星球。

senses.def: the people or things belonging to a particular group or connected with a particular interest, job, etc.
senses.chn: 按性质（或职业等）划分的类别；界；界别

ex.en: the animal/plant/insect world
ex.cn: 动物界；植物界；昆虫界

ex.en: the world of fashion
ex.cn: 时装界

ex.en: stars from the sporting and artistic worlds
ex.cn: 体育和艺术界的众明星

senses.def: everything that exists of a particular kind; a particular kind of life or existence
senses.chn: 某领域的一切事物；自然界

ex.en: the natural world (= animals, plants, minerals, etc.)
ex.cn: 自然界

ex.en: They are a couple in the real world as well as in the movie.
ex.cn: 他们在电影和现实生活中都是一对夫妇。

ex.en: The island is a world of brilliant colours and dramatic sunsets.
ex.cn: 这个岛是个绚丽多彩、晚霞娇妍的世界。

ex.en: They had little contact with the outside world (= people and places that were not part of their normal life).
ex.cn: 他们与外界没有什么联系。

senses.def: a person's environment, experiences, friends and family, etc.
senses.chn: 生活环境；阅历；生活圈子

ex.en: Parents are the most important people in a child's world.
ex.cn: 父母在儿童的天地里是最重要的人。

ex.en: When his wife died, his entire world was turned upside down.
ex.cn: 他妻子死后，他的整个生活变得一塌糊涂。

senses.def: our society and the way people live and behave; the people in the world

ex.en: We live in a rapidly changing world.
ex.cn: 我们生活在瞬息万变的社会里。

ex.en: He's too young to understand the ways of the world.
ex.cn: 他还太年轻，不懂得处世之道。

ex.en: The whole world was waiting for news of the astronauts.
ex.cn: 全世界的人都在等待宇航员的消息。

ex.en: She felt that the world was against her.
ex.cn: 她觉得整个世界都在与她作对。

ex.en: The eyes of the world are on the President.
ex.cn: 世人的眼睛都在盯着总统。

senses.def: a way of life where possessions and physical pleasures are important, rather than spiritual values

ex.en: monks and nuns renouncing the world
ex.cn: 弃绝俗世享乐的修士和修女

senses.def: the state of human existence

ex.en: this world and the next (= life on earth and existence after death)
ex.cn: 今世和来世

senses.def: to be loved by and very important to sb
senses.chn: 是…的最喜爱的人（或事物）；对…非常重要；是…的一切

senses.def: the benefits of two or more completely different situations that you can enjoy at the same time
senses.chn: 两种（或多种）不同情况的优点；两全其美

ex.en: If you enjoy the coast and the country, you'll get the best of both worlds on this walk.
ex.cn: 你要是喜欢海滨和乡村，那么这次散步你会一举两得。

senses.def: to be completely different in attitudes, opinions, etc.
senses.chn: （在态度、看法等方面）有天壤之别，截然不同

senses.def: to become less/more important or successful in society
senses.chn: 落泊；衰落；倒运；飞黄腾达；发迹；兴盛

senses.def: to be born
to make sb feel much better; to improve sth
senses.chn: 使…感到好得多；对…大有好处；改善

ex.en: A change of job would do you the world of good.
ex.cn: 换一下工作会对你大有好处。

senses.def: exactly as if…; exactly like sb/sth

ex.en: She behaved for all the world as if nothing unusual had happened.
ex.cn: 看她的表现就像根本没有发生过什么大事似的。

ex.en: He looked for all the world like a schoolboy caught stealing apples.
ex.cn: 他那个样子简直就像偷苹果时被当场抓住的小学生。

senses.def: to be very successful and admired
used to emphasize sth and to show that you are surprised or annoyed
senses.chn: （用于强调，表示惊讶或不悦）到底，究竟

ex.en: What in the world did they think they were doing?
ex.cn: 他们到底认为自己在做什么？

senses.def: used to say that sth is what you would like to happen or what should happen, but you know it cannot

ex.en: In an ideal world we would be recycling and reusing everything.
ex.cn: 我们要是能回收并再利用所有的东西就再理想不过了。

senses.def: used to emphasize what you are saying
senses.chn: （加强语气）世界上，天下，根本，到底

ex.en: There's nothing in the world I'd like more than to visit New York.
ex.cn: 访问纽约是我最想做的事。

ex.en: Don't rush—we've got all the time in the world.
ex.cn: 别急急忙忙的，我们有的是时间。

ex.en: You look as if you haven't got a care in the world!
ex.cn: 你看上去好像一丝牵挂都没有！

senses.def: if you are in a world of your own, you are so concerned with your own thoughts that you do not notice what is happening around you
a person with a lot of experience of life, who is not easily surprised or shocked
senses.chn: 生活阅历丰富的人；老成持重的人

senses.def: used to say that you would never do sth

ex.en: I wouldn't hurt you for the world.
ex.cn: 我绝不会伤害你。

senses.def: used to refer to people of a particular type

ex.en: We all envy the Bill Gateses of this world (= the people who are as rich and successful as Bill Gates).
ex.cn: 我们大家都羡慕比尔 · 盖茨这样的人。

senses.def: used to emphasize how good, beautiful, etc. sth is
senses.chn: 好（或美等）得不得了；非凡；呱呱叫

ex.en: The meal was out of this world.
ex.cn: 这顿饭简直是没治了。

senses.def: to travel widely and gain wide experience
to talk about how the world could be changed to be a better place
senses.chn: 谈论如何使世界变得更好

ex.en: We stayed up all night, setting the world to rights.
ex.cn: 我们一夜没睡，谈论着如何拯救世界。

senses.def: to be very successful and gain the admiration of other people

ex.en: He's never going to set the world on fire with his paintings.
ex.cn: 他的绘画永远不会引起轰动。

senses.def: used to express disapproval, surprise or shock, especially at changes in people's attitudes or behaviour
senses.chn: 这个世界要变成什么样子了；这世道是怎么了；太不像话

ex.en: When I listen to the news these days, I sometimes wonder what the world is coming to.
ex.cn: 我近来收听新闻时，有时纳闷这成了什么世道了。

senses.def: everyone; a large number of people
used to emphasize how different two things are

ex.en: His new luxury mansion was a world away from the tiny house where he was born.
ex.cn: 他那座新的豪宅与他出生的小屋完全不能相比。

senses.def: there is no limit to the opportunities open to you
senses.chn: 世界是属于你的；你的前途无量

senses.def: used to emphasize how much difference there is between two things

ex.en: There's a world of difference between liking someone and loving them.
ex.cn: 喜欢一个人和爱一个人完全不是一回事。

senses.def: everywhere in the world

ex.en: People are basically the same the world over.
ex.cn: 世界各地的人基本上都一样。

senses.def: a situation or society that changes in a way that is meant to improve people's lives but is often a source of extra problems
senses.chn: 美好的新世界（本欲改善人们的生活，实则带来预料不到的问题）

ex.en: the brave new world of technology
ex.cn: 科技进步的美好新世界

senses.def: fast asleep
not the worst thing that could happen to sb
senses.chn: 天不会塌下来；不是灭顶之灾

ex.en: Failing one exam is not the end of the world.
ex.cn: 一次考试不及格并非世界末日。

senses.def: to be giving all your attention to sth so that you do not notice what is happening around you
senses.chn: （全神贯注于某事而）不注意周围的事情

senses.def: to make promises that will be impossible to keep
senses.chn: 作出不可能实现的承诺

senses.def: used to express your surprise when you meet sb you know in an unexpected place, or when you are talking to sb and find out that you both know the same person
senses.chn: （意外遇见某人或发现对方也认识某人时表示惊讶）世界真小

senses.def: very happy or proud
senses.chn: 欢天喜地；心满意足；非常自豪

senses.def: to relax and watch people in a public place
senses.chn: 闲看人来人往；静观众生百态

ex.en: We sat outside a cafe, watching the world go by.
ex.cn: 我们坐在一家小餐馆外面，望着眼前来来往往的人们。

senses.def: the way that most people behave; the way that things happen, which you cannot change
senses.chn: 大多数人的行为模式；世道；事情发生的规律

ex.en: The rich and powerful make the decisions—that's the way of the world.
ex.cn: 有钱有势者说了算，这就是世道。

senses.def: used to say that you cannot do sth, even though you really want to
senses.chn: 尽管已尽心竭力；尽管真心愿意

ex.en: With the best will in the world I could not describe him as a good father.
ex.cn: 尽管我心里极想美言几句，却怎么也不能说他是位好父亲。

senses.def: all the disadvantages of every situation
senses.chn: 各种情况的所有不利因素

senses.def: a person or thing that is better than all others
as good as the best in the world
senses.chn: 世界级的；世界上一流的

ex.en: a world-class athlete
ex.cn: 世界一流的运动员

senses.def: the English language, used throughout the world for international communication, including all of its regional varieties, such as Australian, Indian and South African English
senses.chn: 世界英语（通行于世界各地的国际交流英语，包括澳大利亚英语、印度英语、南非英语等地域变体）

senses.def: known all over the world
senses.chn: 举世闻名的；世界著名的

ex.en: a world-famous scientist
ex.cn: 世界著名的科学家

senses.def: if the situation becomes too difficult or dangerous
senses.chn: 如果发生最坏的事情；如果情况变得过于艰难（或危险）

ex.en: If the worst comes to the worst, we'll just have to sell the house.
ex.cn: 如果最坏的事发生，我们就只好把房子卖掉。

senses.def: all the disadvantages of every situation
senses.chn: 各种情况的所有不利因素

senses.def: to defeat sb in a fight, a contest or an argument
senses.chn: （在打斗、比赛或辩论中）打败，战胜

senses.def: involving the worst situation that could happen

ex.en: In the worst-case scenario more than ten thousand people might be affected.
ex.cn: 在最坏的情况下，有一万多人可能会受到影响。

senses.def: a type of cloth made of wool with a smooth surface, used for making clothes

ex.en: a grey worsted suit
ex.cn: 一套灰色的精纺毛料西服

senses.def: having a value in money, etc.

ex.en: Our house is worth about £100 000.
ex.cn: 我们的房子大约值 10 万英镑。

ex.en: How much is this painting worth?
ex.cn: 这幅画值多少钱？

ex.en: to be worth a bomb/packet/fortune (= a lot of money)
ex.cn: 值一大笔钱

ex.en: It isn't worth much.
ex.cn: 这不值多少钱。

ex.en: If you answer this question correctly, it's worth five points.
ex.cn: 答对了这道题可以得五分。

ex.en: house prices
ex.cn: 房屋价格

senses.def: used to recommend the action mentioned because you think it may be useful, enjoyable, etc.

ex.en: The museum is certainly worth a visit.
ex.cn: 这家博物馆的确值得参观。

ex.en: This idea is well worth considering.
ex.cn: 这个想法很值得考虑。

ex.en: It's worth making an appointment before you go.
ex.cn: 去之前预约一下是值得的。

senses.def: important, good or enjoyable enough to make sb feel satisfied, especially when difficulty or effort is involved

ex.en: Was it worth the effort?
ex.cn: 这值得花费力气吗？

ex.en: The new house really wasn't worth all the expense involved.
ex.cn: 这座新房子确实不值这么多的花费。

ex.en: The job involves a lot of hard work but it's worth it.
ex.cn: 这工作需要花费很大力气，但是值得。

ex.en: The trip was expensive but it was worth every penny.
ex.cn: 这次旅行花费很大，但是花的每一分钱都不冤枉。

senses.def: having money and possessions of a particular value

ex.en: He's worth £10 million.
ex.cn: 他拥有 1 000 万英镑的财产。

senses.def: with great energy, effort and determination
senses.chn: 竭尽全力；拼命；十分坚定

ex.en: He was rowing for all he was worth.
ex.cn: 他在拼命地划船。

senses.def: in order to get as much as you can from sb/sth

ex.en: She is milking her success for all it's worth.
ex.cn: 她在利用自己的成功拼命捞好处。

senses.def: used to emphasize that what you are saying is only your own opinion or suggestion and may not be very helpful
senses.chn: （所说的只是个人意见）无论管不管用，不论好坏

ex.en: I prefer this colour, for what it's worth.
ex.cn: 无论好坏，我喜欢这个颜色。

senses.def: the advantages to be gained from doing sth are not great enough, considering the effort or cost involved
having no value, especially legally, or because one of the people involved has no intention of doing what they said they would
deserving respect, especially because you do your job well

ex.en: Any teacher worth her salt knows that.
ex.cn: 凡称职的教师都知道这一点。

senses.def: very useful or valuable

ex.en: A good mechanic is worth his weight in gold.
ex.cn: 优秀的技工是不可多得的。

senses.def: interesting or useful for sb to do

ex.en: It will be worth your while to come to the meeting.
ex.cn: 你来参加会议对你会大有好处。

ex.en: He'll do the job if you make it worth his while (= pay him well).
ex.cn: 你要是给他的报酬丰厚，他会做这份工作的。

senses.def: it is better to keep sth that you already have than to risk losing it by trying to get much more
senses.chn: 一鸟在手胜过双鸟在林（满足于现有的总比因过分追求而失去一切好）

senses.def: not worth doing because it is against the rules or because it might cause you to lose your job
senses.chn: 工作所不允许的事；违反原则的事；可能丢饭碗的事

ex.en: It's more than my job's worth to let you in without a ticket.
ex.cn: 没有票就让你进去，我可能会丢饭碗的。

senses.def: an amount of sth that has the value mentioned
senses.chn: 价值（十美元、40 英镑等）的东西

ex.en: The winner will receive fifty pounds' worth of books.
ex.cn: 获胜者将得到价值五十英镑的书。

ex.en: a dollar's worth of change
ex.cn: 一美元的零钱

senses.def: an amount of sth that lasts a week, etc.
senses.chn: 能用（一个星期、一个月等）的东西

senses.def: the financial, practical or moral value of sb/sth

ex.en: Their contribution was of great worth.
ex.cn: 他们的贡献具有伟大的意义。

ex.en: The activities help children to develop a sense of their own worth.
ex.cn: 这些活动有助于儿童培养自身的价值感。

ex.en: A good interview enables candidates to prove their worth (= show how good they are).
ex.cn: 好的面试可以让求职者证明他们的价值。

ex.en: a personal net worth of $10 million
ex.cn: 价值 1 000 万美元的个人净资产

senses.def: to give your opinion about sth, even if other people do not want to hear it
senses.chn: 发表意见（即使别人不想听）

senses.def: to get enough value or enjoyment out of sth, considering the amount of money, time, etc. that you are spending on it

example.en: This idea is well worth considering.
example.cn: 这个想法很值得考虑。

phrases.filled: ten dollars', £40, etc. worth of sth

phrases.pattern: a week's, month's, etc. ~ of sth
phrases.filled: a week's, month's, etc. worth of sth

senses.def: having no practical or financial value

ex.en: Critics say his paintings are worthless.
ex.cn: 评论家说他的画毫无价值。

senses.def: having no good qualities or useful skills

ex.en: a worthless individual
ex.cn: 品质坏的人

ex.en: Constant rejections made him feel worthless.
ex.cn: 不断地遭到拒绝使他觉得一无是处。

senses.def: interesting or useful for sb to do

ex.en: It will be worth your while to come to the meeting.
ex.cn: 你来参加会议对你会大有好处。

ex.en: He'll do the job if you make it worth his while (= pay him well).
ex.cn: 你要是给他的报酬丰厚，他会做这份工作的。

senses.def: important, enjoyable, interesting, etc.; worth spending time, money or effort on
senses.chn: 重要的；令人愉快的；有趣的；值得花时间（或花钱、努力等）

ex.en: It was in aid of a worthwhile cause (= a charity, etc.)
ex.cn: 这是在为高尚的事业尽一份力。

ex.en: The smile on her face made it all worthwhile.
ex.cn: 她脸上的笑容使得这一切都非常值得。

ex.en: High prices in the UK make it worthwhile for buyers to look abroad.
ex.cn: 英国的高价足以使买主把视线转向国外。

ex.en: It is worthwhile to include really high-quality illustrations.
ex.cn: 把真正高质量的插图包括进去是值得的。

ex.en: It didn't seem worthwhile writing it all out again.
ex.cn: 把这再都写出来似乎不必要。

phrases.filled: worthwhile for sb to do sth

example.en: High prices in the UK make it worthwhile for buyers to look abroad.
example.cn: 英国的高价足以使买主把视线转向国外。

example.en: It is worthwhile to include really high-quality illustrations.
example.cn: 把真正高质量的插图包括进去是值得的。

example.en: It didn't seem worthwhile writing it all out again.
example.cn: 把这再都写出来似乎不必要。

senses.def: having the qualities that deserve sb/sth

ex.en: to be worthy of attention
ex.cn: 值得注意

ex.en: A number of the report's findings are worthy of note.
ex.cn: 这份报告里有些调查结果值得注意。

ex.en: No composer was considered worthy of the name until he had written an opera.
ex.cn: 作曲家直到写出一部歌剧来才被认为是名副其实。

ex.en: a worthy champion (= one who deserved to win)
ex.cn: 当之无愧的冠军

ex.en: He felt he was not worthy of her.
ex.cn: 他觉得他配不上她。

senses.def: having qualities that deserve your respect, attention or admiration
senses.chn: 值得尊敬的；值得注意的；值得敬仰的

ex.en: The money we raise will be going to a very worthy cause.
ex.cn: 我们筹集的钱款将用于非常崇高的事业。

ex.en: a worthy member of the team
ex.cn: 一位优秀的队员

senses.def: having good qualities but not very interesting or exciting
senses.chn: 值得尊敬的，有价值的（但不太令人感兴趣或激动的）

ex.en: her worthy but dull husband
ex.cn: 她那为人正派却呆板的丈夫

senses.def: typical of what a particular person or thing might do, give, etc.
senses.chn: 有（某人或事物）的典型特征

ex.en: He gave a speech that was worthy of Martin Luther King.
ex.cn: 他作了一次典型的马丁 · 路德 · 金式的演讲。

senses.def: deserving, or suitable for, the thing mentioned

ex.en: trustworthy
ex.cn: 值得信任的

ex.en: roadworthy
ex.cn: 适于在公路上行驶的

senses.def: an important person

ex.en: a meeting attended by local worthies
ex.cn: 当地知名人士参加的会议

senses.def: a way of writing 'what', used to show that sb is speaking very informal English
senses.chn: （what 的一种写法，表示说话者用极不正规的英语）什么

ex.en: 'Wot's going on?' he shouted.
ex.cn: “出了什么事？” 他喊道。

senses.def: used as a friendly way of saying hello to a person

ex.en: Wotcha Dave—thanks for coming.
ex.cn: 你好，戴夫，谢谢光临。

senses.def: used as the past form of will when reporting what sb has said or thought
senses.chn: （will 的过去式，用于转述）将，将会

ex.en: He said he would be here at eight o'clock (= His words were: 'I will be there at eight o'clock.').
ex.cn: 他说他将在八点钟到达这里。

ex.en: She asked if I would help.
ex.cn: 她问我是否会帮忙。

ex.en: They told me that they probably wouldn't come.
ex.cn: 他们对我说他们多半不会来。

senses.def: used for talking about the result of an event that you imagine

ex.en: She'd look better with shorter hair.
ex.cn: 她留短发会显得好看些。

ex.en: If you went to see him, he would be delighted.
ex.cn: 倘若你去看望他，他会高兴的。

ex.en: Hurry up! It would be a shame to miss the beginning of the play.
ex.cn: 快点儿！要是错过这出戏的开场就太可惜了。

ex.en: She'd be a fool to accept it (= if she accepted).
ex.cn: 她倘若接受，那她就是个傻瓜。

senses.def: used for describing a possible action or event that did not in fact happen, because sth else did not happen first
senses.chn: （表示可能发生的事情没有发生，是因为之前另一件事没有发生）就会

ex.en: If I had seen the advertisement in time I would have applied for the job.
ex.cn: 我要是及时看到了这则广告，我就应聘那份工作了。

ex.en: They would never have met if she hadn't gone to Emma's party.
ex.cn: 她如果不去参加埃玛的聚会，他们就永远不会相会。

senses.def: used for saying why sb does sth

ex.en: She burned the letters so that her husband would never read them.
ex.cn: 她把那些信都烧了以便永远不让她丈夫看见。

senses.def: used for saying what you want to happen

ex.en: I wish you'd be quiet for a minute.
ex.cn: 我希望你会安静一会儿。

senses.def: used to show that sb/sth was not willing or refused to do sth

ex.en: She wouldn't change it, even though she knew it was wrong.
ex.cn: 尽管她知道这错了，她也不肯改变。

ex.en: My car wouldn't start this morning.
ex.cn: 今天早晨我的汽车怎么也发动不起来。

senses.def: used to ask sb politely to do sth

ex.en: Would you mind leaving us alone for a few minutes?
ex.cn: 你不介意让我们单独待一会儿吧？

ex.en: Would you open the door for me, please?
ex.cn: 请你给我开门好吗？

senses.def: used in polite offers or invitations

ex.en: Would you like a sandwich?
ex.cn: 您来一个三明治好吗？

ex.en: Would you have dinner with me on Friday?
ex.cn: 请你星期五和我一起用餐好吗？

senses.def: used to say what you like, love, hate, etc.

ex.en: I'd love a coffee.
ex.cn: 我想喝杯咖啡。

ex.en: I'd be only too glad to help.
ex.cn: 我非常愿意帮忙。

ex.en: I'd hate you to think I was criticizing you.
ex.cn: 我可不愿意让你认为我是在批评你。

ex.en: I'd rather come with you.
ex.cn: 我倒愿意和你一起去。

ex.en: I'd rather you came with us.
ex.cn: 我倒愿意你和我们一块儿去。

senses.def: used to give opinions that you are not certain about

ex.en: I would imagine the job will take about two days.
ex.cn: 我猜想这工作大概需要两天左右的时间吧。

ex.en: I'd say he was about fifty.
ex.cn: 我猜他五十岁上下。

senses.def: used to give advice

ex.en: I wouldn't have any more to drink, if I were you.
ex.cn: 我要是你的话，我就不会再喝酒了。

senses.def: used for talking about things that often happened in the past
senses.chn: （带出过去常见的情况）总是，老是

ex.en: When my parents were away, my grandmother would take care of me.
ex.cn: 我父母外出的时候，总是祖母照看我。

ex.en: He'd always be the first to offer to help.
ex.cn: 他总是第一个主动提出帮忙。

senses.def: used for talking about behaviour that you think is typical
senses.chn: （带出一贯的行为）总是，爱，好，就

ex.en: 'She said it was your fault.' 'Well, she would say that, wouldn't she? She's never liked me.'
ex.cn: “她说这是你的错。” “唉，她总是这么说，不是吗？她从来就没有喜欢过我。”

senses.def: used to express a strong wish

ex.en: Would that he had lived to see it.
ex.cn: 他要是能活到看见这该多好哇。

ex.en: He can speak three languages.
ex.cn: 他会说三种语言。

ex.en: She will try and visit tomorrow.
ex.cn: 她明天将设法去参观。

ex.en: You must find a job.
ex.cn: 你必须找到一份工作。

ex.en: You ought to stop smoking.
ex.cn: 你应当戒烟。

ex.en: I used to smoke but I gave up two years ago.
ex.cn: 我过去抽烟，但两年前就戒了。

phrases.filled: so that/in order that sb/sth would

phrases.pattern: ~ like, love, hate, prefer, etc. sth/(sb) to do sth |
phrases.filled: would like, love, hate, prefer, etc. sth/(sb) to do sth |
would rather do sth/sb did sth

senses.def: used to describe sb who is hoping to become the type of person mentioned

ex.en: a would-be actor
ex.cn: 想要成为演员的人

ex.en: advice for would-be parents
ex.cn: 对即将成为父母的人的忠告

senses.def: an injury to part of the body, especially one in which a hole is made in the skin using a weapon
senses.chn: （身体上的）伤，伤口；（武器造成的）伤

ex.en: a leg/head, etc. wound
ex.cn: 腿伤、头伤等

ex.en: a bullet/knife/gunshot/stab wound
ex.cn: 枪伤；刀伤；枪伤；刺伤

ex.en: an old war wound
ex.cn: 战争中的旧伤

ex.en: The nurse cleaned the wound.
ex.cn: 护士清洗了伤口。

ex.en: The wound healed slowly.
ex.cn: 伤口愈合得很慢。

ex.en: He died from the wounds he had received to his chest.
ex.cn: 他由于胸部受伤而死亡。

senses.def: mental or emotional pain caused by sth unpleasant that has been said or done to you

ex.en: After a serious argument, it can take some time for the wounds to heal.
ex.cn: 激烈争吵之后的感情创伤需要一些时间才能愈合。

ex.en: Seeing him again opened up old wounds.
ex.cn: 再次见到他打开了旧的创伤。

senses.def: to spend time trying to get your strength or confidence back after a defeat or disappointment
senses.chn: （失败或失望后）恢复元气，重整旗鼓

senses.def: to remind sb of sth unpleasant that happened or existed in the past
to make a difficult experience even more difficult for sb
senses.chn: 在伤口上抹盐；使雪上加霜

senses.def: to injure part of the body, especially by making a hole in the skin using a weapon
senses.chn: 使（身体）受伤；（用武器）伤害

ex.en: He had been wounded in the arm.
ex.cn: 他的手臂受过伤。

senses.def: to hurt sb's feelings

ex.en: She felt deeply wounded by his cruel remarks.
ex.cn: 他那刻薄的话语使她感到深受伤害。

senses.def: injured by a weapon, for example in a war

ex.en: wounded soldiers
ex.cn: 伤兵

ex.en: seriously wounded
ex.cn: 伤势严重

ex.en: There were 79 killed and 230 wounded.
ex.cn: 有 79 人死亡，230 人受伤。

senses.def: feeling emotional pain because of sth unpleasant that sb has said or done

ex.en: wounded pride
ex.cn: 受到伤害的自尊心

senses.def: people who are wounded, for example in a war
that hurts sb's feelings

ex.en: He found her remarks deeply wounding.
ex.cn: 他觉得她的话十分伤人。

senses.def: used to express great surprise or admiration
senses.chn: （表示极大的惊奇或钦佩）哇，呀

ex.en: Wow! You look terrific!
ex.cn: 哇！你的样子太酷了！

senses.def: to impress sb very much, especially with a performance
senses.chn: （尤指以表演）博得…的称赞，使喝彩，使叫绝

ex.en: He wowed audiences around the country with his new show.
ex.cn: 他以他的新节目博得了全国各地观众的交口称赞。

senses.def: a great success
senses.chn: 极大的成功；一鸣惊人之举

ex.en: Don't worry. You'll be a wow.
ex.cn: 别担心。你会一鸣惊人的。

senses.def: gradual changes in the pitch of sound played on a record or tape
senses.chn: （唱片或录音磁带逐渐出现的）走调，失真，颤动

senses.def: the quality sth has of being very impressive or surprising to people
senses.chn: 令人叫好的性质；使人惊奇的因素

ex.en: If you want to sell your house quickly, it needs a wow factor.
ex.cn: 若想很快把房子卖掉，就得找个卖点。

senses.def: a person who criticizes people who are enjoying themselves
senses.chn: 批评别人玩乐者；扫别人兴的人

senses.def: a person who does not drink alcohol
the abbreviation for 'woman police constable' (a woman police officer of the lowest rank)
senses.chn: 女警察（全写为 woman police constable，警衔最低的女警察）

ex.en: WPC (Linda) Green
ex.cn: 女警（琳达 ·）格林

senses.def: words per minute

ex.en: to type at 60 wpm
ex.cn: 每分钟打 60 个字

senses.def: (in Britain) Women's Royal Army Corps
(in Britain) Women's Royal Air Force
the ghost of a person that is seen a short time before or after that person dies
senses.chn: （临终前后显现的）活人灵魂，鬼魂

ex.en: a wraith-like figure (= a very thin, pale person)
ex.cn: 瘦削苍白、幽灵似的人

senses.def: an argument that is complicated and continues over a long period of time

ex.en: a legal wrangle between the company and their suppliers
ex.cn: 这家公司与各供货商之间长期的法律纠纷

senses.def: to argue angrily and usually for a long time about sth

ex.en: They're still wrangling over the financial details.
ex.cn: 他们仍在为财务细节争吵。

senses.def: a cowboy or a cowgirl , especially one who takes care of horses
to cover sth completely in paper or other material, for example when you are giving it as a present

ex.en: He spent the evening wrapping up the Christmas presents.
ex.cn: 他花了一个晚上的时间把圣诞礼物都包了起来。

ex.en: individually wrapped chocolates
ex.cn: 单块包装的巧克力

senses.def: to cover sth/sb in material, for example in order to protect it/them

ex.en: Wrap the meat in foil before you cook it.
ex.cn: 把肉用锡箔裹起来后再烹调。

ex.en: I wrapped the baby (up) in a blanket.
ex.cn: 我用毯子把婴儿裹了起来。

ex.en: I wrapped a blanket around the baby.
ex.cn: 我用毯子把婴儿裹了起来。

senses.def: to put sth firmly around sth/sb

ex.en: A scarf was wrapped around his neck.
ex.cn: 他的脖子上围着一条围巾。

ex.en: His arms were wrapped around her waist.
ex.cn: 他的双臂紧紧环抱她的腰。

senses.def: to cause text to be carried over to a new line automatically as you reach the end of the previous line; to be carried over in this way

ex.en: How can I wrap the text around?
ex.cn: 我怎么才能使文本换行呢？

ex.en: The text wraps around if it is too long to fit the screen.
ex.cn: 如果文本太长，在显示屏放不下的话，会自动换行。

senses.def: to be so involved with sb/sth that you do not pay enough attention to other people or things
senses.chn: 专心致志于；全神贯注于；完全沉浸于

senses.def: to persuade sb to do anything that you want
senses.chn: 任意摆布某人；左右某人

senses.def: usually used as an order to tell sb to stop talking or causing trouble, etc.
to put warm clothes on sb/yourself

ex.en: She told them to wrap up warm/warmly.
ex.cn: 她叫他们穿暖和点。

senses.def: to complete sth such as an agreement or a meeting in an acceptable way
senses.chn: 圆满完成，顺利结束（协议或会议等）

senses.def: to work correctly or in the way mentioned

ex.en: This pen won't write.
ex.cn: 这支钢笔不好使。

senses.def: to be very obvious to other people from the expression on sb's face
senses.chn: 形之于色；表现得十分明显

ex.en: Guilt was written all over his face.
ex.cn: 他满脸愧疚。

senses.def: to show clearly the quality mentioned or the influence of the person mentioned
senses.chn: 明显有（某性质）；显然受到（某人影响）

ex.en: It was a performance with star quality written all over it.
ex.cn: 这次演出显然明星气派十足。

ex.en: This essay has got Mike written all over it.
ex.cn: 这篇散文俨然是迈克的手笔。

senses.def: not especially good; ordinary
used when you are stating that there is nothing more that can be said about sth or that sth is completely finished
senses.chn: （表示没有其他要说或某事已彻底结束）就这么多，到此结束

senses.def: having no value, especially legally, or because one of the people involved has no intention of doing what they said they would
to write sb a letter replying to their letter

ex.en: I'm afraid I never wrote back.
ex.cn: 我恐怕从未写过回信。

ex.en: She wrote back saying that she couldn't come.
ex.cn: 她回信说她来不了。

senses.def: to write sth on paper, especially in order to remember or record it

ex.en: Write down the address before you forget it.
ex.cn: 把地址记下来，免得忘了。

senses.def: to reduce the value of assets when stating it in a company's accounts
senses.chn: 减记，划减（资产的账面价值）

senses.def: to write a letter to an organization or a company, for example to ask about sth or to express an opinion
senses.chn: 致函（某机构）（表达意见等）

ex.en: I'll write in for more information.
ex.cn: 我要写信索取更详细的材料。

senses.def: to add an extra name to your voting paper in an election in order to be able to vote for them
senses.chn: （在选票上）写上非候选人姓名

senses.def: to include a rule or condition in a contract or an agreement when it is made
to write to an organization or a company, usually in order to ask them to send you sth
senses.chn: 致函（某机构）（索取资料等）

ex.en: I've written off for the catalogue.
ex.cn: 我已去函索取商品目录。

senses.def: to cancel a debt; to recognize that sth is a failure, has no value, etc.

ex.en: to write off a debt/an investment
ex.cn: 注销一笔债务／一项投资

senses.def: to damage sth, especially a vehicle, so badly that it cannot be repaired
to decide that sb/sth is a failure or not worth paying any attention to
senses.chn: 认定…失败（或没有价值、不可救药等）

senses.def: to write sth on paper, including all the details, especially a piece of work or an account of sth
to remove a character from a regular series on television or radio
senses.chn: 去掉（系列电视剧或广播剧中的角色）

senses.def: to record sth in writing in a full and complete form, often using notes that you made earlier

ex.en: to write up your notes/the minutes of a meeting
ex.cn: 把笔记／会议记录整理成文

example.en: Please write in pen on both sides of the paper.
example.cn: 请用钢笔在纸的正反两面书写。

example.en: Write your name at the top of the paper.
example.cn: 请把名字写在纸的顶端。

example.en: He hopes to write a book about his experiences one day.
example.cn: 他希望有一天写一部关于自己经历的书。

example.en: I wanted to travel and then write about it.
example.cn: 我本想去旅行，然后把见闻写下来。

example.en: She wrote him several poems.
example.cn: 她为他写了几首诗。

example.en: She wrote to him in France.
example.cn: 她给他往法国写信。

example.en: I wrote a letter to the Publicity Department.
example.cn: 我给宣传部写了一封信。

example.en: She wrote that they were all fine.
example.cn: 她信上说他们一切安好。

example.en: Write me while you're away.
example.cn: 你外出期间给我写信。

example.en: He wrote me that he would be arriving Monday.
example.cn: 他给我写信说他将于星期一到达。

example.en: They wrote thanking us for the present.
example.cn: 他们写信来感谢我们赠送的礼物。

example.en: Ancient historians wrote of a lost continent beneath the ocean.
example.cn: 古代史学家写过有关一个沉没海底的大陆的事迹。

example.en: 'Of all my books,' wrote Dickens, 'I like this the best.'
example.cn: 狄更斯写道：“在我所有的书中，我最喜欢这本。”

example.en: to write out a cheque
example.cn: 开一张支票

example.en: I'll write you a receipt.
example.cn: 我来给你开一张收据。

senses.def: a situation where an asset gets a value which it was thought to have lost; an amount of money entered in the financial records because of this
senses.chn: （对呆账的）拨回；拨回资产的账面值

senses.def: a reduction in the value of assets, etc.
senses.chn: （资产等账面价值的）减记，划减

senses.def: a vote for sb who is not an official candidate in an election, in which you write their name on your ballot paper
a vehicle that has been so badly damaged in an accident that it is not worth spending money to repair it
a period of time during which you do not achieve anything

ex.en: With meetings and phone calls, yesterday was a complete write-off.
ex.cn: 昨天都在开会和打电话，瞎忙了一天。

senses.def: an act of cancelling a debt and accepting that it will never be paid
to protect the information on a computer disk from being changed or deleted (= destroyed)
a person whose job is writing books, stories, articles, etc.

ex.en: writers of poetry
ex.cn: 诗人

ex.en: a travel/cookery, etc. writer
ex.cn: 游记作家、写菜谱的人等

senses.def: a person who has written a particular thing

ex.en: the writer of this letter
ex.cn: 写这封信的人

senses.def: a person who forms letters in a particular way when they are writing

ex.en: a messy writer
ex.cn: 书写潦草的人

senses.def: a problem that writers sometimes have when they cannot think of what to write and have no new ideas
senses.chn: （写作人的）灵感障碍，神思枯竭，写作笔障

senses.def: a pain or stiff feeling in the hand caused by writing for a long time
senses.chn: 书写痉挛（长时间写字造成的手部疼痛或僵硬感）

senses.def: to include a rule or condition in a contract or an agreement when it is made
an article in a newspaper or magazine in which sb writes what they think about a new book, play, product, etc.
to twist or move your body without stopping, often because you are in great pain
senses.chn: （常指因剧痛不停地）扭动，翻滚

ex.en: She was writhing around on the floor in agony.
ex.cn: 她痛得在地板上直打滚。

ex.en: The snake writhed and hissed.
ex.cn: 那蛇蠕动着，发出嘶嘶的声音。

ex.en: He was writhing (= suffering a lot) with embarrassment.
ex.cn: 他难堪得无地自容。

senses.def: the activity of writing, in contrast to reading, speaking, etc.

ex.en: Our son's having problems with his reading and writing (= at school).
ex.cn: 我们儿子在读写方面有困难。

ex.en: a writing case (= containing paper, pens, etc.)
ex.cn: 文具盒

senses.def: the activity of writing books, articles, etc., especially as a job

ex.en: Only later did she discover a talent for writing.
ex.cn: 她后来才发现自己的写作天分。

ex.en: He is leaving the band to concentrate on his writing.
ex.cn: 他要离开乐队去专职写作。

ex.en: creative writing
ex.cn: 文学创作

ex.en: feminist/travel, etc. writing
ex.cn: 女权主义文章、游记等的写作

senses.def: books, articles, etc. in general

ex.en: The review is a brilliant piece of writing.
ex.cn: 这篇评论很精彩。

senses.def: a group of pieces of writing, especially by a particular person or on a particular subject

ex.en: His experiences in India influenced his later writings.
ex.cn: 他在印度的经历影响了他后来的著作。

ex.en: the writings of Hegel
ex.cn: 黑格尔的著作

senses.def: words that have been written or painted on sth

ex.en: There was writing all over the desk.
ex.cn: 书桌上写满了字。

senses.def: the particular way in which sb forms letters when they write

ex.en: Who's this from? I don't recognize the writing.
ex.cn: 这是谁写来的？我辨认不出笔迹。

senses.def: in the form of a letter, document, etc. (that gives proof of sth)

ex.en: All telephone reservations must be confirmed in writing.
ex.cn: 所有的电话预订必须以书面形式确认。

ex.en: Could you put your complaint in writing?
ex.cn: 你能把投诉的内容写下来吗？

ex.en: You must get it in writing.
ex.cn: 你必须用书面的形式。

senses.def: used when you are describing a situation in which there are signs that sth is going to have problems or that it is going to be a failure
senses.chn: （看出）厄运临头的预兆，不祥之兆

ex.en: It is amazing that not one of them saw the writing on the wall.
ex.cn: 令人吃惊的是他们就没有一个人看出大难临头的预兆。

senses.def: easy to see or understand

ex.en: Mistrust was writ large on her face.
ex.cn: 她脸上明显流露出不信任的神情。

senses.def: being a large or obvious example of the thing mentioned

ex.en: This is deception writ large.
ex.cn: 这是明目张胆的欺骗。

senses.def: expressed in writing rather than in speech

ex.en: written instructions
ex.cn: 书面指示

senses.def: involving writing rather than speaking or practical skills

ex.en: a written test
ex.cn: 笔试

ex.en: written communication skills
ex.cn: 书面交流技巧

senses.def: in the form of a letter, document, etc. and therefore official
senses.chn: 以书信（或文件等）形式的；书面的；成文的；正式的

ex.en: a written apology
ex.cn: 书面道歉

ex.en: a written contract
ex.cn: 书面合同

senses.def: language expressed in writing rather than in speech

ex.en: the permanence of the written word
ex.cn: 书面语传之久远的特性

senses.def: not right or correct
senses.chn: 错误的；不对的；不正确的

ex.en: I got all the answers wrong.
ex.cn: 我的答案全都错了。

ex.en: He was driving on the wrong side of the road.
ex.cn: 他开车行驶在道路逆行的一侧。

ex.en: Sorry, I must have dialled the wrong number.
ex.cn: 对不起，我一定是拨错电话号码了。

ex.en: You're holding the camera the wrong way up!
ex.cn: 你把照相机拿颠倒了！

ex.en: That picture is the wrong way round.
ex.cn: 那幅画挂反了。

senses.def: not right about sth/sb

ex.en: I think she lives at number 44, but I could be wrong.
ex.cn: 我想她是住在 44 号，不过我可能记错了。

ex.en: You were wrong about Tom; he's not married after all.
ex.cn: 你把汤姆的情况搞错了，他根本没结婚。

ex.en: We were wrong to assume that she'd agree.
ex.cn: 我们错误地以为她会同意。

ex.en: She would prove him wrong (= prove that he was wrong) whatever happened.
ex.cn: 不论发生的是什么事，她都会证明他是错的。

ex.en: You think you've beaten me but that's where you're wrong.
ex.cn: 你以为已经赢了我了，可你错就错在这里。

ex.en: Correct me if I'm wrong (= I may be wrong) but didn't you say you two knew each other?
ex.cn: 我若说错了请你纠正，你不是说过你们彼此认识吗？

senses.def: causing problems or difficulties; not as it should be
senses.chn: 引起问题（或麻烦）；有毛病；不正常

ex.en: Is anything wrong? You look worried.
ex.cn: 出了什么事？看你愁眉苦脸的样子。

ex.en: ' What's wrong?' 'Oh, nothing.'
ex.cn: “哪儿不舒服？” “噢，没事。”

ex.en: There's something wrong with the printer.
ex.cn: 打印机出了故障。

ex.en: The doctor could find nothing wrong with him.
ex.cn: 医生查不出他有什么病。

ex.en: I have something wrong with my foot.
ex.cn: 我的脚有点儿不对劲。

senses.def: not suitable, right or what you need
senses.chn: 不合适的；不适当的；不合意的

ex.en: He's the wrong person for the job.
ex.cn: 他不适合做这项工作。

ex.en: I realized that it was the wrong thing to say.
ex.cn: 我意识到说这话不恰当。

ex.en: We don't want this document falling into the wrong hands.
ex.cn: 我们不想让这份文件落入不对路的人手里。

ex.en: It was his bad luck to be in the wrong place at the wrong time (= so that he got involved in trouble without intending to).
ex.cn: 算他倒霉，在错误的时间出现在错误的地方。

senses.def: not morally right or honest

ex.en: This man has done nothing wrong.
ex.cn: 这位男子没有做过不正当的事。

ex.en: It is wrong to tell lies.
ex.cn: 说谎是不道德的。

ex.en: It was wrong of me to get so angry.
ex.cn: 我不该发这么大脾气。

ex.en: What's wrong with eating meat?
ex.cn: 吃肉有什么不对？

ex.en: It is wrong that he should not be punished for what he did.
ex.cn: 他的所作所为竟可不受惩罚，这太不公平了。

senses.def: from or living in a poor area or part of town
senses.chn: 来自（城里的）贫民区；住在贫穷的地区（或城区）

senses.def: to understand sth in the wrong way
in trouble with the police
to be offended by a remark that was not intended to be offensive
to support sb/sth that is not successful
senses.chn: 下错赌注（支持了失败的一方或事情）

senses.def: to have the wrong idea about how to get or achieve sth
senses.chn: 把方法搞错（或想偏）；走错路线

ex.en: You're barking up the wrong tree if you're expecting us to lend you any money.
ex.cn: 你要是指望我们借钱给你，你是走错庙门了。

senses.def: to be bad-tempered for the whole day for no particular reason
senses.chn: （无缘由地）一起床就整天情绪不好

senses.def: almost correct

ex.en: Your guess wasn't far out at all.
ex.cn: 你猜得几乎一点不错。

senses.def: to start a relationship well/badly

ex.en: I seem to have got off on the wrong foot with the new boss.
ex.cn: 看来我和新老板的关系一开头就不好。

senses.def: to do, say or write sth that is suitable/not suitable for a particular occasion
senses.chn: 做（或说、写）得得体／不得体

senses.def: to make sb annoyed or angry, often without intending to, by doing or saying sth that offends them
to make sb pleased with you/annoyed with you
senses.chn: 讨得某人的欢心；惹得某人恼怒

senses.def: younger or older than 40, 50, etc. years of age
senses.chn: 不到／已过 40 岁（或 50 岁等）

senses.def: thinking or behaving in the right/wrong way
senses.chn: 思路对头／不对头；做法对路／不对路

senses.def: in a way that produces a result that is not correct or that you do not want

ex.en: My name is spelt wrong.
ex.cn: 我的名字给拼错了。

ex.en: The program won't load. What am I doing wrong?
ex.cn: 这程序载入不了。我哪里出错了？

ex.en: I was trying to apologize but it came out wrong (= what I said sounded wrong).
ex.cn: 我是想要道歉，可是话一出口却变了味儿。

ex.en: 'I thought you were going out.' 'Well you must have thought wrong, then!'
ex.cn: “我原以为你要出去呢。” “啊，那你一定是想错了！”

ex.en: My name was spelled wrong.
ex.cn: 我的名字拼错了。

ex.en: I'm afraid you guessed wrong.
ex.cn: 恐怕你猜错了。

senses.def: to not understand correctly what sb means
senses.chn: 误会，误解，曲解（某人的意思）

ex.en: Don't get me wrong (= do not be offended by what I am going to say), I think he's doing a good job, but…
ex.cn: 别误解我，我认为他活儿干得不错，不过…

senses.def: to not understand a situation correctly

ex.en: No, you've got it all wrong. She's his wife.
ex.cn: 不，你完全误会了。她是他的妻子。

senses.def: to make a mistake with sth

ex.en: I must have got the figures wrong.
ex.cn: 我一定是把数字给搞错了。

senses.def: to make a mistake
senses.chn: 犯错误；做错事；搞错；弄错

ex.en: If you do what she tells you, you won't go far wrong.
ex.cn: 你要是按照她说的做，就不会出大差错。

ex.en: Where did we go wrong with those kids (= what mistakes did we make for them to behave so badly)?
ex.cn: 我们在什么地方把这些孩子惯坏了？

senses.def: to stop working correctly

ex.en: My watch keeps going wrong.
ex.cn: 我的表不断地出毛病。

senses.def: to experience problems or difficulties

ex.en: The relationship started to go wrong when they moved abroad.
ex.cn: 移居国外后，他们的关系开始出现问题了。

ex.en: What else can go wrong (= what other problems are we going to have)?
ex.cn: 还会出现什么问题？

senses.def: used to say that sth will always be acceptable in a particular situation
senses.chn: 绝对不会出错；绝不会有问题

ex.en: For a quick lunch you can't go wrong with pasta.
ex.cn: 想要吃一顿快捷的午餐，吃意大利面准错不了。

senses.def: to make a mistake

ex.en: In the last two games he has hardly put a foot wrong.
ex.cn: 他在上两局比赛中几乎一点错都没有出。

senses.def: behaviour that is not honest or morally acceptable
senses.chn: 不义行为；欺骗行径；恶行

ex.en: Children must be taught the difference between right and wrong.
ex.cn: 必须教儿童分清是非。

ex.en: Her son can do no wrong in her eyes.
ex.cn: 在她眼里，她的儿子不可能做坏事。

senses.def: an act that is not legal, honest or morally acceptable

ex.en: It is time to forgive past wrongs if progress is to be made.
ex.cn: 如果想有进步，现在就该宽恕过去的罪过。

senses.def: responsible for an accident, a mistake, an argument, etc.
senses.chn: （在事故、错误、争论等中）有错，应承担责任

ex.en: The motorcyclist was clearly in the wrong.
ex.cn: 骑摩托车的人显然对事故负有责任。

senses.def: used to say that if sb does sth bad to you, the situation will not be improved by doing sth bad to them
senses.chn: 冤冤相报永无完了；以牙还牙行不通

senses.def: to do sth to correct an unfair situation or sth bad that you have done
to treat sb badly or in an unfair way

ex.en: He felt deeply wronged by the allegations.
ex.cn: 这些指控让他感到深受冤枉。

example.en: You were wrong about Tom; he's not married after all.
example.cn: 你把汤姆的情况搞错了，他根本没结婚。

example.en: We were wrong to assume that she'd agree.
example.cn: 我们错误地以为她会同意。

example.en: There's something wrong with the printer.
example.cn: 打印机出了故障。

example.en: He's the wrong person for the job.
example.cn: 他不适合做这项工作。

example.en: I realized that it was the wrong thing to say.
example.cn: 我意识到说这话不恰当。

example.en: It is wrong to tell lies.
example.cn: 说谎是不道德的。

example.en: What's wrong with eating meat?
example.cn: 吃肉有什么不对？

example.en: It is wrong that he should not be punished for what he did.
example.cn: 他的所作所为竟可不受惩罚，这太不公平了。

senses.def: a person who does sth dishonest or illegal
senses.chn: 做坏事的人；违法犯罪者；作恶者

senses.def: illegal or dishonest behaviour
senses.chn: 不法行为；坏事；作恶；欺骗行径

senses.def: to put sb in a difficult or embarrassing situation by doing sth that they do not expect
senses.chn: 使措手不及；使窘态毕露

ex.en: It was an attempt to wrong-foot the opposition.
ex.cn: 这一举动为的是让对手措手不及。

senses.def: not fair, morally right or legal
senses.chn: 不公正的；不道德的；不合法的

ex.en: She decided to sue her employer for wrongful dismissal.
ex.cn: 她决定起诉雇主非法解雇她。

senses.def: having or showing bad judgement
senses.chn: 判断错误的；执迷不悟的

ex.en: wrong-headed beliefs
ex.cn: 错误的信念

senses.def: in a way that is unfair, immoral or not correct
senses.chn: 不公正地；不道德地；错误地

ex.en: She was wrongly accused of stealing.
ex.cn: 她被诬告犯了偷盗罪。

ex.en: He assumed, wrongly, that she did not care.
ex.cn: 他误以为她并不在乎。

ex.en: The sentence had been wrongly translated.
ex.cn: 这个句子翻译错了。

ex.en: They knew they had acted wrongly.
ex.cn: 他们知道他们做得不对。

ex.en: Rightly or wrongly, they felt they should have been better informed (= I do not know whether they were right to feel this way).
ex.cn: 不论对错，他们觉得本该让他们了解到更多的情况。

ex.en: My name was spelled wrong.
ex.cn: 我的名字拼错了。

senses.def: caused sth to happen, especially a change
senses.chn: 使发生了，造成了（尤指变化）

ex.en: This century wrought major changes in our society.
ex.cn: 本世纪给我们的社会带来了重大变革。

ex.en: The storm wrought havoc in the south.
ex.cn: 这场暴风雨在南方造成了巨大的灾害。

senses.def: a form of iron used to make decorative fences, gates, etc.

ex.en: The gates were made of wrought iron.
ex.cn: 这些大门是用熟铁制成的。

ex.en: wrought-iron gates
ex.cn: 熟铁门

senses.def: showing that you are both amused and disappointed or annoyed

ex.en: 'At least we got one vote,' she said with a wry smile.
ex.cn: “我们起码还得了一票。” 她苦笑着解嘲道。

ex.en: He pulled a wry face when I asked him how it had gone.
ex.cn: 我问他近况如何，他有些哭笑不得。

senses.def: amusing in a way that shows irony

ex.en: a wry comedy about family life
